 Uphold the highest standards of data precision and monitor and rectify discrepancies across different platforms 

 Evaluate and implement tools and integrations to improve visibility, connectivity, and decision-making 

 Champion AI adoption across Global Partnerships 

 Identify, pilot, and scale AI tools and agentic workflows that remove manual work and give the team leverage, then drive team-wide adoption through training, documentation, and change management 

 Lead automation, process development, and operational scale. Enhance processes through automation to achieve data accuracy, reliability, and speed 

 Act as the team's AI thought partner, staying current on emerging tools and translating them into concrete, high-leverage improvements to LP-facing and internal processes 

 Leverage data to enable practical insights on our portfolio and the industry 

 Build visualizations and quantitative analyses that provide key insights on fund and investment performance including projected exit scenarios, liquidity and follow-on decisions 

 Develop strong fluency with the firm’s portfolio company information database and be able to manipulate and analyze data from the system to draw insights 

 Refine and calibrate portfolio performance analyses to stay current and relevant 

 Minimum Qualifications 

 Minimum of 5 years of experience. Preferable past experience includes but is not limited to, data analytics or data engineering 

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Economics, Finance, Accounting, or a technical field preferred but not required 

 Demonstrate a critical eye and keen attention to detail for written prose and charts, tables and spreadsheets and the ability to stay on top of changing data/facts across multiple documents with ease 

 Strong writing skills: The ability to communicate effectively through the written word is a critical skill 

 Demonstrated experience building and maintaining data workflows, automations, or integrations using tools such as Python, Javascript, or a comparable programming language 

 Proven ability to lead ambiguous, cross-functional projects with substantial autonomy and influence stakeholders across technical and business teams 

 Experience owning or administering complex data pipelines or another critical business system, with a focus on data completeness, governance, and integration 

 Low ego, high empathy, and the capacity to collaborate effectively with diverse teams 

 Ideal Candidate 

 You have a sense of urgency and value the courtesy of professional responsiveness (this is super important as speed is a form of client service) 

 You are able to adapt on the fly and handle unforeseen developments with ease. You are also able to do this without compromising attention to detail and quality 

 You are a “measure twice, cut once” type of person – you are comfortable and have a preference for asking more questions upfront to avoid an oversight down the road 

 You strive to be an enabler who gives the team maximum leverage - there is no job too big, no job too small 

 You do what you say you are going to do, when you say you are going to do it 

 You continually search for new ideas and means of improvement 

 You are a dedicated team player that is willing to wear multiple hats 

 Most importantly, you take your work seriously but not yourself too seriously 

 You anticipate business needs, take ownership without waiting to be asked, and design solutions for scale 

 You can break down complex processes, identify high-leverage improvements, and guide teams through change 

 You are a trusted partner and emerging leader whom peers consult on data practices, systems, and efficiency 

 The anticipated salary range for this role is between $269,000 - $314,000, actual starting pay may vary based on a range of factors which can include experience, skills, and scope. 

 This role is eligible to participate in the a16z carry program and various discretionary bonus programs as well as benefit and perquisite plans including health, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, 401K plan, vacation, and sick leave. 
 a16z culture 

 We do only first class business and only in a first class way 

 We take a long view of relationships, because we are in the relationship business 

 We believe in the future and bet the firm that way 

 We are all different, we recognize that, and we win 

 We celebrate the good times 

 We do it for the team 

 We play to win 

 At a16z we are always looking to hire the absolute best talent and recognize that diversity in our experiences and backgrounds is what makes us stronger. jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer - Data Connectors
jobs.description:
A World-Changing Company

Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role

The Connectivity team builds the software that connects Palantir’s platform to customer systems. Our connectors integrate databases, enterprise applications, cloud storage, web services, and streaming systems, enabling customers to bring data into Foundry and write back to their operational systems. From large datasets to real-time events and user-driven interactions, these connections underpin the applications and AI workflows customers build with Foundry and AIP.

You’ll build and maintain Foundry’s first-class connector suite and the shared infrastructure behind it. You’ll work across the stack, taking ownership of connector implementations, developer SDKs, and the systems that build, test, distribute, and run our connectivity software.

A central part of this work is evolving and scaling a large, established codebase. You’ll move integrations from bespoke infrastructure onto shared platform capabilities, design SDKs that enable other teams and customers to build integrations independently, and safely retire older implementations. You’ll also build observability and diagnostic tools that help users understand, monitor, and troubleshoot their connections. You’ll own improvements from design through production and use what you learn from operating connectors to strengthen the platform they share.

Technologies We Use

 Java and Python for connectors, backend services, and developer SDKs

 Open-source technologies like Kafka, Kubernetes, Flink, Debezium, Iceberg

 Industry-standard build tooling, including Gradle and GitHub

 Shared job orchestration, streaming, serverless execution, and compute deployment platforms

Core Responsibilities

 Build and maintain Foundry’s first-class connectors, improving performance and extending support for imports, exports, change data capture, interactive queries, and writeback as external systems and customer needs evolve.

 Improve the infrastructure that builds, tests, packages, and distributes connectors and shared libraries, including tooling across our connector monorepo.

 Design and maintain connectivity SDKs for internal teams and end users, with clear APIs, documentation, testing utilities, and development workflows that make integrations easy to author and maintain.

 Collaborate with product teams to integrate connector execution with job orchestration, streaming, and serverless platforms.

 Lead incremental migrations onto shared infrastructure, manage compatibility, and retire older implementations while preserving the workflows customers depend on.

 Develop reusable security frameworks and tooling that make secure connectivity a consistent part of connector development and execution.

 Debug production issues and performance problems across the stack, turning recurring support problems into durable fixes, automated tests, and better observability.

 Establish shared testing frameworks, compatibility checks, and release practices that keep a large connector portfolio reliable and maintainable.

 Help prepare and maintain Palantir connectivity software for open-source use, including its APIs, packaging, documentation, and contributor experience.

What We Value

 An ownership mindset and a high bar for correctness, security, and automated testing, including responsibility for how software behaves in production.

 Pride in building and maintaining integrations over time, including the detailed work required to keep them reliable as upstream systems change.

 Engineering judgment that balances delivering new capabilities with simplifying existing systems and reducing operational burden.

 Empathy for developers and end users, reflected in usable SDKs, clear configuration, actionable errors, and useful diagnostics.

 Curiosity about unfamiliar systems and persistence in debugging problems across languages, APIs, services, networks, and execution environments.

What We Require

 4+ years of professional software engineering experience developing external system connectors, with depth in areas such as developing batch and streaming data ingestion systems, third-party integration development, or monorepo and asset distribution frameworks. Operating on top of these technologies alone does not qualify.

 Deep expertise in Gradle, including developing custom plugins, managing multi-project builds, and optimizing build performance.

 Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex reliability and performance problems and improve systems through measured, incremental changes.

 Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively across teams, incorporate feedback, and hold a high bar for quality.

Salary

The estimated salary range for this position is estimated to be $135,000 - $200,000/year. Total compensation for this position may also include Restricted Stock units, sign-on bonus and other potential future incentives. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any potential sign-on bonus; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives.

Life at Palantir
We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.

In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.

If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please reach out and let us know how we can help.

Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

 At Abnormal AI, we are on a thrilling mission to safeguard the world's largest enterprises against a vast range of relentless email and collaboration application cyber security attacks.  The Multi-Product Platform (MPP) organization owns the product platform that enables scalable product development, helping the business build and launch enterprise-grade products with a consistent customer experience.

 This is a chance to build the data backbone that every Abnormal product depends on. As a Senior Software Engineer on MPP and founding engineer of the team, you'll create the standardised data layer that becomes our single source of truth — the one governed path through which any system, agent, or interface can reach data from across every product, from a single record to cross-product aggregates, online or offline, in whatever shape it needs. A hard, high-leverage problem: serve the whole platform at high throughput and low latency without becoming the bottleneck, while enforcing tenant isolation, auth, and fine-grained access control so every team gets security and reliability for free — built AI-native from day one.

 You won't be maintaining someone else's system — you'll be defining the foundation every product is built on, where getting it right compounds across the whole company.

 If you're energized by 0→1 platform work, driving cross-team standards, and owning a system end-to-end, this role is built for you.

 Technical Delivery & Operational Excellence 

 Design, build, and iterate on the APIs and services that make up the standardized data access layer.

 Drive adoption of API-gated data sources, so product teams expose their data once and every consuming surface can reuse it, instead of building one-off integrations.

 Design and implement standard labeling for data ownership, and build the validation logic that checks incoming requests against it.

 Own reliability, latency, and operational excellence for a high-throughput, low-latency system on the critical request path.

 Make the early architectural calls and codify them in technical design docs the team aligns on.

We are looking for a Data Architect I who combines strong platform design expertise with the judgment to assess legacy infrastructure and design an implementable, cloud-native architecture; someone who wants to own the technical direction of a critical modernization initiative without compromising the reliability enterprise clients depend on. Reporting directly to the Data Architect II overseeing AccuWeather’s data architecture function, this position will assess the legacy, on-premises infrastructure behind AccuWeather For Business and design the cloud-native architecture that will support its future. You will produce architecture and modernization design documents — including current-state assessments, target-state designs, transition and sequencing plans, and technical specifications — and work alongside engineering teams to implement key components of the architecture, while maintaining the reliability of the backend data systems that support critical data delivery services.

 You will demonstrate high-level knowledge across cloud platforms and legacy enterprise systems, independently resolve complex architecture and modernization challenges, and collaborate closely with the Data Architect II and engineering teams. Your work will help modernize the technology foundation behind AccuWeather For Business, creating a more scalable, resilient, and cloud-native platform while maintaining the reliability expected by the Fortune 500 companies that depend on it.

 We are open to hiring candidates to work from our global headquarters in State College, PA, USA, or remotely.

 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 · Assess the legacy, on-premises infrastructure behind AccuWeather For Business, documenting current-state architecture, system dependencies, data flows, and technical debt to inform modernization priorities.

 · Design the cloud-native architecture, producing architecture designs, technical specifications, and other documentation needed to guide implementation.

 · Own the architectural direction for the modernization effort, ensuring a cohesive approach across the platform rather than individual services or components.

 · Develop a roadmap and sequencing plan that provides a practical path from the current environment to the cloud-native architecture while minimizing disruption to enterprise clients.

 · Design backend data systems to maintain continuity of critical data delivery services throughout the transition.

 · Partner with engineering and data teams to validate and implement architecture designs, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, performant, and maintainable.

 · Contribute hands-on to the implementation of architecture designs, including developing and modifying code, data models, schemas, and supporting data platform components.

 · Estimate data consumption, capacity, and infrastructure requirements, incorporating cloud infrastructure costs into architecture decisions and trade-offs.

 · Identify and document architectural and operational risks associated with modernizing a customer-facing production platform, and design appropriate mitigation strategies.

 · Ensure the cloud-native architecture addresses performance, security, scalability, resiliency, recoverability, compliance, and data residency requirements.

 · Understand system scheduling, integrations, and dependencies across the platform and incorporate them into planning and sequencing.

 · Serve as a technical point of contact for questions and decisions related to the modernization effort’s architectural direction.

 QUALIFICATIONS

 · Required Qualifications:

 o BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, with 5+ years of experience in data or enterprise architecture, or MS with 3+ years of experience.

 o High-level knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., Microsoft Azure) and cloud-native architecture.

 o Demonstrated experience assessing legacy, on-premises systems and designing modern, cloud-native architectures.

 o Demonstrated experience planning or supporting large-scale modernization initiatives for production, customer-facing platforms.

 o Experience designing production data platforms for performance, scalability, resiliency, and recoverability.

 o Experience analyzing complex system dependencies, integrations, data flows, and scheduling requirements to inform architecture and modernization decisions.

 o Demonstrated experience working with PostgreSQL, including relational data modeling, schema design, and query development.

 o Advanced proficiency in Python or Go, with experience developing production-quality code for data platforms or backend systems.

 · Preferred Qualifications:

 o Experience designing backend data platforms that support data delivery to external or enterprise clients.

 o Experience evaluating technology and architecture options, including build-versus-buy decisions and alternative modernization approaches.

 o Experience evaluating infrastructure requirements and costs to inform cloud architecture decisions and design trade-offs.

 o Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, and data governance requirements, including SOC 2 and data residency considerations.

 · Skills & Competencies:

 o Strong systems thinking, with the ability to design architectures that engineering teams can implement and maintain effectively.

 o Excellent written communication, with the ability to produce clear, actionable architecture and technical design documentation.

 o Sound technical judgment, with the ability to translate business and platform requirements into pragmatic architecture without overengineering or underspecifying solutions.

 o Ability to move effectively between architecture and hands-on implementation, translating designs into working solutions in collaboration with engineering teams.

 o Ability to mentor team members and help develop the architectural judgment of less experienced engineers.

 o Ability to independently lead complex, large-scale architecture initiatives and drive technical decisions through ambiguity.

 About AccuWeather and Dr. Joel N. Myers 

 AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making. jobs.description:
About us 

 AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

 About AB InBev Growth Group 

 Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

 What you'll do: 

 Own the technical design and delivery of the data model for a BEES business domain. Start from business intent and from the data sources that exist, and produce authoritative definitions for entities, assets, attributes, relationships, identifiers, and grain.

 Profile source systems and Unity Catalog tables (grain, keys, cardinality, overlap, nulls, and how columns are derived) and decide which sources can support a trustworthy representation of the business.

 Produce and evolve the domain's canonical logical model and canonical datasets, including identifiers, relationships, and cardinalities. Map attributes to physical columns, with transformation, nullability, and lineage documented so consumers can trust the result.

 Design master-data outcomes for the domain, including entity resolution: match approach, blocking keys, duplicate handling, cross-system identity, and survivorship when sources disagree.

 Define advanced data-quality expectations on the model (uniqueness at the declared grain, referential integrity, completeness, validity, consistency across sources, reconciliation, and freshness) and contribute to the Data Quality Framework and Tooling so those expectations become executable checks and monitoring.

 Shape the model for its consumers. Data scientists and data analysts are the primary consumers. The same model feeds downstream data products such as curated tables, metric views, and feature tables, with a stable grain and documented semantics.

 Contribute to the ontology codebase: Python packages, SQL and Spark on Databricks, YAML definition contracts, entity classification, lineage-aware mappings, and tests. Review pull requests on models, mappings, and ontology-aligned dataset changes.

 Drive entity and attribute lifecycle work: creation, change, split, rename, deprecation, and retirement, with compatibility guidance and clear communication to consumers.

 Escalate cross-domain conflicts or ownership disputes when broader alignment is required.

 Mentor engineers on the team through design review, source-analysis pairing, and hands-on support

 What you'll need: 

 Senior experience as a data engineer, data analyst, or any equivalent role in data, who has designed conceptual and logical data models from operational source systems in a complex business.

 A record of turning ambiguous business context and imperfect data into a model with explicit entities, grain, keys, relationships, and cardinalities that downstream teams actually use.

 Hands-on master data management, including entity resolution: deterministic and probabilistic matching, blocking, duplicate detection, golden-record or survivorship rules, and identity across systems.

 Advanced data quality technique. You have designed and applied uniqueness, referential integrity, validity, completeness, consistency, reconciliation, and timeliness checks, and you have seen them catch real defects before consumers did. SQL, Python, or a quality framework in production counts.

 Traditional data engineering: production SQL (joins, aggregations, window functions), batch ELT patterns, and enough PySpark or Spark SQL to profile a source and prototype a conformed dataset on Databricks.

 Ability to contribute to a Python codebase: change an existing package, add a test, and carry a pull request through review. Our stack is Python 3.11+, Databricks (Unity Catalog and Delta), SQL, and YAML contracts in Git.

 Experience with catalog or metadata systems, mapping business attributes onto physical tables and columns, lineage, and data contracts between producers and consumers.

 Experience reviewing other engineers' models and code, and mentoring through design feedback and documentation.

 Collaboration in GitHub or Azure DevOps, including review of changes from outside the immediate team.

 Clear written and verbal communication with business stakeholders, data scientists, and data analysts. Definitions should be usable without a meeting.

 Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or another quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

 Nice to have: 

 Relevant data management and governance experience: business glossaries, critical data elements, stewardship, naming standards, and dataset certification. The team will teach the ontology vocabulary.

 Prior work on Azure Databricks or Unity Catalog.

 Experience preparing data for data scientists or analysts: feature grain, metric grain, slowly changing attributes, or point-in-time correctness.

 Exposure to entity classification, schema matching, or duplication discovery across a large table estate.

 Prior experience in a marketplace, B2B, or B2C company.

 More about you: 

 You own the model for your domain after it ships: you answer consumer questions, and you change the definition when the data or the business shows it is wrong.

 You trust a model after you have looked at the data, and you can show the grain, the key, and the source behind a definition.

 You care that a data scientist or a data analyst can use an entity without reverse-engineering the source system.

 You treat identifiers, match rules, and grain as product decisions, because a wrong key breaks quality, metrics, and downstream products together.

 You write definitions, mappings, and quality expectations that another engineer can implement.

 You raise the bar through review, documentation, and practical mentorship.

 You balance delivery urgency with compatibility when an entity that consumers already use has to change.

jobs.title: Data Engineering Manager (Billing Development)
jobs.description:
About the Role: You will own the design and architecture of aCommerce's billing platform . Your main goal is to turn billable business events into accurate, auditable charges, invoices, and financial records . This is a highly hands-on leadership role where you will lead a team of data engineers while continuing to write code, build prototypes, and set engineering standards . 

 Responsibilities: 

 Specifically, this role will be doing:

 Design and own the end-to-end architecture of a scalable, multi-country, multi-currency billing platform, from capturing billable business events through rating, invoicing and posting to the accounting system

 Define the billing data model – clients, contracts, rate cards, billable events, charges, invoices, credit notes and adjustments – with full traceability from every invoice line back to its source events

 Architect the pipelines that extract billable business events from our supply chain, fulfillment, delivery and SaaS applications into the data platform, guaranteeing completeness and integrity

 Build a flexible rating and pricing engine that supports our commercial models: per-order and per-unit fees, storage, tiered and volume pricing, minimum commitments, subscriptions and pass-through costs

 Ensure the billing platform meets accounting requirements in terms of completeness and timeliness, including revenue recognition, accruals, month-end close, tax across Southeast Asian markets and integration with our ERP

 Design reconciliation and controls: automated checks between operational events, billed charges and financial records, complete audit trails, and processes for disputes, adjustments and re-billing

 This is a MUST: Stay hands-on, write production code for the most critical and complex components, build prototypes and proofs of concept Own the quality of the code your team delivers – lead design and code reviews, and quality-check the pipelines, SQL, Python and data models built by the data engineers 

 Establish and enforce engineering practices: version control and branching strategy, CI/CD, automated testing (unit, integration and data-quality tests), infrastructure-as-code, documentation and observability

 Define data-quality standards and monitoring for billing data, and lead incident response and root-cause analysis when billing issues occur

 Make and document architecture decisions that balance scalability, performance, cost and maintainability on our AWS-based data platform (Amazon Redshift, PostgreSQL)

 Work with revenue operation team to define event contracts and schemas, so that upstream changes do not break billing

 Ensure that settlements from all sources are ingested, monitored, and maintained for maximum reliability

 Translate client contracts and commercial requirements from Finance and the commercial teams into technical specifications, and advise them on the feasibility and billing impact of new pricing models

 Plan and prioritize the billing roadmap with Billing Product Manager; do work break down, effort estimation, and deliver predictably

 Lead, coach and develop the billing engineering team – hiring, setting goals and giving regular feedback – to build a high-performing team

 Protect financial and client data through appropriate access controls, and support internal and external audits

 Identify possible risks and take measures to prevent these and escalate if needed

 QUALIFICATIONS 

 In order to succeed in this role, we are looking for an individual with the following skill sets and experiences:

 Job Overview:
 ABC Legal is looking for a detail-oriented Database Engineer to help own, improve, and scale the PostgreSQL database layer behind Skye, our core legal-services platform. Skye supports high-volume process serving, court filing, operational workflows, customer facing applications, mobile field work, integrations, reporting, billing, and automation. Its primary operational database is PostgreSQL across all environments, with AWS Aurora reader/writer topology in production and major staging environments.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys deep database work: understanding complex schemas, reviewing migrations, tuning high-volume queries, diagnosing production issues, improving operational safety, and helping application engineers make better data-access decisions. Accounting, ERP, or NetSuite/Boomi experience is helpful because some important data flows touch billing and payments, but this is fundamentally a PostgreSQL/Aurora database engineering role.

What You’ll Do: 

 • Serve as a PostgreSQL and AWS Aurora subject-matter expert for our internal system Skye’s operational database.

 • Manage and improve a large relational schema with hundreds of tables, high volume operational data, and substantial historical data.

 • Review database changes for correctness, performance, safety, indexing, grants, triggers, foreign keys, and migration hygiene.

 • Analyze and triage production database issues, including slow queries, lock contention, blocking transactions, runaway queries, replication lag, and performance regressions. 

 •Improve query performance and indexing for large tables, reporting workloads, assignment/routing workflows, mobile API payloads, and internal operational dashboards.

 • Automate routine database maintenance and operational tasks, such as repacking, cleanup, monitoring checks, and recurring reports.

 • Support database refresh, backup, restore, staging, and release workflows in partnership with Infrastructure.

 • 5+ years of experience working with production relational databases (8+ years a plus). 

 • Strong production experience with PostgreSQL, ideally including AWS Aurora PostgreSQL.

 • Strong SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, query plans, indexes, constraints, triggers, transactions, and lock behavior.

 • Experience investigating high-volume databases with large tables, long-lived schemas, and real production load.

 • Ability to distinguish intrinsic query cost from lock contention, blocking, bad plans, missing indexes, and application call-volume issues.

 • Strong attention to detail when reviewing schema migrations and operational changes.

 • Experience collaborating with application engineers on database-backed application design and performance.

 • Good judgment around access control, PII, production safety, and release risk.

 • Clear written communication for documenting findings, tradeoffs, and recommended fixes.

 • Bachelor's degree in engineering or software field preferred, Master's Degree is a plus.

Very Nice to Have: 

 • Experience with Linux, Bash, scripting, cron, or other orchestration/automation tools used for database maintenance and operational workflows.

 • Java experience, especially in applications using MyBatis, Spring, or similar data access frameworks.

 • Experience with reporting workloads, BI tooling, Metabase-style access patterns, PostGIS, or geospatial query performance.

 • Experience with AWS monitoring tools, CloudWatch, RDS/Aurora Performance Insights, pg_stat_statements, pgAdmin, or similar observability tools.

 • Experience using AI coding agents such as Codex, Claude, or similar tools; at minimum, willingness to use AI-assisted development tools as part of day-to-day engineering work.

 • Secondary bonus: experience with NetSuite, Boomi, ERP / iPaaS integrations, accounting, billing, AR/AP, payments, invoices, credit memos, customer deposits, vendor payments, or working-table integration patterns.

jobs.description:
Company Description 

 Air is the leader in Enterprise Readiness. Our mission is to establish readiness as a real-time condition that is continuously achieved. Today, a dangerous Readiness Gap exists between what the front line needs and what is delivered. Our AI-native platform, Air Enterprise Readiness, aligns development, production, delivery, and sustainment into one coordinated execution system for government agencies and industrial suppliers. By revealing true capacity, exposing real constraints, coordinating resources, and executing at the speed of operational demands, the front line gets what it needs to succeed.

 Job Description 

 We are seeking an exceptional and experienced Data Engineer team member, a role for someone who shares our passion and obsession with shipping insightful and accurate data. You will be a core member of our team dedicated to helping drive our growth by building and maintaining data pipelines that deliver key business insights. The ideal candidate is an analytically minded engineer with large dataset experience. You must also possess strong interpersonal skills to work cross-functionally across internal teams and with Air platform Subject Matter Experts (SMEs).

 You will support the proliferation of our enterprise data by sourcing data from business systems and our core application, and transforming that into a scalable data model delivering key insights. This role involves collaborating with technical and business stakeholders, maintaining high-confidence accuracy across every stage of our medallion architecture, and ensuring our tooling and data model scales to meet growth. You will own the execution, delivery, and validation of key data pipelines driving GTM, Operations, Product, and Engineering decisions.

 This role is a full-time position located out of our office in Pittsburgh, PA. 

 This role may require up to 10% travel

 Scope of Responsibilities

 Collaborate with other software engineers, product managers, and client-facing teams to understand client requirements and translate them into technical solutions

 Lead the deployment and integration of our software and data solutions in client environments, ensuring smooth implementation and adherence to project timelines

 Actively participate in designing, building and testing scalable data architecture

 Craft clean, testable, and maintainable code

 Participate in the end-to-end software development of new feature functionality and design capabilities

 Optimize processes for maximum speed and accuracy

 Regularly seek out innovation and continuous improvement, finding efficiency in all assigned tasks

 Qualifications

 U.S. Citizenship is required

 Required Skills: 

 3+ years of writing, maintaining, and optimizing Production grade SQL to support business functions and/or applications. Knows how to efficiently write CTE’s, correlated and non-correlated subqueries, and window functions.

 3+ years of data modeling. Knows star and snowflake schemas and the difference between a dimension and a fact.

 3+ years writing ETL pipelines. Has used Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or similar orchestration tools.

 1-3+ years of Python for pipelines, data science, or applications

 Has hands-on experience in at least one startup/tech data domain: Finance, Pipeline/Funnel, Product Analytics, Operations

 Ability to quickly understand how end user engagement with an application ties to conversion and revenue.

 Demonstrated track record of working collaboratively and delivering independently

 Strong judgment and attention to detail when validating complex relationships and resolving ambiguous cases

 Excellent written communication — able to document decisions with clear reasoning and auditable source support

 Ability to prioritize, triage, and execute quickly while maintaining consistent quality

 Strong stakeholder communication skills and the ability to coordinate across multiple workstreams

 Close attention to detail and validating data accuracy

 Desired Skills: 

 Current possession of a U.S. security clearance, or the ability to obtain one with our sponsorship

 Experience in or exposure to the nuances of a startup or other entrepreneurial environment

 Experience with a Business Intelligence tool (Tableau, Looker, Sigma, etc.)

 Exposure to Data Governance practices (Source of Truth, Role Level Security, permissions and roles)

 We firmly believe that past performance is the best indicator of future performance. If you thrive while building solutions to complex problems, are a self-starter, and are passionate about making an impact in global security, we’re eager to hear from you.

jobs.description:
[Job Overview]
We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to join our engineering team and play a key role in building and scaling our enterprise data platform. You will design, develop, and maintain high-quality data warehouses and data-driven applications that power analytics, reconciliation, and business decision-making across the organization.
This role requires strong expertise in modern data architectures, pipeline engineering, and data quality management. The ideal candidate combines hands-on technical capability with a deep commitment to reliability, scalability, and governance in a regulated environment.

· Data operations: own day-to-day operations of data platforms/pipelines capacity, stability, upgrades, deployments, and recovery drills to sustain high availability and low latency.

· Implement automated remediation, reconciliation workflows, and historical backfilling.
· Establish monitoring and alerting frameworks to ensure trusted, production-grade datasets.
· End-to-End pipelines: plan and maintain scalable ETL/ELT including scheduling, caching, partitioning, modelling, schema evolution, and lineage to support both batch and real-time streaming.
· Enforce data access controls, encryption, auditing, and classification to comply with internal policies and external regulatory requirements (including PII management).
· Apply Infrastructure-as-Code, data versioning, data tests, and CI/CD to improve predictability and reduce manual risk.
· Contribute to embedded GenAI and LLM-powered data applications for enterprise analytics, reconciliation, and internal productivity use cases.
· Partner with analytics and product teams to operationalize AI-driven data solutions.

[Requirements]
· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
· 5+ years of experience in data engineering, data platform architecture, or AI/ML engineering.
· Strong experience with modern cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift).
· Hands-on experience building BI data foundations and supporting GenAI / LLM architectures.
· Proficiency in SQL and workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow), streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka), and pipeline design best practices.
· Solid understanding of data warehouse development lifecycles and dimensional modeling concepts.
· Familiarity with GitLab and CI/CD pipelines.
· Strong debugging, performance tuning, and problem-solving skills.
· Working knowledge of data governance, lineage, privacy, and security frameworks.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
At Aircapture, we’re creating and scaling a circular carbon economy to solve what we believe to be the challenge of our lifetime: the climate crisis. We supply commercial and industrial customers with clean CO₂ captured directly from the atmosphere, transforming a climate threat into a valuable resource. Solving a challenge of this scale takes people with different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking. We value those differences and believe they make us a stronger team. 

 You will shape the data foundation that runs our technology by owning the pipelines, models, and analyses that turn operational data from our Direct Air Capture (DAC) systems into the insights that our engineers and scientists rely upon. Partnering with our test and engineering teams, you’ll turn the continuous stream of sensor, process, and test data from the physical equipment in the field and shop into actionable decisions. You have built and run production data systems in a hardware or physical product environment, and are comfortable with the realities of real-world sensor data, making durable architectural choices that hold up over time. If this sounds like you and you are excited to have a major impact at a groundbreaking climate technology startup, we want to hear from you!

 This role is onsite at our development and production facility in Berkeley, California. 

 Salary: $180,000-$220,000 per year 

 Please include a cover letter with your application–describe why you are interested in this role and Aircapture using your own words (not AI). 

 What You’ll Do Here 

 Own and evolve Aircapture’s end-to-end data platform, using both Ignition and AWS

 Set technical direction for the data stack, evaluating tools, defining standards, and making durable architectural decisions

 Standardize and enforce engineering workflows across the data stack, such as version control, code review, CI/CD, testing, and documentation

 Maintain and support on-prem server systems as part of the data infrastructure

 Partner closely with controls engineering on Ignition rollout

 Partner with test engineering to build the pipeline that moves test and operational telemetry, including sensor, DAQ, and historian data, into the dashboards and reports engineering relies on

 Your Skills and Experience Include 

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on industry experience, Master’s preferred

 6+ years building and operating production data systems that are mission critical to a hardware or physical product, gained in an industry such as automotive, aerospace, robotics, industrial equipment, energy, or semiconductor manufacturing. Hands-on hardware/physical-product experience required

 Solid experience with AWS and services such as RDS, IAM, VPC, S3

 Strong SQL and Python expertise combined with solid engineering fundamentals across Git, CI/CD, and production workflows

 Thorough background in dbt across the full model lifecycle, plus orchestration tools like Airflow and Docker for production deployment

 Hands-on experience with industrial historian or DAQ platforms such as Ignition, ibaPDA, Keysight, National Instruments, or similar, as well as fluency working with time-series and sensor data

 Working physical intuition for the systems generating your data — thermal, fluid, electrical, or mechanical — sufficient to sanity-check sensor readings, spot anomalies, and communicate credibly with test and controls engineers

 Strong analytical orientation toward data interpretation, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and adjust architectural decisions accordingly

 Effective cross-functional collaborator and communicator; able to translate ambiguity into scoped work and push back when needed

 Self-directed, resourceful, and highly ownership-oriented from scoping through delivery

 Bonus: BI tooling experience, climate/energy domain background, or prior experience partnering directly with a test or reliability engineering function

 Aircapture strives to create a safe, inclusive, equitable and diverse workplace where everyone can do their best work. We hope you feel welcome here.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Data Analytics
jobs.description:
Agility’s commercially deployed humanoids operate alongside teams in warehouses, manufacturing facilities, and distribution centers—tackling physically demanding and repetitive tasks while enabling workers to focus on higher-value work. With industry-leading safety standards and years of proven deployment data, we're pioneering a new era of automation that enhances human potential.

 About The Team 

 Agility Robotics is building the future of work through humanoid robots that operate in human environments. The Data Platform team builds the data infrastructure that powers everything from fleet operations and hardware reliability to business analytics and machine learning. We enable engineers across robotics, perception, and product teams to derive insight from the vast quantities of telemetry and log data generated by our robots in the field. 

 About The Role 

 We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data Platform team and help shape the foundation of data-driven operations at Agility. In this role, you’ll work closely with robotics & and operations teams to design, curate, and maintain high-quality datasets that enable analytics, debugging, and fleet-scale insights. 

 You’ll bridge the gap between raw robot data and actionable information — working both on-robot data generation and in the cloud ingestion and processing pipelines. You’ll design transformations, author pipelines, and collaborate across teams to deliver reliable and queryable data products for hardware reliability, system health, workflow metrics, and root cause analysis. 

 What You’ll Do 

 Collaborate with robot software and hardware teams to define, collect, and curate data needed for analytics and debugging. 

 Develop and maintain ETL pipelines that transform raw robot logs and telemetry into structured datasets using Spark, Airflow (or equivalent orchestration tools), and AWS data services. 

 Own the gold-layer datasets that power fleet dashboards, reliability models, and business metrics, with defined freshness SLAs, documentation, and monitoring so analytics and data science teams can rely on them. 

 Implement data quality checks, schema evolution, and metadata management practices using our internal Data Registry and cataloging systems. 

 Collaborate with internal consumers — reliability, analytics, and ML teams — to design efficient data models for their workflows. 

 Occasionally contribute to shared libraries or APIs in Python, Java, or C++ to support data capture and consumption. 

 What We’re Looking For 

 Required: 

 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or similar role building and maintaining production data pipelines. 

 Strong proficiency in Apache Spark or equivalent distributed data processing framework with complementary programming skills in Python, Java and/or Scala. 

 Experience with Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or other data orchestration systems. 

 Proficiency with data formats such as Avro, Parquet, and structured/numeric datasets. 

 Familiarity with table formats like Icerbeg, Delta Lake etc and medallion architecture. 

 Solid understanding of data modeling, schema evolution, and data quality best practices. 

 Good intuitions of how to model datasets logically and partition them physically for optimal query performance, both for analytical query engines and for playback or root-cause-analysis(e.g. ReRun, Foxglove etc) 

 Comfort working cross-functionally with software, hardware, and analytics teams in a fast-paced environment 

 Nice to Have: 

 Familiarity with data versioning or immutable dataset design (e.g., Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake) 

 Experience with vision data (RGB, depth, point clouds, or perception outputs) pipelines and how to process, store, and query multimodal efficiently. 

 Familiarity with C++ and willingness to contribute to lightweight logging or data serialization libraries. 

 Experience with data catalog systems and metadata management. 

 Why You’ll Love Working Here 

 Join a small, high-impact team building the data foundation for humanoid robotics. 

 Work at the intersection of physical systems and large-scale data infrastructure. 

 Collaborate with talented roboticists, software engineers, and data scientists shaping the future of automation 

 Location 

 This is a fully remote role with the option to work hybrid if a commutable distance from our Salem, OR, Pittsburgh, PA, or Fremont, CA offices. 

 The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to: market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This range may change based on geographical location and may be modified in the future. 
 Anticipated Base Salary Range
 $175,000 — $274,000 USD 

 In addition to base pay, our competitive total rewards package consists of the following for full-time employees: 

 401(k) Plan: Includes a 6% company match.

 Equity: Company stock options.

 Insurance Coverage: 100% company-paid medical, dental, vision, and short/long-term disability insurance for employees.

 Benefit Start Date: Eligible for benefits on your first day of employment.

 Well-Being Support: Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

 Time Off: 

 Exempt Employees: Flexible, unlimited PTO and 12 company holidays, including a winter shutdown.

 Non-Exempt Employees: 10 vacation days, paid sick leave, and 12 company holidays, including a winter shutdown, annually.

 On-Site Perks: Catered lunches four times a week and a variety of healthy snacks and refreshments at our Salem and Pittsburgh locations.

 Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave programs.

 Work Environment: A culture that supports flexible work arrangements.

 Growth Opportunities: Professional development and tuition reimbursement programs.

Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company's products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. The result is trusted customer experiences with stronger conversions for measurable business impact. 

 As a Senior Software Engineer on the Connectors Platform Team, you’ll play a key role in building products that help our customers ingest, transform, and enrich their data with AI, making it simple to integrate into Algolia.

 The Team & Platform 

 The Connectors Platform Team builds and scales the services that bring our customers’ data into Algolia, reliably, securely, and at scale.

 Our work touches:

 E-commerce: powering real-time integrations with Shopify, Commercetools, BigCommerce

 Data Connectivity: connecting to sources like JSON, BigQuery, Supabase, MySQL, and beyond

 Data Transformations: allow customers to transform their data as it flows into Algolia

 AI Enrichment Pipelines: enhancing data to improve search relevance

jobs.title: Database Engineer
jobs.location: Cambridge, Massachusetts, United States; Palo Alto, California, United States; Singapore; Tokyo, Japan
jobs.description:
Own the data layer behind one of the biggest crawlers on the web. 

 Ahrefs helps marketers get their brands found in search, in AI answers and on social. Under the product sits one of the largest datasets on the web, and someone has to keep it fast, correct and alive. 

 The team

 The Database team owns our databases and storage end to end, from the source code to production. We run ClickHouse, MooseFS, SeaweedFS, TiDB and Elasticsearch on about 1,200 servers holding hundreds of petabytes, in data centres in Singapore, the US and the UK.

 We don’t file tickets with vendors and wait. When a system doesn’t do what we need, we change its source, prove the change on production data and roll it out ourselves.

 The job

 You’ll build and run our data layer: ClickHouse, the MooseFS and SeaweedFS storage under it, and the TiDB and Elasticsearch clusters beside it. You write the code, you ship it, and you’re there when it meets production. You’ll work with AI coding agents as a normal part of the job.

 Examples of what you’ll work on

 Build storage and query features in ClickHouse, such as replication over a shared file system, and storage policies that place data by its merge history.

 Keep up with upstream ClickHouse LTS releases, keep CI green and ship our own releases regularly.

 Make MooseFS and SeaweedFS highly available and durable: Raft-based metadata servers, follower reads, an intent log, automatic re-replication.

 Find performance problems in production profiles and fix them in the code, from query plans to FUSE clients.

 Trace data corruption to its root cause, even when it’s in compression, the memory allocator or the compiler, and repair the damaged data.

 Roll out releases and storage migrations across about 1,200 servers in three regions, without downtime.

 Run and tune TiDB, TiKV, TiCDC and Elasticsearch: scheduling, replication lag, backups, disk balance.

 Check risky designs with TLA+ and fault injection, and automate whatever repeats with watchdogs, balancers and dashboards.

 Build an SRE agent that watches our database clusters, diagnoses incidents and proposes fixes.

 You’re probably right for this if

 You write strong C++, C and Rust, can work in Go, and feel at home in codebases of millions of lines.

 You know database storage engines deeply: merges or compaction, replication logs, query execution.

 You understand distributed consensus (Raft or Paxos) and what happens when things fail.

 You know Linux storage internals: page cache, fsync, FUSE, file systems, and how NVMe and HDDs really behave.

 You’ve run databases or storage on hundreds of nodes, and led the recovery when an incident hit.

 You debug with gdb, perf and sanitizers.

 You measure a change on production data before you call it a win.

 Good to have

 Contributions to an open-source database or file system.

 OCaml. Much of our backend is written in it.

 Puppet or a similar configuration management tool.

 Why Ahrefs?

 We give smart people real ownership and don’t micromanage them. Here that means a few hundred petabytes and the source code of the systems that hold them. Small team, no layers of process, and the hardware to do the job properly. We value honesty, results and simple solutions over complicated ones.

 Ahrefs does not engage with agencies or third-party recruitment providers for the roles we hire for. If we need help, we’ll let you know.

 Location: Singapore, Tokyo, Palo Alto (CA) or Cambridge (MA). On-site; you’ll need the right to work in the office you choose.
 Ahrefs does not engage with agencies or third party recruitment solutions for the roles we hire for. If at any point we need help, we'll let you know!

We have the tooling, the data, and the leadership experience to build this function the right way — and this role is central to that effort. The person who joins will help establish the patterns, standards, and culture of Analytics Engineering here.

Analytics Engineering sits at the center of all three.

 Alloy operates in a hybrid-work environment. We look to foster collaboration and community by having our local employees onsite three days a week.

 What you'll do

 You'll manage the Data Platform team: hire for it, grow the people on it and set its direction. This is a player-coach role. Roughly half your time goes to hands-on work on the platform, and the other half to leading the team.

 Lead a team of two engineers. Set clear direction, run one-on-ones and performance reviews, give direct feedback and coach each person toward work that stretches them

 Hire as the team grows. Define the roles, run the interview loops and decide who joins

 Own the data platform end to end: ingestion and change data capture, the Snowflake warehouse, dbt and the semantic layer, and the tooling that internal and customer-facing analytics run on

 Ship native warehouse data sharing into customers' own environments, including the schema contracts customers will build on for years

 Design how sensitive customer data is handled across analytics and BI, so teams get the answers they need and customer data stays protected

 Set the team's technical standard for modeling, testing, documentation and code review, and meet it in your own code

 Work with Product, Compliance and other engineering teams to decide what data we expose, to whom and under what constraints. Make the platform good enough that teams choose it over building their own

 What we're looking for

 You want both halves of this job. You'd be unhappy in a role that took you away from building, and just as unhappy in one where nobody grew because of you.

 Deep analytics engineering and data systems experience. Strong SQL, dbt and a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake preferred), with real depth in data modeling: grain, slowly changing dimensions and what makes a model trustworthy

 Experience owning architecture from ingestion through the warehouse to delivery, including ingestion and change data capture tools (Artie or similar) and how they fail: late-arriving data, schema drift, out-of-order events

 A record of leading people. You've set direction others followed, grown someone on purpose, given feedback that was hard to give and raised a team's standard. Formal management experience is not required. We care about what you did, not the title you held

 Good judgment about sequencing. Given more good ideas than quarters, you pick what comes first and can explain why the rest wait

 Experience getting other teams to adopt something you built, or agreeing a constraint with a function that had reasons to resist, with the relationship intact afterwards

 Based in the New York City area and able to work from our Union Square office Tuesday through Thursday

 Nice-to-haves: 

 Experience with native warehouse data delivery, such as Snowflake Data Sharing or Marketplace

 Background in fintech, financial services or another regulated industry, especially handling PII in analytics

 Experience building a semantic or metrics layer and connecting it to BI tools

 Exposure to agentic or LLM-based workflows and the data infrastructure behind them

 We're a lean team, so your impact will be felt immediately, and opportunities will grow as the company scales up. If this all sounds like a good fit for you, why not join us?

Your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details and what compensation could look like for you specifically!

 Benefits and Perks 

 We invest in your health, your financial future, and your growth. Here's what you can expect:

 Medical, dental, and vision coverage from the first of the month after you join, including $0 employee-only premium options, plus FSA options and an Alloy-funded HSA with our high-deductible plan

 Hybrid work environment: most team members work from our HQ in Union Square, Manhattan, Tuesday through Thursday, with in-office expectations that vary by role. Catered lunches from a variety of local restaurants and frequent employee-organized cultural events bring energy to the office. On Mondays and Fridays, many employees work remotely, while some take advantage of the quieter office.

 How to apply

 Apply right here! You've found the application!

We are committed to an inclusive interview experience and provide reasonable accommodations to applicants with visible and invisible disabilities.  Analyze business problems and define appropriate database and data architecture patterns, including relational, dimensional, denormalized, integration, and service-oriented approaches.

 Minimum of 5 years related experience.

 Demonstrated experience leading and architecting enterprise database and data-engineering solutions from business need and conceptual design through implementation.

 Strong hands-on SQL and database engineering experience, including Oracle SQL/PL/SQL, with demonstrated ability to architect solutions across multiple relational database technologies.

 Demonstrated experience designing conceptual, logical, and physical data architectures and translating business information requirements into implementable technical solutions.

 Proficiency in database design and architecture, ERDs, data modeling, relational design, performance engineering, and complex SQL development.

 Experience architecting enterprise ETL/data-integration solutions using Informatica or comparable enterprise integration technologies.

 Demonstrated understanding of modern data architecture patterns including PostgreSQL, APIs/data services, containerization, CI/CD, metadata, lineage, and data quality.

 Experience working with modeling tools such as ERwin or comparable enterprise modeling technologies.

 Demonstrated knowledge of enterprise data governance principles, standards, and practices, including data stewardship, metadata management, data quality, lineage and traceability, authoritative data sources, information classification, and governance-driven architecture controls.

 Hands-on PostgreSQL architecture, development, or Oracle-to-PostgreSQL modernization experience.

 Experience defining API/service-oriented data-access and integration patterns.

 Experience with semantic/information modeling, authoritative-source identification, metadata management, lineage, traceability, and change-impact analysis.

 Experience establishing reusable database/data-engineering standards and architecture patterns across development teams.

 Familiarity with modern data-storage and data-platform architectures, including object storage such as MinIO, and modern relational, cloud-native, distributed, and analytical platforms such as PostgreSQL, Azure SQL, Amazon Aurora, Snowflake, Databricks, and comparable enterprise technologies, with an understanding of appropriate architectural use cases, integration patterns, and tradeoffs.

 Experience defining architecture patterns for modern .NET data access, including Entity Framework and object-relational mapping (ORM)-based approaches, and guiding the appropriate placement of data access, business logic, and transaction responsibilities across database, application, integration, and service layers.

 Exposure to version control systems and development platforms such as Azure DevOps Server/TFS, Visual Studio, and Git.

 Data Integration: Informatica and related enterprise ETL/data integration technologies

products for Agoda’s technology organization, including curated datasets, metrics,

jobs.description:
Our Mission 

 Our mission is to restore cell health and resilience through cell rejuvenation to reverse disease, injury, and the disabilities that can occur throughout life.

 For more information, see our website at altoslabs.com. 

 Our Value 

 Our Single Altos Value: Everyone Owns Achieving Our Inspiring Mission .

 Diversity at Altos 

 Altos Labs has been named one of the Top 3 Biotech Companies and ranked for the second year on the Forbes 2026 Best Startups in America list. At Altos, exceptional scientists and industry leaders from around the world work together to advance a shared mission. Our intentional focus is on Belonging, so that all employees know that they are valued for their unique perspectives. We are all accountable for sustaining a diverse and inclusive environment.

 What You Will Contribute To Altos

 As a contract Senior Knowledge Engineer, Ontology and Data Standards, you will drive how our team represents biological knowledge At Altos

 We have built the machinery: a large canonical LinkML/Biolink schema including REST/MCP/CLI service layer; specification packages covering multiple prior-knowledge sources; and an agentic / human-in-the-loop curation framework. What it lacks is a technical owner—someone to govern and administer the content.

 You are the scientific translation layer between biological discovery and AI platform engineering. You will elicit implicit models from bench and computational scientists, encode them rigorously, and utilize the agentic workflows that scale curation beyond what manual review can reach.

 This role carries explicit decision rights: review authority on canonical schema change, ownership of the curation conventions that data atlas and engineering teams follow.

 Key Responsibilities 

 Knowledge Modeling & Ontology Engineering:

 Design, maintain, and extend internal LinkML / Biolink models and ontologies covering experimental and prior-knowledge metadata—driven by competency questions from user requirements and not by source-side convenience.

 Own mapping and alignment as a discipline: cross-ontology mappings with recorded justification and provenance, and upstream term requests as appropriate.

 Serve as reviewer of record for schema change, holding the line that reuse precedes coining anything new.

 Agentic & Automated Curation:

 Administer, steer, and refine our agentic curation framework and Model Context Protocol (MCP) service layer to scale data profiling, validation, and entity mapping far beyond manual capacity.

 Standardize tool definitions (FastMCP), prompt templates, and LLM-driven workflows that extract, normalize, and validate metadata from prior-knowledge sources and experimental assets.

 Biological Data Harmonization:

 Define mapping patterns and metadata conventions for diverse experimental modalities (genomics, single-cell, screening data) to conform to the canonical schema.

 Establish standardized conventions that allow both external prior-knowledge sources and internal experimental datasets to cleanly map into the LinkML graph architecture.

 Quality, Evaluation & Provenance:

 Establish and maintain automated validation, LLM-assisted quality control, and CI/CD under a "curation as code" paradigm—extending existing drift and coverage gates into the places where semantic review is still manual.

 Measure whether the knowledge is correct, not merely reproducible: gold-standard sets, inter-curator agreement, and precision/recall on automated extraction.

 Who You Are

 Education & Experience: PhD with 5+ years, or MS with 8+ years, in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, Systems Biology, or a related life science field. This is a senior individual-contributor role with organization-wide technical authority and no direct reports.

 Biological Data Lifecycle: Direct experience turning messy, real-world exploratory datasets (genomics, single-cell, screening, imaging) into structured metadata. 

 Ontology & Semantic Web Expertise: Strong working knowledge of OBO Foundry standards, OWL, RDF, and SPARQL, with schema modeling experience in LinkML, Biolink, or BioCypher. Experience with Protégé, ROBOT, ODK, or SSSOM mapping sets is a plus.

 Python & Agentic AI Tooling: Proficient in modular Python (3.12, uv, pandas, Pydantic, pytest), and able to read and extend a substantial existing codebase rather than only scripting against it. Active hands-on experience with AI environments (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) and building agentic LLM workflows, custom MCP tools, or RAG pipelines.

 Software & Data Management: Familiarity with Git, GitHub Actions, graph/relational databases, and cloud storage (e.g., AWS S3).

 Partner with our Commercial team to understand how our customers use Antenna data to inform critical business decisions — and design and build data solutions that let them do that with zero friction

 Manage the end-to-end data product release, prioritizing tasks and project-managing cross-functional teams to ensure accurate, reliable, and on-time delivery of data to all internal and external stakeholders

 Develop and deploy strategic product improvements that maximize both data quality and business impact

 Who You Are 

 Strategic thinker with 6+ years of hands-on experience in data-focused roles

 Expert in SQL, DBT (or similar), Excel, and business intelligence tools (e.g. Looker, Redash), comfortable navigating complex ETL systems and messy data.

 Expert use of AI to streamline data workflows and elevate data product reliability — without adding QA overhead

 Proven ability to organize, analyze and vet large volumes of data with great attention to detail

 Comfortable making defensible judgment calls in gray areas: you can tell a genuine data-quality issue from a real signal in the data, use hypothesis testing to rule out sources of discrepancy, and run root-cause investigations that stop the problem from recurring

 Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; able to translate technical concepts and align Data Ops initiatives with customer-centric objectives

 Passionate about solving customer problems

 Self-starter with the ability to carry multiple initiatives, prioritize time and resources, and meet deadlines in a fast-moving environment

 Antenna’s Benefits 

 Work from anywhere during US business hours

 Mentorship from experienced executives

 Opportunity to grow and impact a rapidly growing start up 

 Travel to In-person team off-sites (visa-permitting)

jobs.description:
Who We Are: 

 Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

 Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator. 

 Our Team Members: 

 We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

 About the team & role 

 The Data Platform team builds and operates the shared infrastructure that powers how data is stored, moved, and consumed across Alpaca. Our platform supports financial transactions, customer data, API and system events, enriched datasets, and third-party sources that power critical decisions and products for internal teams and external stakeholders. We process hundreds of millions of events each day and that scale continues to grow as Alpaca serves more customers and launches new products.

 As a Senior Data Platform Engineer , you'll design, build, and operate reliable systems across Alpaca's data platform, from distributed query engines and lakehouse storage to streaming infrastructure, governance, and data serving. You'll also work closely with our AI and Data Science teams to enable agentic workflows and machine learning capabilities. As part of a small team, you'll contribute across multiple initiatives, own projects from design through production, and help shape the future of our platform.

 Our team is 100% distributed and remote.

 What you’ll do 

 Design, build, and operate core data platform infrastructure, including distributed query engines, lakehouse storage, orchestration, and streaming pipelines.

 Contribute to regional platform deployments, building scalable and repeatable infrastructure using Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code.

 Develop real-time data processing, analytics, and alerting capabilities for operational and product use cases.

 Partner with AI and Data Science teams on the platform foundations for agentic workflows, evaluations, and ML lifecycle tooling.

 Evolve our data catalog, governance, and access controls so data is discoverable and properly governed.

 Own platform reliability through observability, on-call participation, and operational improvements while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

 Must-haves 

 5+ years of experience in data infrastructure, platform engineering, or software engineering, with demonstrated end-to-end ownership of production systems.

 Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience building reliable pipelines, services, or platform tooling.

 Experience building or operating distributed data systems, such as query engines, lakehouses, or streaming platforms.

 Experience operating cloud infrastructure using Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, and deployment automation.

 Sound operational judgment, clear technical communication, and the ability to collaborate across engineering teams.

 Nice to Haves: 

 Experience with distributed query engines such as Trino, Presto, or Spark, and open table formats such as Apache Iceberg.

 Experience with streaming and real-time data infrastructure such as Kafka, Redpanda, Flink, or Debezium.

 Experience with AI and agent infrastructure, including MCP servers, retrieval systems, agent observability, or LLM evaluation.

 Experience supporting ML infrastructure using technologies such as MLflow, Vertex AI, or similar platforms.

 Experience with real-time analytics engines such as ClickHouse, Pinot, or Druid.

 Experience designing and operating infrastructure across multiple cloud regions, including workload isolation and cost-performance trade-offs.

 How We Take Care of You: 

 Competitive Salary & Stock Options 

 Health Benefits

 New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500 

 Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card 

 Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.
