Capco, a Wipro company, is a global technology and management consultancy specializing in driving digital transformation in the financial services industry. With a growing client portfolio comprising of over 100 global organizations, Capco operates at the intersection of business and technology by combining innovative thinking with unrivalled industry knowledge to deliver end-to-end data-driven solutions and fast-track digital initiatives for banking and payments, capital markets, wealth and asset management, insurance, and the energy sector. Capco’s cutting-edge ingenuity is brought to life through its Innovation Labs and award-winning Be Yourself At Work culture and diverse talent.

 Role Summary 

 We are seeking a solution-driven and governance-focused Data Architect to support the design, development, and evolution of BankX's enterprise data architecture. This role is critical in ensuring that data across the organization is well-modeled, secure, high-quality, discoverable, and optimized for analytics, AI/ML, and regulatory requirements. You will work closely with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, AI/ML Engineers, Business Stakeholders, and Data Governance teams to define architectural standards, enhance data flows, and ensure alignment with regulatory and internal policies such as PDPA.

 What You’ll Do 

 1. Enterprise Data Architecture Design

 Define and maintain logical and physical data models across domains (e.g., customer, product,
transaction, risk)

 Establish data architecture principles, naming conventions, and modelling standards aligned with
business and regulatory needs.

 Design semantic layers, data marts, and feature stores to support analytics and AI use cases.

 Collaborate with Data Scientists to ensure feature definitions are consistent, reusable, and aligned with
business logic.

 2. Platform Integration & Optimization

 Work with Data Engineers to implement scalable data pipelines using Azure Data Services, Databricks,
and Delta Lake.

 Ensure architectural alignment across batch, streaming, and real-time data flows.

 Optimize data storage, partitioning, and indexing strategies for performance and cost-efficiency.

 Support AI/ML Engineers in designing model-ready datasets and feature pipelines.

 3. Governance & Metadata Management

 Partner with Data Governance and Privacy teams to embed classification, lineage, and consent
management into the architecture.

 Ensure integration with Unity Catalog, Azure Purview, and enterprise metadata tools.

 Design architecture that supports auditability, traceability, and policy enforcement across data and AI
assets.

 4. Collaboration & Enablement

 Work with Business Owners and/or Business Analysts to translate business use cases into architectural
requirements.

 Provide guidance, templates, and standards to enable analytics and engineering teams to build on a
unified architecture.

 Promote data literacy and architectural awareness across technical and business teams.

 What We’re Looking For 

 6+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, or related roles.

 Strong expertise in data modeling, SQL, and distributed data systems.

 Hands-on experience with Azure Data Services, Databricks, Delta Lake, and Lakehouse architecture.

 Familiarity with metadata management, data governance, and privacy frameworks.

 Ability to design for scalability, security, and regulatory compliance.

 Proficient in Thai and English at intermediate level or above, sufficient for technical discussions,
meetings, and written documentation

 Experience in banking, fintech, or other regulated industries.

 Knowledge of PDPA, Responsible AI, and data classification frameworks.

 Exposure to feature store design, real-time architecture, and semantic modeling.

 Strong communication skills and ability to work in cross-functional teams.

 Passion for building trusted, well-governed, and future-ready data platforms.

 Why Join CAPCO 

 Work on engaging projects with some of the largest banks/insurance in the world, on projects that will transform the financial services industry

 Access continuous learning, training, and industry certifications

 Ongoing learning opportunities to help you acquire new skills or deepen existing expertise in our financial services offerings

 The platform is a key source of financial information, supporting measures including such as Assets under Management (AuM), Net New Money (NNM) and Return on Assets (RoA) and other KPIs. 

 You will combine technical and data expertise with Finance understanding, enabling you to interpret and validate financial outputs, identify issues and help improve the quality and capabilities of the platform.

 Work on the enhancement, upgrade, and potential re-development of a critical Finance Data Mart and its underlying data capabilities.

 Deep experience in Data and IT, with strong database knowledge and hands-on SQL skills, alongside an understanding of coding and data engineering concepts.

 If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you. This is an opportunity to make a difference and contribute to a highly successful company with a significant growth trajectory.

jobs.description:
SOBRE A CAPCO 

 A Capco é uma consultoria global de tecnologia e negócios, focada no setor de serviços financeiros e energia, somos apaixonados por ajudar nossos clientes, temos 40 escritórios nas Américas, Europa e Ásia-Pacífico! Se criatividade e inovação são sua paixão, a Capco é ideal para você. Vamos te apoiar e ajudar a acelerar sua carreira!

 Estamos buscando um Desenvolvedor de Integração experiente para projetar e implementar integrações corporativas para um programa de Modernização de Automação em larga escala no setor de Energia. A função será responsável pelo desenvolvimento dos microsserviços corporativos para realizar a conexão entre múltiplas plataformas de negócio, incluindo Portal do Cliente, CRM, Faturamento, Precificação, Previsão, Gateways de Pagamento, Utilities, Microsoft Fabric e outras plataformas SaaS. O candidato selecionado trabalhará em estreita colaboração com o Líder de Integração, Arquitetos de Soluções, Analistas de Negócios, Arquitetos de Dados e fornecedores externos para entregar integrações seguras, escaláveis, resilientes e reutilizáveis, utilizando Azure Integration Services e serviços Java Spring Boot.

 Visão Geral do Projeto: O programa de Modernização de Automação tem como objetivo modernizar o ecossistema da organização nas áreas de clientes, precificação, previsão, faturamento e analytics por meio de integrações API-first, nativas da nuvem e orientadas a eventos no Microsoft Azure.

 Principais Responsabilidades: 
• Projetar e desenvolver integrações corporativas utilizando Azure Integration Services e Java Spring Boot.
• Desenvolver APIs RESTful e microsserviços utilizando Java e Spring Boot.
• Desenvolver e configurar APIs utilizando Azure API Management (APIM).
• Implementar padrões de integração síncronos e assíncronos com base nos requisitos da solução.
• Desenvolver integrações de mensageria e orientadas a eventos utilizando Azure Service Bus, filas, tópicos, assinaturas e serviços relacionados do Azure.
• Implementar integrações entre aplicações corporativas, plataformas SaaS, bancos de dados, parceiros externos e serviços do Microsoft Azure.
• Implementar transformação, validação, roteamento e orquestração de mensagens, tratamento de exceções e mecanismos de retry.
• Desenvolver componentes e serviços de integração reutilizáveis e alinhados aos padrões corporativos de integração.
• Implementar autenticação e autorização de APIs utilizando Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2.0, JWT, Managed Identities e mecanismos de segurança relacionados.
• Proteger credenciais de aplicações, segredos, certificados e informações de conexão utilizando Azure Key Vault.
• Implementar logging, monitoramento, rastreamento distribuído, correlation IDs e telemetria operacional para serviços de integração.

Why Charlie Health? 

 Millions of people across the country are navigating mental health conditions, substance use disorders, and eating disorders, but too often, they’re met with barriers to care. From limited local options and long wait times to treatment that lacks personalization, behavioral healthcare can leave people feeling unseen and unsupported.

 Charlie Health exists to change that. Our mission is to connect the world to life-saving behavioral health treatment. We deliver personalized, virtual care rooted in connection—between clients and clinicians, care teams, loved ones, and the communities that support them. By focusing on people with complex needs, we’re expanding access to meaningful care and driving better outcomes from the comfort of home.

 As a rapidly growing organization, we're reaching more communities every day and building a team that’s redefining what behavioral health treatment can look like. If you're ready to use your skills to drive lasting change and help more people access the care they deserve, we’d love to meet you.

 About the Role 

 The Analytics & Data Engineering team owns all post-transactional data operations that turn raw data into insights. We design and operate ETL pipelines, Kafka Topics, data warehouses, transformations, agentic skills, and analytics tooling that power reporting, experimentation, and decision-making across Charlie Health. Our focus is on reliability, scalability, and making data accessible and actionable for the entire organization.

 As a Staff Data Engineer on this team, you'll be a key technical contributor and mentor across the team. You will build and own significant parts of our data infrastructure, driving pipeline reliability and warehouse quality. You'll work across a modern data stack to ensure that Charlie Health's data is timely, accurate, performant, secure, and trusted. If you're energized by the opportunity to expand access to mental healthcare and make a meaningful impact on millions of lives from the data and pipelines you support, we'd love to hear from you.

 Responsibilities 

 Build, release, and maintain high-quality ELT & streaming pipelines with a strong emphasis on correctness, observability, and performance

 Orchestrate complex data workflows using Dagster/Airflow and DBT, ensuring reliable and well-monitored execution and quality assessments

 Own meaningful areas of our data warehouse, Snowflake, designing well-modeled, performant schemas, and maintaining clear documentation of data definitions and lineage

 Resolve critical data issues independently and proactively identify and address bottlenecks before they impact downstream consumers

 Contribute to architectural decisions and technical design discussions, bringing well-reasoned, data-driven recommendations to the team

 Support analytics delivery through Hex and AI Agents, collaborating with stakeholders to ensure data is accessible, governed, and actionable

 Help the team level up by authoring documentation, sharing learnings, and contributing to a culture of craft and continuous improvement

 Participate in our on-call rotation to ensure data availability and pipeline health

 Requirements 

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience

 5+ years of experience in Data, with at least 4 years in a Data Engineering role. 7+ years of experience in Data minimum for Staff level

 Deep expertise in analytical use cases of SQL, including CTEs, window functions, aggregation patterns, and performance tuning techniques such as partitioning and clustering

 Strong proficiency in Python, including experience with common data engineering libraries

 Hands-on experience with a modern data stack

 Demonstrated ability to take ownership of loosely-defined problems, breaking them into well-scoped tasks, driving them to completion, and communicating tradeoffs clearly

 Experience working with sensitive data in a regulated environment

 You live within a 75-minute commute of our NYC office (near Union Square) and are able to work in-office 4 days per week

 Nice to Haves 

 Previous Experience in Healthcare

 Previous Experience in Airflow & Migrations

 Previous Experience with Kafka Streams

 Experience leveraging AI tools for development

 Benefits 

 Charlie Health is pleased to offer comprehensive benefits to all full-time, exempt employees. Read more about our benefits here.

 The total target base compensation for this role will be between $180,000 and $285,000 per year at the commencement of employment. At Censys, we believe in working iteratively, but we’re always thinking about the big picture.  Censys is building the most credible, robust map of the Internet through IP scanning, DNS lookups, web crawling, and the ingestion of millions of certificates. jobs.description:
About Carrot: 

 Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com .

 The Opportunity 🚀 

 Carrot is seeking a Business Intelligence Analytics Engineer to join our BI function as it scales to meet, and anticipate, the needs of the organization and its clients. This is an executional role providing essential analytics support across the company: you will gather requirements, field ad hoc and recurring data requests, and build the reporting dashboards that leaders across Carrot rely on to make decisions.

 You will work hands-on with modern data tooling, including SQL, dbt, and enterprise BI platforms, and partner with teams across the business to translate their questions into clear, trustworthy answers. The BI team is highly cross-functional and sits alongside Data Engineering, making this a strong opportunity to sharpen technical skills while building broad business context in a mission-driven environment.

 What You’ll Own 💼 

 In this role, you will:

 Design and build data models in SQL with a focus on correctness, clarity, and reusability

 Build and maintain dashboards and reports that track key business metrics and inform decision-making across the company

 Conduct ad hoc analyses to answer high-priority business questions from stakeholders across the organization

 Collaborate with teams across Carrot to understand their data domains, reporting needs, and success metrics

 Contribute to data quality, documentation, and self-service BI capabilities as the function scales

 What Success Looks Like 📈 

 In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

 Delivered accurate, well-documented dashboards and reports that stakeholders across the company trust and use regularly

 Fully ramped on Carrot's data stack and core data domains, independently owning recurring and ad hoc reporting requests

 Built strong working relationships with cross-functional partners and established yourself as a reliable analytics resource

 Improved turnaround and consistency of reporting by creating reusable data models and reducing manual work

 About You ✨ 

 You likely have:

 A Bachelor's Degree

 Intermediate-to-advanced SQL experience: ability to write advanced queries using joins, common table expressions, and window/analytic functions

 Experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Looker, DOMO, or Power BI) to bring data insights to life for broad audiences

 Basic statistics proficiency: experiment design, hypothesis testing, statistical significance, probability, and distributions

 Ability to translate business intelligence needs from a variety of stakeholders into technical execution and clear presentation

 Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical information to non-technical audiences

 Nice to Have ⭐ 

 While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

 Experience using dbt to transform, test, and document data

 Experience working with healthcare industry data or in other complex, regulated data environments

 Experience in a high-growth environment

 Familiarity with version control systems (Git preferred)

 Understanding of effective data modeling strategies and implementations

 Why This Role Matters 🧡 

 Data is central to how Carrot operates and grows. Leaders across the company depend on accurate, timely reporting to serve members, support customers, and make sound business decisions. As a Business Intelligence Analytics Engineer, you will be the connective tissue between raw data and those decisions, ensuring the organization runs on insights it can trust.

 Your work directly supports Carrot's mission of expanding access to fertility and family-building care worldwide. Better data means better decisions for the members and customers who rely on Carrot every day.

 We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

 For this role, candidates can expect:

 Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes

 Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes

 Performance Task — 60 minutes

 Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

 Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

 A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.

 A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.

 Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Data Platform
jobs.description:
Cato Networks is the converged network and security cloud for the AI era. 

 As AI reshapes cybersecurity, enterprises face a dual challenge: unlocking AI’s potential while defending against AI-driven attacks. Cato addresses both through a unified, cloud-native platform, providing the visibility and context to prioritize risks and stop threats in real time across users, applications, data, and AI agents. 

 Join us as we scale: take on ambitious technological challenges and shape the next generation of enterprise security at a company trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide. 

 We're looking for an experienced Software Engineer to join our Data Platform Group. In this key role, you will build the company’s data platform: cloud-based microservices and data pipelines that process approximately 1M records per second at low latency. Because the platform is the foundation other groups build on, your work directly impacts our customers and enables engineering, product, and research teams across the organization.
The Streaming team owns the real-time heart of the platform: every record enters the company through our pipelines, and we process it in motion. We build high-throughput Go services and Kafka-based pipelines that ingest, enrich, aggregate, and route our data in real time, at low latency. We also build external integrations that deliver our data to customers, partnering closely with Product to define and implement connectors that meet customer needs.
At this scale, efficiency is the product. We care about how many records per second each core handles and how many bytes each record costs in memory. If you enjoy profiling hot paths, pushing CPU utilization to the limit, and cutting memory footprint without giving up correctness, this is the role.

 Responsibilities

 • Take end-to-end ownership of our real-time stream processing layer: ingestion, enrichment, aggregation, and routing of high-volume data at low latency..
• Design and develop high-performance stream processing services in Go, built on Kafka/MSK..
• Build and evolve stateful stream processing pipelines, including Kafka Streams-based applications..
• Partner with Product to define, design, and implement external connectors that export and deliver our data to customers’ systems..
• Own performance and resource efficiency: profile and optimize hot paths, get the most out of every CPU core, reduce memory footprint and allocations, and lower compute costs at scale..
• Design for reliability under load, including backpressure, partitioning and consumer-group strategies, ordering, delivery guarantees, and idempotency..
• Research new technologies in stream processing and adapt them for use in our product..
• Work closely with Product, DevOps, Security, and the other teams in the Data Platform Group..

 Requirements

 • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and developing high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems in production..
• Deep, hands-on experience with Kafka at significant scale: partitioning, consumer groups, offset management, producer/consumer tuning, and throughput vs. latency trade-offs..
• Familiarity with fundamantals of Go and Java is a major advantage..
• At least basic hands-on experience using AI coding assistants or development tools to accelerate implementation, testing, and debugging, with the ability to review and validate generated code..
• Experience building and running microservices on Kubernetes, including tuning resource requests and limits, and configuring autoscaling..
• Hands-on experience with AWS, particularly MSK, EKS, and EC2..
• A motivated, independent learner and strong problem solver..
• A team player with excellent collaboration and communication skills..
• B.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience..

 As CHAOS Industries scales production of advanced defense systems, the systems and data infrastructure that support manufacturing become mission-critical. We are seeking a Data Engineering, Manufacturing to own the architecture, integration, and evolution of the systems that power manufacturing operations across the company.

 Working closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Engineering, Program Management, and Information Technology, you will lead the design and implementation of the manufacturing systems ecosystem—from operational databases and reporting infrastructure to ERP, MES, PLM, quality systems, and analytics platforms. You will establish the technical foundation that enables accurate decision-making, scalable production, and end-to-end traceability across the factory.

 This is a builder’s role: you will define how manufacturing data is captured, structured, integrated, governed, and consumed across the organization while creating scalable systems capable of supporting significant production growth.

 Responsibilities: 

 Design and build the data models, schemas, and ontologies—and the pipelines and integrations—that power manufacturing execution, quality, supply chain, inventory, and production planning, independent of any single platform.

 Integrate the manufacturing systems ecosystem—MES, ERP, PLM, quality, warehouse, and data platforms—into a coherent, queryable source of truth, and evolve that architecture as systems are added or replaced.

 Build the reporting and analytics backbone that turns operational data into a single operating picture: throughput, quality, labor, capacity, inventory, and on-time delivery.

 Own the technical vision and roadmap for manufacturing systems—defining how the data and systems layer scales to support significant production growth and future automation.

 Lead root-cause investigations into systems, data-quality, and reporting issues, and build the fixes that keep them closed.

 Ability to translate operational requirements into scalable technical solutions.

 Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.

 Active U.S. Department of Defense Secret or Top Secret security clearance.

 Data Core , a Java / Spring Boot service with gRPC and message-queue APIs.

 sqlglot , where we translate and optimize SQL across dialects.

 Implement features and fix bugs in Data Core backend integrations.

 Solid Java, or strong Python with the willingness to work in Java daily.

jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Code for America believes government can work for the people, by the people, in the new digital age, and that government at all levels can and should work well for all people. For more than a decade, we’ve worked to show that with the mindful use of technology, we can break down barriers, meet community needs, and find real solutions. 

 Our employees build and transform government and community tools and services, making them so good they inspire change. We merge the best parts of technology, nonprofit, and government to help support the people who need it most. 

 With a focus on transparency and fairness, and deep empathy for partners in government and community organizations and the people that our partners serve, we’re building a movement of motivated change agents driven by meaningful results and lasting impact. 

 At Code for America, you contribute to exciting work while learning and developing in a supportive and flexible environment. Our compensation and benefits are holistic and thoughtfully curated to represent our employees and our mission. Help us drive real generational change that lasts. 

 Code for America is looking for a talented Staff Data Engineer who will lead the technical execution of our data infrastructure behind high-impact government services. In this role you will make data reliable and usable at scale — improving how our teams collect, move, model, and analyze the data that tells us whether the services we build actually work for the people who need them most. 

 The pace of change in the policy and government landscape is accelerating at the same time that technology possibilities are shifting rapidly. Together, these shifts create new windows of opportunity to develop technical solutions that make critical public services more effective for the people who need them. Staff data engineers keep delivery moving through those moments, supporting staff and holding high delivery standards so that data are trustworthy, and reachable by the people who need it. 

 About the role: 

 Code for America’s Staff Data Engineers build and operate the infrastructure that moves data through the products we ship, between our systems and our partners’ systems, and into the analysis that drives meaningful improvements in outcomes across the tax, criminal justice, and safety net delivery areas. Staff Data Engineers lead the technical execution of data infrastructure projects and solutions while guiding their teams’ technical direction, setting a high standard for technical judgment, and enabling other data scientists and engineers through collaboration and mentorship. 

 This role will report to a Data Science Manager and is expected to travel no more than 10 % of the time. 

 Code for America is based in California and can employ those who reside full-time within the United States. This is a remote position. 

 In this position you will: 

 Data Infrastructure & Pipeline Engineering 

 Lead cross-functional technical planning with Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and Product Managers to translate data architecture requirements into scalable technical solutions for your team's projects 

 Create new data pipelines, data transfers, and compliance-oriented infrastructure to facilitate seamless data utilization within cloud environments 

 Contribute to best practices for dataset management and optimization, ensuring data consistency and performance 

 Implement data transformation, integration, and validation processes to support analytics and reporting needs 

 Partner with our DevOps team to apply deployment standards, monitoring frameworks, and operational best practices for data infrastructure 

 Lead technical investigations into data issues within the systems you own, resolving them with thorough communication and recommending process changes where necessary. 

 Optimize and fine-tune data pipelines for improved speed, reliability, and efficiency 

 Lead generation and optimization of data architecture recommendations and demonstrate the ability to implement them 

 Champion privacy, security, and data governance practices throughout the entire data lifecycle 

 Support Engineering's culture of writing by producing quality documentation and learning materials. 

 Technical Leadership & Enablement 

 Contribute to the development of data engineering best practices and standards, and reinforce them across the team. 

 Collaborate with Product Managers and other cross-functional peers; adapt your approach as priorities, technology, and team needs shift; and actively help others do the same when facing major changes in direction or tooling. 

 Mentor engineers and data scientists on data engineering best practices, pipeline design, and sound architectural thinking, and create conditions for them to grow into unfamiliar problem spaces through pairing, documentation, or direct coaching. 

 Other duties as assigned 

 Engage in ad hoc projects and initiatives as required by the organization's evolving needs. 

 About you: 

 7+ years of experience in data engineering or related technical fields 

 Expert-level SQL and experience with python, R 

 Experience with Postgres and cloud-based data warehousing (e.g. BigQuery, Snowflake) 

 Expert at data orchestration tools (e.g. Dagster) for building and managing data pipelines 

 Expert at using dbt for data transformation and modeling within data warehouses 

 Demonstrated experience with Metabase or similar business intelligence tools (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI, Looker) 

 Experience in ensuring that data pipelines are accessible to Data Scientists through notebook tools (e.g. Hex) 

 Experience with cloud infrastructure and infrastructure as code. 

 Excellent collaboration skills, with a demonstrated ability to manage cross-functional relationships, respond to stakeholder needs, and facilitate effective decision-making conversations 

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. 

 Demonstrated ability to use AI coding tools judiciously, validating and refining generated code for quality, and modeling that discipline for teammates is needed for this specific role; organizationally, a curiosity about emerging AI tools and a commitment to using them responsibly and effectively 

 A deep commitment to Code for America's mission of making government services work well for the people who need them most. 

 It’s a bonus if you have: 

 Experience with making government services better for people who need them most 

 Personal or professional experience with the social safety net or other mission-relevant government services. 

 Experience building and integrating AI-powered features in production systems, with evaluation and monitoring. 

 What you’ll get - 

 Salary: 

 Code for America’s salary bands are transparent as a part of our commitment to transparency and fairness. As part of our hiring practices, we aim to target the midpoint of the 2nd quartile of the range for all new hires. 

 Offer targets vary based on market / geographic location. The offer targets for this role range from $128,945 to $157,850 , annually. Your Recruiter will discuss compensation in more detail & answer any related questions, during the initial Recruiter phone screen. 

 Benefits and perks: 

 This role includes a comprehensive benefits package including the following: 

 Values: 

 Leadership and teammates who share a strong work ethic and values, and who respect and care for one another 

 A collaborative, cross-functional, hardworking, and joyful environment 

 Employee Enablement Support: 

 Laptop provided 

 A one-time $700 payment for remote environment setup; $200 stipend (in first paycheck) and up to $500 reimbursement, in accordance with our equipment policy 

 Cell phone and/or internet reimbursement of $50 per month 

 Professional Development: 

 $500 annual (per calendar year) stipend towards professional development; prorated at time of hire 

 Up to $500 of professional development funds can be rolled over each year, up to a maximum of $1000 

 Training / guidance for staff required to utilize AI as part of their role, plus opportunities for employees to gain AI-related skills to support job and career growth 

 Retirement & 401k Plans: 

 Employees receive a 100% employer match on the first 3% of contributions. 

 Employees with 3+ years of service receive an additional 50% match on contributions between 3% and 5%, for a maximum employer contribution of 5% 

 Medical: 

 At least one no cost health insurance option for full-time employees for employee-only coverage 

 A minimum of 80% of the cost of dependent coverage 

 Remote Work: 

 Code for America employees may work remotely across the US 

 Code for America employees main residence must be within the US 

 Full-time employees work 40 hours per week, Monday - Friday 

 Collaborative working hours: we aim to hold all internal meetings between 10 AM - 3 PM PT. We expect all Code for America staff to be available during these set working hours 

 Time Off: 

 Open personal time off ( subject to manager approval ), a minimum of 14 paid holidays, and an org-wide closure from Christmas Day through New Year's Day 

 Paid sick time; up to 96 hours annually 

 17 weeks of paid parental and family leave 

 3 weeks of paid sabbatical after 5 years of service 

 Timeline: 

 From the time you are contacted by a Recruiter, you can expect a 1-2 month, or longer, hiring process. The specific hiring process and timeline goals for this role will be covered during the initial Recruiter phone screen. Code for America's standard interview process details are also available on our careers page. 

Equal Employment Opportunity: 

 Code for America is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition or any protected category prohibited by local, state or federal laws. 

 Code for America Workers United: 

 This position is covered by a Collective Bargaining Agreement between Code for America and Code for America Workers United, affiliated with OPEIU, Local 1010. The agreement was ratified on January 14, 2026, and is currently in effect.

jobs.description:
What is Coast 

 Coast is re-imagining the trillion-dollar U.S. B2B card payments infrastructure, with a focus on the country’s 500,000 commercial fleets, 40 million commercial vehicles, and many millions of commercial drivers. The incumbent technologies that cater to these customers are decades old, and businesses with fleets increasingly demand modern digital experiences and transparent financial services products. Coast’s mission is to deliver this at a transformational scale, beginning with the Coast Fleet and Fuel Card built on a cutting-edge spend management platform.

 About the Role 

 We’re looking for a Staff Data Engineer who can not just get their hands dirty building pipelines and also act as a thought leader for the company. Data sits at the center of everything we do, and we need someone who not only understands how to make it available, but how to make it accessible to everyone in the company. In the age of AI, making good decisions is key, and having accurate data is a core part of our decision-making process.

 You won't be starting from scratch. We already run on Redshift, Dagster, and dbt, but the biggest pieces are still yours to build: a data catalog, a semantic layer, a mature security posture, and AI-ready access to our data.

 This is a chance to lead a small, high-leverage team and touch all corners of the company, not just reporting and analytics. Our data organization follows a federated model: product teams own their data products, and the data platform gives them the patterns, tools, and guardrails to do that well. Your job isn't to be the team everyone files tickets with; it's to make everyone else at Coast better at producing and using data.

 What You’ll Do 

 Own Our Data Warehouse 

 Set standards and build patterns for ingesting data

 Make sure data consumers can build models efficiently and quickly

 Build new capabilities, like data catalogs and semantic layers that make data discoverable for your coworkers across the company

 Set data security standards, including tokenization, RBAC, and row-level security

 Provide High-Quality Patterns 

 You should have opinions, we want you to be the expert on the best way to produce and consume data

 Figure out how to make data usable, whether via reverse ETL or making it available to AI agents

 Be a Teacher 

 Help our product engineering teams evolve from treating data as exhaust to building DDD-based data products

 Teach nontechnical users how to consume data using AI tools without needing to learn SQL

 Evangelize new practices and patterns that present opportunities for Coast to remain innovative and nimble

 Write Code 

 Contribute to our data pipelines in Python

 Build CI/CD pipelines for data products

 Contribute new data tests for dbt

 What Success Looks Like 

 In your first year, you’ll be successful if you:

 Provide a model for understanding our data warehouse costs

 Ship a data catalog that helps all employees know where to find good data

 Have a strategy and have made real progress on building a data security posture, including row-level security, RBAC, and tokenization

 Have a strategy and have made real progress on making our data safely accessible to AI agents

 Requirements 

 7+ years hands-on experience working across the data ecosystem, from modern ETL/ELT and orchestration to data warehouses and columnar stores, from BI tooling for less-technical business users to SQL optimization

 AI-native mindset: you’re already using AI tools in your daily work and you’re excited to push further

 Experience with data warehouses such as Redshift or Snowflake (we use Redshift), data pipeline tools (we use Dagster), dbt, and medallion architecture

 Proficiency in Python

 Experience leading a horizontal Data Engineering team, working with analytics and product engineering teams

 Mentorship experience, both of data engineers and members of other teams who have to touch data products

 Excellent written and verbal communication

 Bias toward action and process-building; you don’t wait for someone to hand you a playbook

 Comfortable in ambiguity; you can build structure where none exists without losing momentum

 New York City based; able to be in-office 3–4 days per week

 Compensation and Benefits 

 Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of our total compensation package that also includes benefits and equity. Pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including scope and qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to other Coast employees. We expect the majority of candidates who are offered roles at Coast to fall healthily within the range based on these factors.

 Salary range : $170,000 – $220,000 annually

 Equity Grant : Meaningful potential upside given Coast’s early-stage trajectory

 Benefits Overview :

 Medical, dental and vision insurance

 Flexible paid time off (vacation, personal well being, paid holidays)

 Tools to help manage your financial wellness, including webinars, access to an equity tax advisory service, and company-sponsored 401(k)

 Paid parental leave

 $400 accessories allowance (a keyboard, mouse, headphones, etc.)

 Education stipend

 Free lunch every Friday

 Coast is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We are building a diverse and inclusive environment, so we encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, disability, national origin, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

 Check out the latest podcast interview on Fintech One on One with Coast Founder Daniel Simon !

 Clear Street’s mission is to give every sophisticated investor access to every asset, in every market, through a unified platform built for speed, transparency and scale.

We give our clients the technology, tools, and service once reserved for the largest institutions, rebuilt with modern infrastructure. Our single, cloud-native, end-to-end capital markets platform powers investor growth today and is transforming how they can interact with markets tomorrow.

 For more information, visit https://clearstreet.io .

 The Team:

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description 

 Clear Street is modernizing the brokerage ecosystem. Founded in 2018, Clear Street is a diversified financial services firm replacing the legacy infrastructure used across capital markets.

 We started from scratch by building a completely cloud-native clearing and custody system designed for today's complex, global market. Our platform is fully integrated with central clearing houses and exchanges to support billions in trading volume per day. We've agonized about our data model abstractions, created horizontal scalability, and crafted thoughtful APIs. All so we can provide a best-in-class experience for our clients.

 By combining highly-skilled product and engineering talent with seasoned finance professionals, we're building the essentials to compete in today's fast-paced markets.

 The Team: 

 The mission of the Clear Street Active team is to provide best execution for every asset class in every market. Active is building a new, state-of-the-art, cloud-based trading platform giving high-performance traders access to liquidity venues across multiple asset classes, cutting-edge charting, and sophisticated order handling.

 The Active Data team owns how the business understands itself, and increasingly how it decides what to do next. Data flows into our warehouse from ad platforms, product analytics, CRM and support systems, and the brokerage's own systems. It flows back out to the platforms that message our customers, bid for new ones, and manage relationships with them. Every hop is a place where data can be duplicated, delayed, or quietly redefined, and an error that leaves the warehouse does not stay a reporting problem. It spends ad budget on the wrong people, sends a customer the wrong message, or misstates a regulated number. Moving data is table stakes. Keeping it true as it travels is the problem this role owns. It is a small team with a wide surface area, and we are scaling it as the platform grows toward tens of thousands of accounts.

 The Role: 

 Three areas of the business depend on this role, and you will own the data for all of them:

 Growth. Bring in spend, clicks, and conversions from every paid, affiliate, and organic channel, reconcile them against our own records, and send funded-account outcomes back to the ad platforms, so bidding optimizes for customers who actually fund and trade.

 Lifecycle and the user journey. Resolve each customer's identity from a first anonymous visit through sign-up, KYC, funding, and first trade, and keep lifecycle messaging, CRM, and support systems in step with what actually happened.

 Brokerage data. Model account opening, KYC, funding and transfers, and trading from the platform's own systems, with the precision a regulated broker-dealer needs.

 Across all three, you will:

 Own data integrity in both directions. Prove that every feed arrived complete and on time, and that every outbound sync landed what it should. A duplicated conversion inflates ad spend, a stale attribute sends the wrong message, and a broken join misstates funded accounts to leadership.

 Own the warehouse layers in dbt: raw landing, staged and identity-resolved models, and the curated models that analysts, data scientists, dashboards, and internal AI agents read from. Every model has a declared grain and tests.

 Establish data contracts with product engineering and with the owners of the platforms we depend on, so an upstream change is caught at the boundary instead of silently nulling a field three models downstream. You will define these rather than inherit them.

 Own governance: role-based access, PII masking, retention, and auditability, including self-serve tools that do not become a way around permissions.

 Choose deliberately between batch, change-data-capture, and streaming, based on what each consumer actually needs.

 Partner with Marketing, Product, and Operations to get the events and fields the business needs captured. This role is measured on whether the business's numbers are right and on time, not on pipelines delivered.

 What We Value: 

 Engineers measured on whether the numbers are right, not on what was shipped

 Very high agency. Much of the work here begins before the requirement is clear: the source has no documentation, the field you need was never captured, and the team that owns it is busy shipping. We need someone who chases a dependency into another team and ships something reliable without a spec.

 Skepticism about data, including your own pipelines. Check grain, joins, and completeness before you trust a number.

 A preference for boring, observable systems over clever ones

 Clear communication with non-engineers: able to explain to a marketer why yesterday's number moved, and to negotiate a schema change with a product team the same afternoon

 Pragmatism: ship the version that works now, and improve it deliberately rather than waiting for the ideal one

 Requirements: 

 Minimum five years in data engineering or analytics engineering, with production pipelines you were on the hook for when they broke

 Deep proficiency in SQL and Python, and production experience with dbt in a layered warehouse: raw, staged, and curated models with a declared grain, tests, and incremental builds

 Hands-on experience bringing in third-party and application data through managed connectors, event pipelines, and change-data-capture, and handling what goes wrong with each: schema drift, resyncs, duplicates, and late or missing records

 Experience sending data back out, through reverse ETL, audiences, or conversion feeds, and owning its correctness after it leaves the warehouse

 Data quality in practice: reconciliation against systems of record, freshness and volume monitoring, and the fix that stops an incident from recurring

 Data governance in practice: role-based access, PII masking, retention, and an audit trail you could show a regulator

 Familiarity with fintech or brokerage data: account opening and KYC, funding and transfers, trades and settlement, and why superficially similar balance or status fields are not interchangeable

 Self-starter who operates well without a large team to escalate into

 Nice To Haves: 

 Identity resolution across web, app, and account data: anonymous visitors, multiple devices, and more than one account per person

 Marketing data: ad-platform APIs, conversion APIs, click IDs, and attribution

 Lifecycle and CRM tooling, where the pipeline ends in a campaign rather than a table

 Semantic layers for BI tools and AI agents

 Workflow orchestration (Argo Workflows, Airflow, or similar), and enough Kubernetes to debug your own jobs

 Data retention and audit requirements in a regulated environment (SEC, FINRA)

 Experience being an early data engineering hire on a team that scaled

 Scope: This role owns the data: pipelines into and out of the warehouse, the models in it, and who can see what. The trading systems, the core clearing ledger, and company infrastructure (cloud, Kubernetes, networking) are owned by engineering and infrastructure teams, and you will work closely with them.

 Active Data Stack: Snowflake, dbt, SQL, Python, Fivetran, Segment, Argo Workflows, Datadog

 We Offer: 

 The opportunity to join a small and growing team of good people, where you can make a difference.

 A new, high-quality code base with little technical debt and room to build new services and features.

 A meritocratic philosophy that champions collaboration.

 Competitive compensation, benefits, and perks.

 At Clear Street, we offer competitive compensation packages, company equity, 401k matching, gender neutral parental leave, and full medical, dental and vision insurance. In-office benefits include lunch stipends, fully stocked kitchens, happy hours, a great location, and amazing views.

 The Base Salary Range for this role is $150,000 - $250,000.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
About Clutch 

 Clutch is Canada’s largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car buying and selling experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse hundreds of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee… and that’s just the beginning.

 Named one of Canada's top growing Companies two years in a row and also awarded a spot on LinkedIn's Top Canadian Startups list, we're looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

 Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including Canaan, BrandProject, Real Ventures, D1 Capital, and Upper90. To learn more, visit clutch.ca

 About the role 

 At Clutch, we believe advances in AI are fundamentally changing how great products are built. Traditional handoffs between product, design, and engineering are giving way to smaller, faster teams where builders can take ideas from concept to production in days instead of months.

 As a Senior Data Engineer, you'll own the data platform that powers decision-making across Clutch, from how we buy and price vehicles, to how customers move through our funnel, to how we deliver and finance cars. The pipelines, models, and infrastructure you build will be the foundation our analysts and data scientists rely on every day, including for our fast-growing financial services work.

 Our data engineers don't just move data, they own outcomes. That means working directly with stakeholders to understand what they need, designing systems that scale with the business, and making sure the data behind every important decision is reliable, well-modeled, and easy to use. If you see a broken pipeline or a question the data can't answer yet and feel compelled to fix it, you'll thrive at Clutch.

 Technology at Clutch 

 We believe great engineers can learn great technology.

 Our data team builds with technologies like Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, Python, and AWS, alongside an application stack of TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Express. We're far more interested in exceptional engineers than perfect technology matches. If you've built outstanding data platforms in another modern stack and are excited to learn, improve, and help evolve ours, we'd love to talk.

 What you'll do 

 Own Clutch's data platform end-to-end, designing and evolving the architecture behind our warehouse, pipelines, and data models with long-term scalability in mind.

 Build reliable, well-tested ELT pipelines that bring together data from our applications, operational systems, and third-party tools.

 Design data models in partnership with analysts and data scientists so that trusted, well-structured data is easy to find and use across the business.

 Build the data foundations for our financial services work, partnering closely with the data scientist focused on that area to support modeling, experimentation, and analytics.

 Own data quality and observability, with monitoring, testing, and alerting that catch issues before stakeholders do.

 Apply strong DevOps practices to data, including version control, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and automated deployments.

 Use AI as part of your everyday engineering workflow to prototype, accelerate development, and improve code quality.

 Make thoughtful technical decisions that balance speed, cost, quality, and maintainability, and continuously evaluate new tools that help the team move faster.

 Establish data standards, documentation, and governance practices as our platform matures.

 Mentor others and raise the bar for data engineering across the team through design discussions and code reviews.

 What we're looking for 

 5+ years of experience in data engineering or a closely related field.

 Have built and operated production data pipelines and platforms that people rely on.

 Advanced SQL and strong programming skills in Python (TypeScript is a plus).

 Hands-on experience with a modern cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift.

 Experience with transformation and orchestration tools such as dbt and Airflow.

 Experience with cloud platforms, ideally AWS, and their data services.

 Strong data modeling skills, including designing for analytics use cases.

 Experience with DevOps and observability tooling such as Git, GitHub Actions, Docker, Terraform, and Datadog.

 Use AI as a force multiplier to explore ideas, prototype solutions, and accelerate development.

 Enjoy working directly with stakeholders to understand problems and deliver business value.

 Communicate clearly and are comfortable making decisions in ambiguous environments.

 Care as much about business outcomes as technical excellence.

 Nice to Have 

 Experience with streaming or event-driven data (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis).

 Experience supporting data science or ML workflows in production.

 Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, automotive, or fintech.

 Why you'll love it at Clutch 

 Autonomy & ownership: create your own path and own your work

 Competitive compensation and equity incentives

 Generous time off program

 Health & dental benefits

 Employment Type 

 New, Permanent Full-Time

 Hybrid, Downtown Toronto three days a week

 Compensation & Benefits 

 Salary: $160,000 - 200,000

 Equity incentives

 Comprehensive healthcare, dental, vision, prescriptions, life insurance, and dependent coverage

 Pay reflects skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities, and working conditions

 Clutch is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all individuals have an opportunity to succeed. If you require accommodation at any stage of the interview process, please email talent@clutch.ca

jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

 Staff Data Engineer 

 We are looking for a Staff Data Engineer to be the technical backbone of our Data organization. You will be part of the team owning the architecture of our data platform and making sure our data is ready for the AI era. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role: you will spend most of your time designing and building, not managing people.

 You will: 

 Own the technical vision and architecture of Clara's data platform, from ingestion and storage to modeling, serving and consumption

 Design and build scalable, reliable, cost-efficient data pipelines (batch and streaming) that support analytics, machine learning and operational use cases

 Lead our AI enablement efforts: structure, document and expose data (semantic layers, curated datasets, metadata, feature stores, retrieval-ready data) so that people, models and AI agents across the company can use it safely and effectively

 Define and drive best practices in data modeling, testing, observability, CI/CD, lineage and data quality

 Partner with the Director of Data to translate business and strategic goals into technical roadmaps, and to evaluate build-vs-buy decisions

 Implement the technical foundations of our data governance strategy: access control, PII handling, auditability and compliance, which matter in a regulated fintech environment

 Advance our self-service data platform so analysts, data scientists and business teams can work autonomously

 Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, Risk, Growth, Marketing and Operations to ensure data is captured correctly at the source

 Raise the technical bar of the team through code reviews, design reviews, mentoring and technical documentation, without formal people-management responsibilities

 Stretch and adapt to a dynamic and fast-paced work environment

 Requirements 

 10+ years of experience in data engineering or software engineering with a data focus, including significant experience building and scaling data platforms at a top-tier tech company (fintech/startup experience is a plus)

 Proven track record designing and operating production-grade data architectures (lakehouse/warehouse, ELT/ETL, orchestration, streaming) at scale

 Deep proficiency in SQL and Python; experience with distributed processing frameworks (e.g. Spark) and orchestration tools (e.g. Airflow, Dagster)

 Experience building tooling for AI agents or LLM applications on top of enterprise data (text-to-SQL, MCP, RAG pipelines)

 Hands-on experience preparing data for ML and AI use cases (feature engineering, vector stores/embeddings, semantic layers, LLM-ready data) or a clear track record of moving quickly into this space

 Strong experience with cloud data platforms and infrastructure (AWS, GCP or Azure), plus infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD practices

 Strong command of data modeling, data quality, observability and governance best practices

 Experience with modern data stack tools (e.g. dbt, Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Kafka)

 Ability to make sound architectural trade-offs (scalability, cost, reliability, speed of delivery) and communicate them clearly to technical and non-technical audiences

 Strong interpersonal and communication skills; comfortable influencing without authority and working closely with a Director-level leader

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, or another relevant quantitative discipline (or equivalent practical experience)

 Nice to have: 

 Experience in payments, credit, cards or other regulated financial services

 Experience with data catalogs, metadata management and data contracts

 Open-source contributions or technical writing/speaking

 Where we work 

 This is a hybrid role: you'll split your time between the office, customers and home. We don't set a minimum number of office days for most roles — you'll spend time in the office naturally, and most days during your ramp-up or when your leader asks.
 Why Clara

 A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

 Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

 An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.

 English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.

 How we work

 Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters.

 Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be.

 Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait.

 Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver.

 ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.

 Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

 If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.

jobs.title: Senior Database Reliability Engineer - DBRE
jobs.description:
What Cognite is Relentless to Achieve 

 Cognite operates at the forefront of industrial digitalization, building AI and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. Our Moonshot is bold: unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works.

 About the Role 

 We are looking for a Senior Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) to join our Cloud deployment team and take ownership of the reliability, scalability, automation, and operational excellence of our core database infrastructure.

 You will work across PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Kafka , supporting a multi-cloud, Kubernetes-based platform at significant scale. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex infrastructure and database challenges, eliminating operational toil, and building highly automated systems.

 You will partner closely with Software Engineering, SRE, Platform Engineering, and Product teams to ensure our data platforms are highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient.

 What You’ll Own 

 Managed PostgreSQL Fleet Orchestration 

 Standardize and automate the lifecycle management of a fleet of 1000+ PostgreSQL instances across Azure, AWS, and GCP.

 Build and maintain infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation frameworks.

 Automate provisioning, configuration, patching, upgrades, backups, and operational workflows.

 Improve consistency and reliability across our PostgreSQL fleet while reducing manual operational effort.

 Work with cloud-managed PostgreSQL services including Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server, Amazon RDS, and GCP Cloud SQL .

 Evolve our provisioning and configuration approach using Kubernetes-based and Terraform-driven workflows.

 Hybrid Elasticsearch Operations 

 Design, operate, and scale high-performance Elasticsearch clusters across Elastic Cloud (SaaS) and ECK (self-managed Kubernetes) environments.

 Own the reliability and performance of Elasticsearch infrastructure supporting search, semantic retrieval, vector workloads, and high-volume operational data.

 Establish best practices around cluster sizing, capacity planning, shard management, upgrades, backups, monitoring, and disaster recovery.

 Support Elasticsearch deployments where PostgreSQL is the source of truth as well as environments where Elasticsearch is the authoritative datastore .

 Build automation to simplify provisioning and lifecycle management across Elastic Cloud and ECK.

 Help improve security, connectivity, zone awareness, and operational resilience across multi-cloud deployments.

 Kafka Streaming Infrastructure 

 Own the reliability, scalability, and performance of Kafka clusters supporting high-throughput, low-latency event streaming across the platform.

 Operate Kafka in both self-managed (Kubernetes-based, e.g. Strimzi/Kafka Operator) and managed (e.g. Confluent Cloud, MSK) configurations across multi-cloud environments.

 Drive capacity planning, partition and topic design, replication strategy, and broker-level performance tuning.

 Establish and automate best practices around upgrades, rolling restarts, backups/disaster recovery, and schema evolution (e.g. Schema Registry).

 Build monitoring and alerting for consumer lag, broker health, ISR status, and throughput to enable early incident detection.

 Partner with Software Engineering to ensure producer/consumer patterns, retention policies, and topic ownership scale cleanly as usage grows.

 What You Bring 

 6+ years of experience in Database Reliability Engineering, Database Engineering, SRE, Platform Engineering, or a closely related role.

 Strong hands-on experience operating PostgreSQL at scale , preferably in cloud-managed environments.

 Strong experience with Elasticsearch , including cluster administration, performance tuning, scaling, shard management, and troubleshooting.

 Experience operating databases and stateful workloads on Kubernetes .

 Experience with Kafka or another distributed database/storage system is highly valuable.

 Strong Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform or similar tools.

 Experience with at least one major cloud platform — Azure, AWS, or GCP — with exposure to multi-cloud environments preferred.

 Strong understanding of database reliability principles including high availability, disaster recovery, backups, replication, capacity planning, and observability.

 Proficiency in scripting or programming using Python, Go, or a similar language .

 Experience automating repetitive operational tasks and building self-service infrastructure.

 Strong troubleshooting and incident-management skills, with the ability to diagnose complex distributed-system failures.

 Good to Have 

 Experience with Kafka and fdb-kubernetes-operator .

 Experience with Elastic Cloud and ECK .

 Proficiency in Go for building automation, tooling, or operators; Python or another scripting language is a plus. 

 Experience managing PostgreSQL through Kubernetes operators or custom resources.

 Experience with Kubernetes operators and building automation for stateful workloads.

 Experience operating databases across multi-cloud and private-cloud environments .

 Experience with observability platforms and database performance monitoring.

 Familiarity with distributed systems, data replication, consistency, and failure-domain design.

 What Success Looks Like 

 Database provisioning and lifecycle operations become highly automated and repeatable.

 Operational toil across PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Kafka is significantly reduced.

 Database platforms can scale reliably with business and customer growth.

 Incidents are detected early and resolved through strong automation and observability.

 Database infrastructure is consistent and resilient across Azure, AWS, GCP, and private-cloud environments.

 Engineering teams can consume reliable database infrastructure without requiring significant manual DBRE intervention.

jobs.description:
Recruitment Fraud Alert 

 We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number. 

 What to know: 

 Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.

 We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.

 Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

 If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com 

 About Commvault 

 Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) delivers continuous recovery for the AI era. We help organizations stay ready for constant disruption by returning critical data, applications, identities, and AI systems to a clean, trusted state. Our purpose-built recovery solutions span cloud-native and hybrid environments, leveraging AI to enable resilience at enterprise scale.

 The Opportunity: 

 The Principal AI & Semantic Engineer is the senior technical authority responsible for connecting governed enterprise data and business meaning with scalable analytics and artificial intelligence solutions. This role defines the architecture, standards, and engineering patterns for semantic models, governed metrics, AI-ready data products, machine learning operations, and generative AI consumption.

 Operating at the intersection of Analytics, Data Engineering, Data Science, Governance, and AI Platform Engineering, this role ensures that enterprise data, metrics, models, and knowledge assets can be reliably discovered, understood, deployed, monitored, and reused. The Principal AI & Semantic Engineer provides hands-on technical leadership, guides complex implementations, and mentors engineers and analysts while remaining an individual contributor.

 What you’ll do… 

 Semantic Architecture & Governed Metrics 

 Define enterprise standards and reference patterns for semantic models, dimensional models, business metrics, KPIs, hierarchies, calculations, and reusable analytical assets.

 Architect semantic consumption patterns across Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Databricks Gold-layer data, and approved AI applications.

 Partner with business domain owners, analysts, and Data Governance to translate business concepts into consistent, governed definitions and analytical models.

 Lead design reviews for semantic models and analytical data products, balancing usability, reuse, performance, security, and maintainability.

 Ensure semantic assets are documented with appropriate metadata, lineage, ownership, and change controls.

 AI Engineering & MLOps 

 Define engineering standards for deploying, versioning, testing, monitoring, and governing machine learning and generative AI solutions.

 Architect reusable MLand LLM patterns, including CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, evaluation, observability, rollback, and production support.

 Guide implementation of feature pipelines, model registries, inference workflows, retrieval pipelines, vectorized knowledge assets, and AI evaluation frameworks.

 Partner with Data Scientists and AI product teams to move prototypes into secure, scalable, and supportable production services.

 Implement technical controls for traceability, reproducibility, model performance, data drift, responsible AI requirements, and operational reliability.

 AI-Ready Data & Knowledge Enablement 

 Design curated, governed data products and knowledge assets for predictive analytics, generative AI, copilots, agents, and retrieval-augmented generation.

 Define how structured data, enterprise metrics, metadata, documents, embeddings, and retrieval indexes are linked and consumed.

 Ensure AI applications use approved business definitions, metrics, access policies, and authoritative data sources.

 Collaborate with Architecture and Governance teams on ontology, glossary, metadata, lineage, classification, and policy integration.

 Technical Leadership & Collaboration 

 Serve as the technical escalation point for complex semantic, analytics, MLOps, and AI engineering decisions.

 Create reference implementations, reusable frameworks, coding standards, and engineering playbooks.

 Mentor Senior Analytics & AI Engineers, Semantic Engineers, Data Analysts, and Data Scientists.

 Influence cross-functional roadmaps and communicate architecture decisions, trade-offs, risks, and business outcomes to technical and executive audiences.

 Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend pragmatic adoption paths aligned with enterprise architecture and governance standards.

 Who you are? 

 10+ years of experience across analytics engineering, business intelligence, semantic modeling, data engineering, machine learning engineering, MLOps, or related disciplines.

 Demonstrated experience serving as a principal-level technical leader or architect for enterprise data, analytics, or AI solutions.

 Deep expertise in SQL, dimensional modeling, semantic model design, analytical performance optimization, and governed metric implementation.

 Hands-on experience with Microsoft Power BI and/or Microsoft Fabric semantic models, including DAX and enterprise-scale model design.

 Hands-on experience with Databricks or a comparable cloud data and AI platform, including production data pipelines and model lifecycle capabilities.

 Experience designing or operating CI/CD, experiment tracking, model registries, monitoring, evaluation, and observability for ML or generative AI solutions.

 Working knowledge of generative AI patterns such as embeddings, vector retrieval, RAG, prompt and model evaluation, and agent-based solutions.

 Strong understanding of metadata, lineage, data quality, access control, business glossary, and responsible AI principles.

 Proven ability to mentor technical professionals, lead architecture reviews, and influence stakeholders without direct authority.

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent practical experience will be considered.

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Experience with Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog, MLflow, Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, and cloud observability tooling.

 Experience supporting enterprise Finance, GTM, Product, Customer, or Workforce analytics domains.

 Experience establishing reusable semantic or AI platform capabilities in a federated operating model.

 #LI-VK

We are always committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status and we will not discriminate against on the basis of such characteristics or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we work.

 Commvault’s goal is to make interviewing inclusive and accessible to all candidates and employees. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to participate in the interview process or apply for a position at Commvault, please email accommodations@commvault.com For any inquiries not related to an accommodation please reach out to wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com .
