Join our dynamic and high-impact Data Engineering team, where you'll be responsible for our large-scale data collection, storage, access and query platforms. The work includes the safe and reliable operation of the platform, as well as projects to evolve and expand the capabilities. This is a critical role in the organisation as the data platform drives a huge range of trader analysis, simulation, reporting and insights. 

 You will join a growing team of four in Sydney which is part of the larger APAC Data Team, and will collaborate with counterparts in Chicago, Mumbai and Amsterdam.

 Your Core Responsibilities: 

 Manage and monitor distributed systems, storage infrastructure, and data processing platforms, including Kafka, HDFS, Dremio, and in-house data pipelines.

 Drive heavy focus on systems automation and CI/CD to enable rapid deployment of hardware and software solutions.

 Collaborate closely with systems and network engineers, traders, and developers to support and troubleshoot their queries.

 Stay up to date with the latest technology trends in the industry; propose, evaluate, and implement innovative solutions.

 Your Skills and Experience: 

 2+ years of experience in managing large-scale multi-petabyte data infrastructure in a similar role.

 Knowledge of Linux system administration and internals, with proven ability to troubleshoot issues in Linux environments.

 Experience in at least one of the following technologies: Kafka, HDFS, Kubernetes.

 Working knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm.

 Experience with data access technologies such as Dremio and Presto.

 Familiarity with workflow orchestration tools like Airflow and Prefect.

 Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

 About Us 

 IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.

evidence: 2+ years of experience in managing large-scale multi-petabyte data infrastructure in a similar role.

jobs.title: Trading Data Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At IMC, technology is not a department; it’s at the heart of everything we do. Developed in house, our innovative software makes millions of trading decisions daily, and we win by making better and faster decisions than our competition.

 IMC’s Amsterdam-based Global VMM Data team works on a centralised global data platform to serve high-quality curated data for Valuation Market Making (VMM) research and strategies all throughout IMC. We address the ever changing data requirements and our team tries to solve this in a young project building a central system to ingest, curate and expose data to our research tooling within IMC.

 Your Core Responsibilities: 

 As a Trading Data Software Engineer, you'll work on enabling high-quality research using fundamental option pricing data. Next to that you will increase researchers' focus by centralising the curation of the data and enable quick onboarding of new data sets, to allow for researching new types of strategies that are going to play a vital role in the strategies of IMC now and in the future. Advanced automated testing and daily deployments will allow you to achieve agile and incremental benefits. Within the complex landscape of IMC and its systems and technologies, you’ll be constantly challenged to consider trade-offs between latency, throughput, simplicity, scalability and maintainability. Your core tasks will include:

 Coding, developing, testing, deploying and maintaining applications and automations for data curators, other VMM developers and Traders/researchers to support them and understand their actual needs and the data we serve them.

 Working on a young project and being involved of the architectural design of our system.

 Building a system that is highly-performant at serving petabytes of data globally.

 Your Skills and Experience: 

 At least > 4 years of experience as a Software Engineer 

 Strong programming skills in Java (11+), but experience in the latest versions of Java is highly desirable

 Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes and Linux

 Strong programming skills with Python, especially around data - highly preferred

 Experience working in data analysis and building out data platforms and data - highly preferred

 The ability able to work under minimal supervision and to take full ownership of the applications you build

 Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills; ability to solve problems creatively and proactively

 Prior knowledge of trading / capital markets is not required. Curiosity and a willingness to learn is.

 Our tech stack includes an ever-evolving range of systems and technologies, and our engineers have the freedom to choose the best solution for the problem at hand. If a new technology has the potential to add value, we’ll actively invest in exploring, adopting and developing it.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Data
jobs.location: McLean, Virginia; Mountain View, California, United States
jobs.description:
Company Overview 

 IDMe is the next-generation digital identity wallet that simplifies how individuals securely prove their identity online. Consumers can verify their identity with IDMe once and seamlessly login across websites without having to create a new login and verify their identity again. Over 175 million users experience streamlined login and identity verification with IDMe at 22 federal agencies, 50 state government agencies, and more than 100 healthcare organizations. Over 600 consumer brands use IDMe to verify communities and user segments to honor service and build more authentic relationships. IDMe’s technology meets the federal standards for consumer authentication set by the Commerce Department and is approved as a NIST 800-63-3 IAL2 / AAL2 credential service provider by the Kantara Initiative. IDMe is committed to “No Identity Left Behind” to enable all people to have a secure digital identity. To learn more, visit https://network.id.me/ .

 IDMe is a full-time, in-office culture. Unless a specific job description explicitly states otherwise, all roles are on-site five days per week at one of our offices in McLean, VA; Mountain View, CA; New York City, NY; or Tampa, FL. Certain roles — such as field-based sales or other remote-by-design positions — may have different work arrangements as noted in their individual postings. 

 At IDMe, we embrace the thoughtful use of AI tools in our daily work and there are even occasions where we leverage AI in our hiring process. However, during the interview process, we want to understand your individual skills and experiences. Therefore, we have guidelines on how AI can be appropriately used during your application and interviews which can be found here . 

 Role Overview

 We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer (SDE6), Data to join our Core Platform Engineering organization and spearhead the architectural evolution of IDMe’s data ecosystem. As IDMe scales as an API-first platform company, we need a high-agency technical leader who can immediately step in, rapidly synthesize our current landscape—across business objectives, technical realities, and system architecture—and define and drive a pragmatic, multi-phase evolution plan for our data platform and data architecture.

 In this pivotal role, you will serve as the primary technical strategist and hands-on architectural driver for the Data side of IDMe’s platform transformation. You will assess existing relational, event-driven, and graph-based data systems, identify critical bottlenecks and strategic opportunities, and chart a clear path from our current state to a resilient, scalable, cloud-native target architecture. Rather than operating in an ivory tower, you will lead from the front—partnering closely with executive leadership, product, security, compliance, and application engineering teams to align technical execution with high-priority business outcomes across identity verification, fraud prevention, analytics, and AI/ML enablement.

 This role is based out of our Mountain View, CA or McLean, VA office and requires full-time in-office attendance .

 Responsibilities

 Assess & Synthesize Current State: Rapidly build a deep understanding of IDMe’s existing data landscape, technical debt, operational bottlenecks, and business priorities across relational databases (PostgreSQL/AlloyDB/CloudSQL), graph systems, event streaming, and core data APIs.

 Define & Drive the Data Evolution Plan: Author and own the end-to-end architectural roadmap for IDMe’s data ecosystem—defining clear, incremental milestones that safely evolve legacy patterns into modern, scalable, API-first and event-driven data architectures while continuously delivering business value.

 Architect Foundational Data Systems: Lead the technical design and implementation of core data platform capabilities, including foundational data APIs, event-driven architectures (Pub/Sub, streaming pipelines), graph data models, encryption/data protection services, and automated data lifecycle/retention systems.

 Bridge Business Objectives & Technical Strategy: Partner directly with executive leadership, product management, and domain architects (such as Authentication and Identity) to translate strategic business goals and regulatory mandates into cohesive, future-proof data architectures and data contracts.

 Establish Data Modeling & Governance Guardrails: Define organization-wide standards, paved paths, and self-service tooling for logical and physical data modeling (across relational and graph systems), schema hygiene, metadata management, data lineage, and access patterns.

 Embed Security, Privacy & Compliance by Design: Partner with Security and Compliance teams to ensure data storage, encryption, retention, and access architectures rigorously satisfy regulatory standards (e.g., FedRAMP, NIST 800-63, GDPR) with built-in auditability.

 Hands-On Technical Leadership: Dive into critical codebases, build foundational prototypes, lead architectural reviews, and work side-by-side with engineering teams to unblock complex migrations, optimize database and query performance at scale, and resolve high-severity architectural challenges.

 Influence & Elevate Engineering Culture: Mentor Staff and Senior engineers across the organization, evangelize modern data ownership and stewardship practices, and align cross-functional teams around a unified data vision.

 Basic Qualifications

 Bachelor’s or Graduate degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

 10+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering, distributed systems, and data architecture at a large-scale SaaS, fintech, identity, or platform company.

 Demonstrated track record of stepping into complex, brownfield engineering environments, rapidly diagnosing architectural and business challenges, and defining and executing multi-quarter technical transformation roadmaps.

 Deep expertise in designing, building, and evolving large-scale data architectures spanning relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL), distributed event-driven systems, and graph or NoSQL data stores.

 Strong proficiency in one or more modern backend programming languages (e.g., Go, Java, Python, Ruby, or Rust) and advanced SQL.

 Preferred Qualifications

 Proven ability to act as a force multiplier across an engineering organization—driving alignment among executives, product leaders, and engineers to turn ambiguous, company-wide problems into actionable execution plans.

 Hands-on experience leading large-scale data migrations, decomposing monolithic databases, and establishing API-first data boundaries and data contracts without disrupting mission-critical production traffic.

 Deep expertise with both relational database internals/scaling (e.g., PostgreSQL, AlloyDB, CloudSQL) and graph database architectures (e.g., Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, or similar) for relationship-driven identity and fraud use cases.

 Experience architecting event-driven data platforms and real-time streaming pipelines (e.g., Google Pub/Sub, Kafka, Dataflow, Temporal) on major cloud providers (GCP or AWS).

 Experience designing automated data governance, data retention, and privacy/encryption frameworks in highly regulated environments (e.g., FedRAMP, NIST, SOC2, GDPR).

 Fluency with AI-assisted engineering workflows and experience designing data architectures that power AI/ML and analytical platforms.

 Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a natural ability to distill complex architectural trade-offs into clear strategic narratives for both technical and executive audiences.

 The annual base salary listed does not include a company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity and benefits which will be determined based on experience, skills, education, relevant training, geographic location and role. 

 IDMe offers comprehensive medical, dental, vision, health savings account, flexible spending accounts (medical, limited purpose, dependent care, commuter benefit accounts), basic and voluntary life and AD&D insurance, 401(k) with company match, parental leave, ability to participate in unlimited paid time off subject to the terms and conditions of the PTO policy, including 8 company wide holidays, short and long-term disability insurance, accident and critical illness insurance, referral bonus policy, employee assistance program, pet insurance, travel assistant program, wellbeing and childcare discounts, benefit advocates, and a learning and development benefit. 

 Final offers may vary from the amount listed based on qualifications, professional experiences, skills, education, relevant training, geographic location, and other job related factors.

jobs.title: Data & Annotation Engineer
jobs.description:
Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

 About the Program: 

 Innodata's Federal Practice builds the trusted data layer for critical infrastructure Trust & Safety work. Partnering with a leading systems integrator, we're delivering a modern, governed data services platform in a secure federal (IL4) environment. Over an intensive 20-week phase, you'll help stand up a data services storefront, a DataCard governance framework, synthetic data integration, and Databricks write-back capabilities.

 About the Role: 

 As the Data/Annotation Engineer, you'll be hands-on with the data itself. You'll administer the annotation toolchain, manage annotation workflows across the corpus, and produce the per-dataset documentation that feeds our governance framework. You'll work with the AI Solutions Engineer to ensure the data going into our models is accurate, well-labeled, and fully traceable. This role is for someone detail-obsessed who understands that great AI starts with disciplined, well-governed data.

 Key Responsibilities: 

 Receive, validate, ingest, and ontology-map the ODIN mission-aligned corpus from AFS delivery

 Produce the ODIN load report: corpus description, ontology mapping, readiness state

 Configure CVAT annotation pipeline against the Phase 1 starter kit rule pack

 Operate both self-service and lightweight white-glove annotation paths during Phase D corpus production

 Produce 50–100 label demonstration corpus across synthetic and mission-aligned content

 Support QA/Evaluation Lead on QC execution and corpus annotation dry-runs

 Associate DataCard provenance records with annotated and synthetic outputs in coordination with the Solution Architect

 Must-Have Qualifications: 

 Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, or related field preferred. Equivalent experience may substitute for degree on a 2-for-1 basis.

 5+ years total professional experience, 3+ years in data engineering or annotation operations

 CVAT — deployment and day-to-day operation required; this is not a nice-to-have

 Annotated dataset ingest pipelines: schema mapping, format validation, ontology alignment

 Full-motion video (FMV) annotation concepts and tooling

 Python scripting for data wrangling, validation, and format conversion

 Active Secret clearance with TS/SCI eligibility

 Nice-to-Have Qualifications: 

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or related field required; Master's degree preferred. Equivalent experience may substitute for degree on a 2-for-1 basis

 CVAT annotation platform — AI feature configuration and operation

 DoD or IC data program experience: CUI, distribution statements, federal data governance

 Evaluation design for AI/ML training data: IAA methodology, drift detection, model performance measurement

 Video understanding or FMV annotation experience

 DataCard or ML data provenance framework familiarity

 The expected hourly salary range for this position is $55 to $60 p/hour, based on experience, skills, and qualifications. 

 Note to Candidates: 

 Phase D corpus production (Weeks 17–19) is the core demonstration deliverable. Candidates must be genuinely comfortable operating CVAT at production quality against a mission dataset under a milestone deadline

Innodata will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the application process. To learn more on how to recognize job scams, please visit the Federal Trade Commission’s guide at https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams.

jobs.title: Associate Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description:

 impact.com is the world’s leading commerce partnership marketing platform, transforming the way businesses grow by enabling them to discover, manage, and scale partnerships across the entire customer journey. Its award-winning products— Performance (affiliate), Creator (influencer), and Advocate (customer referral)—unify every type of partner into one integrated platform. As consumers increasingly rely on recommendations from people and communities they trust, impact.com helps brands show up where it matters most. Today, over 5,000 global brands, including Walmart, Uber, Shopify, Lenovo, L’Oréal, and Fanatics, rely on impact.com to power more than 225,000 partnerships that deliver measurable business results.

 Collaboration & craft: Use AI coding assistants while holding the same quality and review standards. Participate in code reviews, pairing, and technical discussions, and communicate progress and blockers clearly.

 What You Have: 

 Preferred Requirements: 

 1–3 years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or a related technical role

 Working programming ability in Scala, Java, or Python, with an appetite to become strong in both Scala and Python

 Solid SQL fundamentals: joins, aggregations, window functions, and an understanding of query behaviour

 Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering basics, including Git and collaborative development workflows

jobs.description:
InMobi (Corporate) 

 InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.

 InMobi Advertising 

 InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

 Glance 

 Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

 Role Overview

 We are looking for a hands-on SDE-II – Data Engineer to join InMobi’s Demand-Side Platform (DSP) team. In this role, you will build, maintain, and optimise scalable data pipelines that support programmatic advertising, campaign analytics, audience targeting, and attribution.

 You will work with batch and streaming data, distributed processing frameworks, cloud data platforms, and analytical storage systems to transform large volumes of data into reliable and actionable insights. You will collaborate with backend, product, and ML engineering teams to develop efficient data solutions that support DSP operations.

 This role is ideal for an engineer with strong fundamentals in Python, SQL, and distributed data processing who is keen to solve data engineering challenges involving high-volume event streams, performance optimisation, and data reliability.

 Key Responsibilities

 1. Data Engineering and Pipeline Development

 Develop, maintain, and optimise end-to-end batch and streaming data pipelines for processing events such as bid requests, impressions, clicks, and conversion signals.

 Build data ingestion and transformation workflows using Python, SQL, Apache Spark/PySpark, and relevant data engineering frameworks.

 Work with data lakehouse architectures and contribute to ingestion, storage, transformation, and serving layers.

 Implement data quality checks, schema validation, error handling, and monitoring to ensure data accuracy and reliability.

 Support data modelling and query optimisation for analytical and reporting workloads.

 Contribute to pipeline performance improvements, resource utilisation, and efficient compute and storage usage.

 2. Distributed Processing and Streaming

 Work with distributed data processing technologies such as Apache Spark, PySpark, and Apache Kafka .

 Develop and support streaming workflows for processing event-driven data, with attention to data freshness, reliability, and processing efficiency.

 Implement mechanisms for handling duplicate, delayed, or failed events, including retries, checkpointing, and recovery where applicable.

 Investigate production issues and troubleshoot data pipeline failures, performance bottlenecks, and data quality discrepancies.

 Contribute to the adoption and effective use of technologies such as Apache Flink, Spark Structured Streaming, and open table formats where relevant to the platform.

 3. Data Storage and Analytics

 Work with cloud-based data platforms and storage services to support scalable data processing and analytics.

 Develop and optimise SQL queries, data transformations, partitioning strategies, and table structures.

 Contribute to analytical data stores such as StarRocks, ClickHouse, or similar technologies, based on project requirements.

 Work with data lake table formats such as Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi, where applicable.

 Support data modelling, metadata management, access controls, and data retention practices in line with established engineering standards.

 4. Collaboration and Engineering Practices

 Collaborate with backend engineers, ML engineers, and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver reliable data solutions.

 Work with workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow or equivalent to schedule, monitor, and manage data pipelines.

 Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, testing, and deployment activities.

 Follow engineering best practices for version control, CI/CD, observability, documentation, and production readiness.

 Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance pipeline reliability, scalability, performance, and cost efficiency.

 Required Skills and Qualifications

 Experience and Education

 2–5 years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or big data development.

 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

 Experience developing and maintaining data pipelines in a production environment.

 Experience handling large datasets or distributed data processing workloads is preferred.

 Exposure to ad-tech, programmatic advertising, real-time bidding (RTB), or event-driven systems is an added advantage.

 Core Data Engineering Skills

 Strong programming skills in Python .

 Good command of SQL , including joins, aggregations, data transformations, and query optimisation.

 Hands-on experience with Apache Spark/PySpark or a comparable distributed data processing framework.

 Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines.

 Understanding of batch processing and streaming data concepts.

 Exposure to workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.

 Understanding of data modelling, partitioning, schema evolution, and data quality practices.

 Streaming, Cloud, and Data Platform Skills

 Familiarity with Apache Kafka or similar messaging and streaming technologies.

 Exposure to AWS, GCP, or Azure data services.

 Familiarity with data lakes, lakehouse architectures, or analytical databases.

 Exposure to Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Apache Hudi, StarRocks, or ClickHouse is an advantage.

 Understanding of monitoring, logging, error handling, and production troubleshooting.

 Preferred Skills

 Experience processing high-volume event data or building near-real-time data pipelines.

 Exposure to ad-tech datasets such as bid requests, impressions, clicks, conversions, campaign performance, or attribution data.

 Familiarity with Java or Scala in addition to Python.

 Basic understanding of REST APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures.

 Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tools is a plus.

 Experience collaborating with ML teams on feature engineering or training data pipelines is an advantage.

 Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable software infrastructure for collecting, processing, and storing large volumes of robotics data (e.g., sensor data, telemetry, logs).

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Data Labs
jobs.location: New York - Hybrid; San Francisco Bay Area - Hybrid
jobs.description:
About Invisible 

 Invisible is an Applied AI research company closing the gap between frontier models and the enterprise. We provide the platform infrastructure that makes AI work in production at scale: unify fragmented data, map complex processes, orchestrate and evaluate agents, and stand up hyper-personalized workflow applications fast for companies like Grubhub, Alliance Global, and Thomson Reuters. Where models fall short, we build RL environments and data to fix them. The result: a virtuous cycle between enterprise deployment and model training.

Recognized as Best Predictive Analytics Platform of the Year at the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards, Invisible makes AI work.

 About the Role 

 We're looking for a Director of Engineering to set the technical strategy for Data Labs, the team that builds the benchmarking systems, data pipelines, and RL environments behind our AI training engagements. The frontier labs and enterprises we work with are changing how they train, evaluate, and deploy models every quarter. Your job is to see where that market is going and make sure Data Labs is built for it before our clients ask.

 You'll decide which capabilities we invest in, which we standardize into platform, and which we leave to individual engagements. You'll track how training methods, evaluation practices, and data needs are shifting across the industry, and turn that into a technical roadmap and a point of view our commercial and research teams can sell against.

 You'll lead a group of engineering managers, forward deployed engineers (FDEs), and senior ICs, and partner closely with applied research, product, and go-to-market leadership. This is a hands-on strategic role. You won't spend much time writing code, but you'll stay close enough to the technical work to make and defend hard architectural calls, and close enough to clients to know which calls matter.

 What You'll Do 

 Technical Strategy & Roadmap 

 Own the multi-year technical strategy for Data Labs, and translate it into a roadmap tied to where the AI training and evaluation market is heading.

 Decide where to build shared platform versus engagement-specific solutions, weighing reuse against team autonomy so platforms speed teams up rather than creating over-dependency.

 Set architectural direction for benchmarking infrastructure, data pipelines, and RL environments so they stay reproducible, portable across client deployments, and ready for the next generation of training methods.

 Anticipate technical shifts 6–18 months out, such as new post-training techniques, agentic evaluation, and synthetic data, and place the bets that keep Invisible ahead of them.

 Set expectations for how AI is used in design reviews and day-to-day engineering work.

 Market Intelligence & Competitive Positioning 

 Build a clear, current view of how frontier labs and enterprises are training, evaluating, and deploying models, and what that means for the data and infrastructure they'll need from us.

 Track the competitive landscape across AI data, evaluation, and RL environment providers, and help define where Invisible differentiates.

 Turn client signals, research developments, and market trends into investment recommendations for executive leadership.

 Partner with product and commercial teams to shape new offerings, pricing logic, and the technical story behind them.

 Evaluation & Data Strategy 

 Define Invisible's point of view on benchmarking and evaluation, including pre- and post-engagement comparisons, capability gap analyses, and regression tracking.

 Make sure evaluation design ties to client-defined success metrics, validate automated checks against human judgment, and be explicit about what each approach can't see.

 Identify reusable data assets, frameworks, and pipelines that become durable advantages and improve margins across engagements.

 Shape practices for data licensing, privacy, and contamination risk as a strategic differentiator, not just a compliance requirement.

 Client & Executive Engagement 

 Represent engineering in executive conversations, strategic client relationships, and pre-sales, translating technical reality into clear, honest narratives.

 Act as a trusted technical advisor to client research and engineering leaders, bringing back what you learn to inform the roadmap.

 Help leaders weigh client-specific asks against broader platform and business goals, with clear short- and long-term paths.

 Organizational Leadership 

 Lead and grow an engineering org of multiple teams, including engineering managers, senior managers, FDEs, and Staff+ ICs.

 Coach managers to build sound technical judgment and strategic awareness in their teams.

 Build hiring pipelines that reinforce a rigorous, client-focused, strategy-aware engineering culture.

 Make sure the org has the planning, quality, and operational practices it needs to execute on the strategy reliably, delegating day-to-day delivery to strong managers.

 What We're Looking For 

 10+ years in software engineering, with significant experience building ML or AI systems.

 5+ years in engineering leadership, including experience managing managers across multiple teams.

 A track record of setting multi-year technical strategy and making platform investment decisions that paid off commercially.

 Deep, current understanding of the AI training and evaluation landscape, including how frontier labs and enterprises approach fine-tuning, RLHF/RLAIF, and evaluation methodology.

 Hands-on familiarity with LLM training pipelines, deep enough to make and defend architectural decisions.

 Experience building benchmarking, data curation, or RL infrastructure that produced measurable client outcomes.

 Ability to read market and competitive signals and turn them into a technical roadmap and a clear product point of view.

 Strong cross-functional partnership with applied research, product, and commercial teams.

 Excellent executive communication, and confidence acting as a technical advisor in client and pre-sales conversations.

 Nice to Have 

 Prior experience at an AI services firm, applied research consultancy, frontier lab, or enterprise AI product company.

 A visible point of view on the AI data and evaluation market, such as talks, writing, or open-source work.

 Familiarity with data licensing, synthetic data generation, or contamination detection involving client data.

 Experience shaping new product lines or service offerings from a technical foundation.

 Experience leading an org through rapid growth or significant change.

 What’s In It For You 

 Invisible is committed to fair and competitive pay, ensuring that compensation reflects both market conditions and the value each team member brings. Our salary structure accounts for regional differences in cost of living while maintaining internal equity.

 For this position, the annual salary will include a 20% annual bonus and an additional incentive structure. The base salary range for SF/NY are:
 Salary Range
 $252,000 — $300,000 USD 

 Bonus and equity is included in all full-time, non commission offers. Final compensation is determined by a combination of factors, including location, job-related experience, skills, knowledge, internal pay equity, and overall market conditions. Because of this, every offer is unique. Additional details on total compensation and benefits will be discussed during the hiring process.

You can find more information about our geographic pay tiers here . During the interview process, your Invisible Talent Acquisition Partner will confirm which tier applies to your location. For candidates outside the U.S., compensation is adjusted to reflect local market conditions and cost of living.

 What It's Like to Work at Invisible: 

 At Invisible, we’re not just redefining work—we’re reinventing it. We operate at the intersection of advanced AI and human ingenuity, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible to unlock productivity and scale. Ownership is at the core of everything we do. Here, you won’t just execute tasks—you’ll build, innovate, and shape the future alongside world-class clients pushing the boundaries of AI. 

 We expect bold ideas, relentless drive, and the ability to turn ambiguity into opportunity. The pace is fast, the challenges are big, and the growth is unmatched. We’re not for everyone, and we’re okay with that. If you’re looking for predictable routines, this isn’t the place for you. But if you’re driven to create, thrive in dynamic environments, and want a front-row seat to the AI revolution, you’ll fit right in. 

 Country Hiring Guidelines:
 Invisible is a hybrid organization with offices and team members located around the world. While some roles may offer remote flexibility, most positions involve in-office collaboration and are tied to specific locations. Any location-based requirements or hybrid expectations will be communicated by our Talent Acquisition team during the recruiting process.

 AI Interviewing Guidelines: 
 Our hiring team thoughtfully uses AI to support an efficient, engaging, and inclusive interview process. Since AI can also be a helpful tool for candidates, we've outlined expectations for using it ethically throughout your interview journey. Click here to learn more about how we use AI and our guidelines for candidates. 

 Accessibility Statement:
 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities. If you require an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please submit your request using our accommodation request form. A member of our team will follow up to support your request. 

 Equal Opportunity Statement:
 We’re an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law.

 Invisible's Data Lab works with leading AI companies to design and deliver the human data that advances model capabilities and measures performance. Our work spans the full frontier of AI training and evaluation—from supervised fine-tuning and preference data to benchmarks, red teaming, multimodal data, coding tasks, and agent environments. Solutions architects are at the center of this work, working with clients to define the problem and translating open-ended model development problems into scalable programs with sound methodology.

 We are looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to bring technical depth, sharp commercial judgment, and a strong command of the rapidly evolving AI training and evaluation landscape. Embedded within an account team working with a major frontier AI lab, you will lead solution design for new opportunities and pilots. You will partner with Project Leads who own execution, client management, and overall project outcomes, while remaining accountable for the integrity, feasibility, and scalability of the solution through handoff and early delivery.

 You will often enter when a client's ask is still underspecified. Your job is to understand what they are really trying to achieve, translate that into a collection we can execute, and help the client and our teams make the right technical, methodological, and commercial choices. You will connect the perspectives of client researchers, program managers, Project Leads, experts, and engineers—bringing context that may not otherwise exist in the room.

 This is not a traditional infrastructure architecture role, nor is it primarily a project management role. It sits at the intersection of ML research, human data, product thinking, and client partnership. Success means teams make better decisions because you are involved: projects are framed correctly, solutions reflect the state of the art, and clients trust Invisible to understand where their work is going next.

 You will work across a remarkable range of frontier AI problems, with direct exposure to the researchers and program leaders defining them. You will help determine how novel human-data programs should work before there is an established playbook, influence the products and systems used to deliver them, and build reusable ways of thinking that shape how Invisible approaches the field.

 If you live and breathe LLM training and evaluation, communicate with unusual clarity, and want your judgment to matter in the room, this role offers a rare combination of technical range, client proximity, and real-world impact.

 What You'll Do

 Equip account teams with the technical and research context they need to fully understand client requests and make sound decisions about how to approach them.

 Own the solution design of new human-data projects and pilots, working with Project Leads from early discovery and scoping through the transition into execution.

 Work directly with client research and program management stakeholders to interpret ambiguous requests, uncover the underlying objective, and turn it into a clear and executable approach. For technical POCs in particular, you may take the lead in the relationship alongside the Project Lead.

 Advise on methodology/best practices across supervised fine-tuning, preference data and RLHF, benchmarks and evaluations, red teaming, multimodal data, coding tasks, agent environments, and emerging approaches.

 Shape task design, annotation and evaluation workflows, quality and validation strategies, data structures, and the trade-offs between research value, feasibility, speed, scale, and expert experience.

 Define the expert profiles a project requires, including the knowledge, experience, and judgment needed to produce credible data.

 Bring commercial judgment to early scoping, building rough-cut estimates of effort, expert supply, timeline, and cost so teams can test feasibility and shape viable proposals.

 Partner with Engineering to define the expert-facing interfaces and technical architecture that collections require, including workflows, APIs, data exchange patterns, synthetic testing, and validation mechanisms.

 Prototype or test critical elements of a solution during discovery, while working with Engineering as the team responsible for production implementation.

 Build alignment across clients, account leadership, Project Leads, Engineering, expert operations, and other internal teams.

 Stay deeply current on LLM training, post-training, human data, benchmarks, and evaluation research, and translate new developments into practical implications for active and future client work.

 Develop and share reusable mental models, patterns, and emerging best practices that raise the technical fluency and solutioning quality of the wider organization.

 What We Need

 Required

 Deep, demonstrable interest in how frontier AI models are trained, improved, and evaluated. You actively follow the space and can form your own views rather than simply repeat its vocabulary.

 Strong working knowledge of LLM training and evaluation concepts, with the ability to reason across data modalities, collection methods, and research objectives.

 Exceptional communication skills. You can listen closely, identify what is missing from an underspecified request, explain complex ideas clearly, and influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 The judgment to challenge assumptions constructively while maintaining momentum and client trust. You know when to ask another question, when to recommend a different approach, and when to make a pragmatic call.

 Enough technical fluency in ML, data systems, software architecture, APIs, and data flows to collaborate credibly with researchers and engineers and to shape implementable solutions.

 Commercial judgment and comfort with rough-cut budgeting, particularly when weighing research ambition against expert availability, delivery effort, timeline, cost, and unit economics.

 Ability to synthesize client context, research intent, expert capabilities, user experience, technical constraints, and operational realities into an executable approach.

 Experience working across multiple stakeholders or teams, particularly in ambiguous environments where responsibilities and requirements continuously evolve.

 High ownership, curiosity, adaptability, and low ego. You care more about reaching the right answer and improving the outcome than being the person who supplied it.

 Nice to Have

 A background in computer science, software engineering, machine learning, data science, AI research, technical product, solutions architecture, or a related field. Equivalent knowledge gained through independent work or other professional experience is equally welcome.

 Direct experience with human-data programs, data annotation, model post-training, RLHF, RLVR, evaluations, benchmarks, red teaming, or research operations.

 Experience partnering directly with AI researchers, research engineers, or technical program managers.

 Hands-on ability with tools such as Python, SQL, APIs, notebooks, or lightweight prototyping. You will not be the primary builder, but being able to inspect, test, or demonstrate an idea can make you more effective.

 Experience designing tools or workflows for specialized users, particularly where expert judgment and data quality are central to the outcome.

 Evidence of serious engagement with the field through professional work, research, open-source contributions, technical writing, independent projects, benchmark participation, or other forms of self-directed learning.

 Bonus and equity is included in all full-time, non commission offers. Final compensation is determined by a combination of factors, including location, job-related experience, skills, knowledge, internal pay equity, and overall market conditions. Because of this, every offer is unique. Additional details on total compensation and benefits will be discussed during the hiring process.

You can find more information about our geographic pay tiers here . During the interview process, your Invisible Talent Acquisition Partner will confirm which tier applies to your location. For candidates outside the U.S., compensation is adjusted to reflect local market conditions and cost of living.

 What It's Like to Work at Invisible: 

 At Invisible, we’re not just redefining work—we’re reinventing it. We operate at the intersection of advanced AI and human ingenuity, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible to unlock productivity and scale. Ownership is at the core of everything we do. Here, you won’t just execute tasks—you’ll build, innovate, and shape the future alongside world-class clients pushing the boundaries of AI. 

 We expect bold ideas, relentless drive, and the ability to turn ambiguity into opportunity. The pace is fast, the challenges are big, and the growth is unmatched. We’re not for everyone, and we’re okay with that. If you’re looking for predictable routines, this isn’t the place for you. But if you’re driven to create, thrive in dynamic environments, and want a front-row seat to the AI revolution, you’ll fit right in. 

 Country Hiring Guidelines:
 Invisible is a hybrid organization with offices and team members located around the world. While some roles may offer remote flexibility, most positions involve in-office collaboration and are tied to specific locations. Any location-based requirements or hybrid expectations will be communicated by our Talent Acquisition team during the recruiting process.

 AI Interviewing Guidelines: 
 Our hiring team thoughtfully uses AI to support an efficient, engaging, and inclusive interview process. If you require an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please submit your request using our accommodation request form. A member of our team will follow up to support your request. 

 Equal Opportunity Statement:
 We’re an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law.

jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer
jobs.location: Cambridge, Massachusetts, United States, New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Iterative Health is a healthcare technology and services company powering the acceleration of clinical research to transform patient outcomes. 

 We built a leading performance-driven network of 100+ sites across the US, Europe, India, and Australia, conducting research directly in the communities where care is delivered across gastrointestinal, hepatology, obesity, and cardiology. By combining deep clinical trial expertise with cutting-edge AI, we connect sponsors' scientific ambitions with high-performing research teams that expedite and expand access to novel therapeutics for patients in need. Today, Iterative Health is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, and New York City with 250+ employees world-wide. 

 About the Role 

 Accelerating clinical research is one of the defining challenges in healthcare. Promising therapies exist that patients can't access because the operational infrastructure to run clinical trials efficiently doesn't exist yet. We're building it. That means designing technology systems that bring order to a fragmented landscape of clinical data sources, automating the operational work that slows trials down, and turning real-world clinical data into a foundation for predictive intelligence.

 We're building a uniquely valuable data asset: real-world patient and research data flowing across 80+ trial sites, spanning dozens of EHRs and clinical systems, focused on patient populations that are chronically underserved by existing clinical research infrastructure. Your job is to build the pipelines, data models, and AI infrastructure that make this asset real, from ingestion and normalization through to the systems that power predictions on top of it. You'll own data quality and observability as foundational engineering problems. You'll also have a direct hand in shaping how this data drives our AI strategy, what we model, what we predict, and what becomes possible.

 This is an opportunity for someone who wants to be part of a small, fast-moving engineering team at a formative stage. You'll shape what gets built, how decisions get made, and what the team becomes.

 Responsibilities 

 Own the data layer and architecture: the models, schemas, and infrastructure decisions that everything downstream depends on

 Build and operate the pipelines and transformations that move data from ingestion through normalization, enrichment, and into the formats that support analytics, ML training, and production model serving

 Own data quality and observability: build the systems that make data issues visible and correctable before they compound

 Partner with ML and engineering teams to identify what's modelable, define training data requirements, and build the data foundations for new predictive capabilities

 Define how clinical and operational data is governed across the system

 Evaluate and select the tools and technologies that make up the data stack, with a clear point of view on build vs. buy

 Help shape the engineering culture of a small, growing team: how technical decisions get made, how problems get debated, what rigor looks like in practice

 What We’re Looking For 

 Required Qualifications

 10+ years of experience in data engineering or related roles, with significant time spent building data systems

 Experience with healthcare data strongly preferred (HL7, FHIR, claims, EHR extracts) or other complex, regulated data domains

 Deep experience modeling and integrating data from multiple heterogeneous sources with inconsistent schemas and quality

 Experience applying AI and LLMs to data engineering problems: extraction, normalization, classification, entity resolution

 Strong understanding of how data infrastructure supports ML workflows from feature engineering to training data pipelines to model serving

 Fluent in SQL and at least one modern programming language (Python, Java, Scala, Go), with experience across modern data infrastructure - distributed processing, streaming, cloud-native storage, orchestration, and transformation frameworks

 Have built data systems from early stages, making foundational decisions with incomplete information

 Naturally raise the quality of the engineering around you through code review, design guidance, and honest technical conversation

 Preferred Qualifications

 Experience building data infrastructure that directly supports ML model training and evaluation

 Familiarity with clinical trial operations, EDC systems, or life sciences data

 SOC 2, HIPAA or similar compliance experience baked into engineering practice

 A track record of building or improving data systems that others had given up on making reliable

 New York pay range
 $200,000 — $325,000 USD 

 At Iterative Health, we’re actively working towards creating an environment that is representative of the diversity of patients our technology serves. We are focused on building an equitable and inclusive culture, and by extension, hiring process. If you require any accommodations to make the application process or interviewing experience more accessible to you, please contact CandidateAccommodations@iterative.health.

jobs.title: Senior Data Protection Engineer
jobs.description:
Our Hosting team delivers InterSystems' solutions as hosted or managed services to customers worldwide, supporting business-critical and regulated workloads that require dependable protection and recoverability. The annual goal of this role is to implement and operate consistent global data protection practices, policies, and services using Rubrik Enterprise Edition. The role holder will strengthen backup, recovery, cyber resilience, and governance while improving automation, assurance, and operational maturity. Success is measured by policy compliance, protection coverage, recovery readiness, service reliability, reduced data-loss risk, and demonstrable achievement of recovery objectives.

 Key Regional Benefits 

 Global scope on an enterprise data protection platform.

 Engineer Rubrik Enterprise Edition across business-critical environments and establish consistent protection and recovery practices worldwide.

 Ability to shape global data protection standards

 Influence decisions covering policy design, retention, recovery, cyber resilience, automation, and the long-term direction of data protection services.

 Highly competitive compensation and benefits package

 A competitive package with market-aligned compensation and comprehensive benefits for a senior technical role based in Dublin.

 Meaningful work supporting healthcare customers

 Protect systems and data used by clinicians and care providers, helping ensure that critical services can be recovered reliably when customers need them.

 Work within a skilled, collaborative engineering and architect teams
Join a global hosting and infrastructure team that values shared ownership, operational excellence, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing.

 Key Responsibilities 

 Implement, administer, and improve Rubrik Enterprise Edition globally, including configuration, upgrades, capacity, health, security, and lifecycle management.

 Define and enforce global data protection policies, SLA domains, retention standards, archival, replication, immutability, access controls, and encryption requirements.

 Translate business, regulatory, contractual, and risk requirements into protection tiers, recovery point objectives, recovery time objectives, and operating procedures.

 Onboard workloads to the protection service and maintain accurate coverage across supported on-premises, cloud, virtual, database, and application environments.

 Operate and monitor backup, replication, archival, and recovery; resolve job failures, capacity constraints, policy exceptions, and performance issues.

 Plan and execute restore tests, disaster recovery exercises, and readiness reviews, maintaining evidence that recovery objectives and controls are met.

 Support cyber recovery and ransomware resilience, including anomaly investigation, clean recovery planning, privileged-access controls, and coordination with security and incident response teams.

 Establish procedures, runbooks, standards, and governance for data protection services, and drive consistent adoption across regions and technology teams.

 Respond to data protection incidents and service degradation, lead technical troubleshooting, and contribute to root cause analysis and corrective and preventative actions.

 Automate operations, compliance checks, reporting, and workflows using Rubrik APIs and appropriate scripting or orchestration tools.

 Report on protection coverage, recoverability, policy compliance, capacity, platform risk, and operational performance.

 Work closely with infrastructure, cloud, database, application, security, risk, and business continuity teams; participate in a shared on-call rota for critical production services.

 Experience / Qualifications Required 

 Strong experience engineering and operating enterprise-scale backup, recovery, and data protection services. - Essential

 Strong hands-on production experience with Rubrik Enterprise Edition. - Essential

 Current Rubrik Certified System Administrator (RCSA) certification is required. Rubrik Certified Engineer (RCE), Rubrik Certified Cloud Specialist (RCCS), or Rubrik Partner Black Belt is strongly preferred.

 Equivalent current Rubrik credentials demonstrating advanced implementation, cloud-protection, or cyber-recovery expertise will also be considered.

 Experience designing and implementing global data protection policies, standards, and operating models. - Essential

 Strong understanding of retention, immutability, encryption, access control, RPO, RTO, and recovery validation. - Essential

 Experience supporting disaster recovery, cyber recovery, or ransomware-resilience capabilities. - Essential

 Proven troubleshooting skills and experience working within incident, change, and problem management processes. - Essential

 Experience supporting production services in a 24x7 or on-call environment. - Essential

 Experience protecting VMware, Nutanix, Windows, Linux, database, and cloud workloads. - Preferred

 Experience using APIs, scripting, or automation tooling to operate data protection services at scale. - Preferred

 Experience supporting audit, risk, compliance, and customer assurance activities. - Preferred

 About InterSystems 

 InterSystems, a creative data technology provider, delivers a unified foundation for next-generation applications for healthcare, finance, manufacturing, and supply chain customers in more than 80 countries. Our data platforms solve interoperability, speed, and scalability problems for large organizations around the globe to unlock the power of data and allow people to perceive data in imaginative ways. Established in 1978, InterSystems is committed to excellence through its 24×7 support for customers and partners around the world. Privately held and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, InterSystems has 38 offices in 28 countries worldwide. For more information, please visit InterSystems.com .

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
About the Position

 We are looking for a Data Engineer to turn messy, real-world datasets into reliable inputs for research and trading. Jane Street depends on data from a wide variety of sources to understand markets and the global economy—think world news, decades of weather patterns, deidentified credit card spending, or packet captures of stock exchange market data feeds. Clean, well-structured data is the difference between noise and a profitable trading signal. 

 You'll work closely with trading desks to identify Jane Street's data needs, evaluate datasets, and build pipelines that ingest and transform external data. You'll figure out what data means and how best to represent it. We build our own tools and software when needed, so you'll also help shape the systems you use every day.

 This is a collaborative role, but you'll own your work from end to end. It requires a mix of engineering, data analysis, and product sense. You'll develop deep expertise in your data domains and use that understanding to decide what's worth building next.

 About You

 Have strong programming skills in any language (Python a plus); you write clear, correct, and maintainable code

 Proficient with SQL or DataFrame libraries like pandas or Polars

 Intellectually curious with a meticulous approach to data investigation; you enjoy the detective work required to make sense of unfamiliar datasets

 A clear and concise communicator

 Prior experience with financial data is helpful but not required. We’re happy to hire talented engineers and teach them what they need to know.

 If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to agency-partnerships@janestreet.com .

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
About the Position

 Our goal is to give you a real sense of what it’s like to work at Jane Street full time. Over the course of your internship, you will explore ways to approach and solve exciting problems within your field of interest through fun and challenging classes, interactive sessions, and group discussions — and then you will have the chance to put those lessons to practical use.

 As a Data Engineering intern, you'll learn how we turn messy, real-world data into reliable foundations for research and trading. You'll write Python, SQL, and OCaml; use open-source tools and proprietary software; and work with a mix of structured and unstructured data (think world news, decades of weather patterns, deidentified credit card spending, or packet captures of stock exchange market data feeds).

 During the internship you'll take on two real projects. You'll get your hands on an unfamiliar dataset, figure out what it actually contains, dig into parts that don't make sense, and explain your findings. You'll write code to ingest and transform data and to monitor its quality. You'll be mentored by full-time Data Engineers and learn about business context from data users, but the projects will be yours to own.

 Learn more about Jane Street's internship program here .

 About You

 We don't expect you to have a background in computer science, data engineering, finance, or any other specific field—we're looking for smart, inquisitive people who enjoy solving interesting problems. We're more interested in how you think and learn than what you currently know. You should be:

 Curious about what data means, not just how to move it from one place to another

 Comfortable manipulating data in Python, SQL, R, or similar. You don't need to be a polished software engineer, but you should be able to turn an idea into working code

 An analytical and logical thinker. You're able to investigate something new, ask good questions, and come to sound conclusions

 Humble and eager to ask questions, admit mistakes, and learn new things

 Courteous, reliable, and organized

 A clear verbal and written communicator

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
About Karya

Karya provides AI-enabled earning and learning opportunities to economically underserved communities, and high-quality, ethically sourced datasets to research labs and technology companies. Digital workers earn at least 20 times the local minimum wage. The platform has delivered over 40 million tasks.

 About the role 
This role runs live client projects on the Karya platform. The work is the execution layer above the core product:
project workflows, data jobs, checks, reports, and delivery.
You will work with Operations and client teams on questions of progress, quality, pay, and files, and with platform
engineers when a fix belongs in the product. Worker payouts and client deliverables depend on getting these checks
right.

 Responsibilities 
• Run and monitor data jobs on remote Linux servers, and recover failed jobs from logs and process state.
• Configure project workflows, including the handoff from automated processing to human tasks, and track what
is in progress, held, or ready to deliver.
• Write PostgreSQL and ClickHouse queries for throughput, completion, quality, pay, and delivery status.
• Apply completion and quality rules to access, pay, and delivery decisions, after a sample check.
• Write Python, SQL, or Bash scripts for those checks and decisions, and keep them in the repository.
• Package datasets to client specifications, move them through cloud object storage, and record what has shipped.
• Read the TypeScript / Node.js codebase to follow tasks, assignments, payments, and file storage.
• Reply to Operations and client teams with the finding, the change made, and what is still open.
• Report repeated manual work to platform engineering, with an example.

 Requirements 
• PostgreSQL, including joins, aggregates, and JSON fields.
• Scripts in Python, Bash, or TypeScript, checked into git.
• Ability to read a TypeScript codebase and a relational schema.
• Linux for running jobs: SSH, logs, long-running processes, and disk.
• Ability to write technical updates that give non-technical teammates a clear picture of the situation.
• Queries or scripts already run against real project or production data.

 Good to have 
• Cloud object storage (Google Cloud Storage, S3, or Azure Blob).
• Experience with collected datasets such as speech, text, or images.
• ClickHouse, Metabase, or a similar reporting tool.

 Perks 
• Flexible leave, with remote or hybrid work.
• Health insurance.
• Direct work on data collection that determines worker earnings and client deliverables.

Karya is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants are considered without regard to race, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation,
disability, or any other protected status. For accommodations, contact hr@karya.in.

We embrace complexity and navigate challenges to empower clients to achieve their optimal outcomes.

 Senior Associate, Software Engineer – Data Platform & AI Applications
 San Francisco, California 

 The Opportunity 

 Jordan Park is seeking a Senior Associate to help build and extend our enterprise data platform and AI application ecosystem.

 This role combines advanced data engineering, cloud infrastructure, DevOps discipline, and applied AI development. The Senior Associate will operate as a senior individual contributor — owning major platform components while partnering closely with leadership and business teams. This is a hands-on technical role with meaningful scope and influence.

 In this role, you will be responsible for enabling trusted analytics across the firm, integrating proprietary data into AI systems, automating operational workflows and creating custom apps and tooling.

 Your Role 

 Data Platform Engineering 

 Design, build, and maintain production-grade SQL data pipelines (e.g., dbt + Snowflake + Python)

 Create data ingestion processes and API integrations

 AI Application Development

 Translate AI experimentation into production-grade tools

 Cloud Infrastructure (AWS) 

 Support AWS-based infrastructure including VPCs, ECS, EKS, S3, etc.

 Containerize services using Docker and manage workloads in Kubernetes

 Establish logging, monitoring standards

 Python Development & Automation 

 Develop Python-based tools for API integrations, data transformations, ad-hoc in-house applications & tooling

 Build reusable modules and maintain code standards

 Create automation solutions that reduce manual operational effort

 Projects & Communication 

 Partner cross-functionally with Investment, Client Advisory, Operations, and Finance teams

 Be self-directed in project management and delivery

 Translate business requirements into technical architecture

 Deliver executive-ready summaries of platform and AI initiatives

 Qualifications 

 Required:

 Bachelors degree with 5–8 years of experience in: data engineering, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure

 Requisite experience in AI Application development including LLM APIs and RAG Pipelines

 AWS experience including Docker and Kubernetes

 Advanced Python proficiency

 Advanced SQL and data modeling

 Experience implementing CI/CD and DevOps best practices

 Strong written and executive communication skills

 Experience in wealth management, asset management, or fintech

 A positive, helpful and can-do attitude

 Preferred:

 Salesforce data integration experience

 Experience designing secure AI architectures

 Experience mentoring junior engineers

 Compensation & Benefits 

 Compensation at Jordan Park includes a base salary, discretionary year-end bonus, benefits and other perks.  We apply a total reward philosophy when determining compensation terms. The expected base salary for this role in San Francisco, California will range from $125,000 to $160,000 per year commensurate with experience, job-related skills, relevant education, licenses and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. 

 Our benefits package includes:  

 Medical, dental & vision insurance – 100% of premium covered for employees

 401k participation with employer contribution

 Generous paid time off 

 Commuter benefits program (pre-paid tax dollars towards your commute)

 Fitness Reimbursement

 Annual Professional Development Stipend 

 We are empathetic problem solvers and subject matter experts, committed to serving clients at the highest level of trust and partnership. Our hallmarks of responsiveness, availability, dependability, and competency are our highest priorities.

 Jordan Park is always seeking great talent. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or family status, veteran status, medical condition or disability. We comply with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: Senior AI & Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us 

 Pearl is AI for professional services at global scale, combining advanced AI with verified human expertise to deliver help that is accurate, accountable, and fast. Since 2003, our network has connected millions of customers with licensed professionals across 196 countries, making real expertise available anytime, anywhere. 

 Our Values 

 Data driven: Start with truth, measure what matters.

 Courageous: Bias to action; run toward hard problems.

 Innovative: Seek novel, elegant solutions.

 Lean: Do more with less. Build, ship, learn fast.

 Humble: Strong opinions, lightly held.

 About the Role 

 Analytics is moving beyond dashboards. We’re building intelligent systems that let analysts and business users explore data, automate analysis, design scalable architectures, and get insights faster and we need a senior engineer to build the data foundations and AI-powered tools that make that possible. 

This is a hands-on builder role at the intersection of analytics engineering and applied AI. You'll own the pipelines, datasets, and metrics that the business runs on, and you’ll build the LLM-powered applications, copilots, agents, and natural-language data experiences that sit on top of them . You'll work directly with product, growth, and business teams on real B2C and customer data. 

 What You’ll Do 

 Analytics Engineering & Business Analytics 

 Build and own scalable data pipelines, transformations, analytical datasets, and reusable data products using SQL and Python.

 Analyze B2C, product, and customer data to identify trends, performance drivers, and actionable insights.

 Translate business and product questions into reliable metrics and decision-support solutions that help teams measure performance and understand customer behavior.

 AI-Powered Analytics 

 Design, build, and deploy LLM-powered applications, agents, and analytics workflows using RAG, tool calling, MCP, and modern agent frameworks.

 Develop reusable AI tools that enable analysts and business users to interact with data, automate analysis, and generate insights.

 Evaluate, monitor, and continuously improve AI solutions in production, focusing on accuracy, reliability, cost, and safety.

 Systems Integration & Production 

 Integrate data platforms, analytics systems, APIs, and AI components into reliable, secure, and maintainable services.

 Contribute to the architecture and design of scalable data and AI systems in collaboration with platform and engineering teams.

 What you'll build 

 A governed metrics layer — reliable, reusable definitions for retention, conversion, LTV and other core B2C metrics, built on BigQuery / Fabric with governed definitions in OpenMetadata, that every team and every AI tool draws from. 

 An analytics copilot — a natural-language interface that lets product managers and business users ask questions of the data and get trustworthy, sourced answers. 

 Automated analysis workflows — agents that handle recurring analyses (weekly performance reviews, anomaly triage, funnel diagnostics) and surface what matters. 

 Reusable AI tooling — skills, knowledge sources, documentation, MCP servers, and ready-to-use scripts that AI tools can call for data extraction, analysis, and visualization, so building the next AI feature is fast and safe. 

 What We're Looking For 

 Relevant Experience: 6+ years of hands-on experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, product/business analytics, applied AI, or a related technical role.

 SQL & Python : Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with experience building and maintaining production-grade data pipelines and analytical datasets beyond exploratory notebooks.

 Solution Architecture: Experience designing scalable, end-to-end architectures integrating data platforms, services, APIs, AI components, and user workflows.

 Business & Product Analytics: Experience with B2C, product, or customer analytics, including defining and applying metrics such as retention, funnels, cohorts, conversion, and customer lifetime value (LTV) to influence business decisions.

 Production AI Experience: Demonstrated experience personally building and deploying at least one LLM-powered application used by real users, leveraging RAG, tool/function calling, or agents.

 Agent Frameworks: Hands-on experience with at least one orchestration or agent framework, such as LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, AutoGen, OpenAI Agents SDK, or similar.

 Communication: Ability to explain technical designs and complex concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

 Nice To Have 

 Experience with AI evaluation, monitoring, guardrails, or Responsible AI practices in production. 

 Built conversational analytics, an analytics copilot, or text-to-SQL / natural-language data experiences. 

 Worked with semantic layers, governed metrics, or enterprise metric definitions. 

 Google BigQuery, Google Analytics, OpenMetadata, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Databricks, Snowflake, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, or Claude. 

 Vector databases, semantic search, or MCP server development. 

 Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, or observability tooling. 

 Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace 

 We welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where professional services are readily available to all. If you have curiosity, passion, and a collaborative spirit, come work with us. Pearl is committed to an inclusive workplace. Pearl is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

 AI Disclosure & Informed Consent 

 Artificial intelligence (AI) technology may be used during the hiring process to record, transcribe, analyze, and rank interview responses. By submitting your application and participating in the interview process, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in the hiring process. For more information see our AI Disclosure and Consent Policy .
