 Engineering Manager – Enterprise Data Engineering 

 We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead a team of Enterprise Data Engineers delivering trusted, scalable and reusable data capabilities across Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE). The role combines people leadership, technical direction, delivery ownership and operational accountability for enterprise data products, pipelines and integrations.

 Working with global engineering, architecture, platform, security and business teams, you will enable enterprise priorities spanning Finance, Supply Chain, IT Operations, People & Places and Sales & Operations. You will balance transformation delivery with the reliability, maintainability and continuous improvement of existing data services.

 Responsibilities 

 Lead, coach and grow the engineering team 

 · Manage performance, development, recruitment and succession; create clear goals, regular feedback and meaningful career plans.

 · Build a culture of ownership, inclusion, engineering discipline, collaboration and continuous learning.

 · Provide hands-on technical guidance when needed while delegating decisions and developing senior engineering capability.

 Own delivery, capacity and execution 

 · Translate enterprise roadmaps into executable plans, milestones, dependencies and measurable outcomes; balance project commitments with run-the-business obligations.

 · Proactively forecast capacity and skills needs, allocate resources, manage competing priorities and identify delivery trade-offs.

 · Maintain clear visibility of progress, blockers and risks; escalate early with options and recommendations, and communicate confidently to leadership and stakeholders.

 · Drive predictable delivery through appropriate agile practices, estimation, design reviews, testing, release management and continuous improvement.

 Provide technical leadership for enterprise data engineering 

 · Guide architecture and implementation of secure, scalable batch and streaming ingestion, ETL/ELT pipelines, transformations and enterprise integrations.

 · Champion maintainable engineering patterns across Snowflake, Databricks, Python/PySpark, SQL, dbt and relevant orchestration and integration technologies.

 · Ensure data models and domain-owned data products are reusable, discoverable, documented and aligned with enterprise standards.

 · Embed source control, peer review, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code where appropriate, and sound software engineering practices.

 Own operational quality and production readiness 

 · Be accountable for service reliability, observability, data freshness, data quality, lineage, access controls and operational support for team-owned pipelines and products.

 · Establish effective monitoring, alerting, incident response, root-cause analysis, recovery procedures and reduction of recurring support effort.

 · Partner with platform, architecture, security and governance teams on production readiness, privacy, compliance, cost and performance optimisation.

 Partner across the enterprise 

 · Work with domain and transformation leaders to understand business outcomes, shape requirements and prioritise sustainable data engineering solutions.

 · Coordinate dependencies with data platform, analytics, AI/ML, application and infrastructure teams to enable end-to-end delivery.

 · Represent the team’s architecture, products, delivery status, risks and impact in technical and executive forums.

 Skills and Qualifications 

 · 3+ years of people management or engineering leadership experience, including performance management, coaching and leading delivery teams.

 · 8+ years of relevant software, data platform or data engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of production-grade enterprise data solutions.

 · Strong understanding of data architecture, ETL/ELT, data warehousing/lakehouse patterns, dimensional modelling, data contracts and reusable data products.

 · Practical technical experience with SQL and Python; strong familiarity with Snowflake, Databricks and PySpark, and experience with dbt or comparable transformation frameworks.

 · Experience with orchestration, API/file-based integrations, cloud services (preferably AWS), Git-based development, automated testing and CI/CD.

 · Experience operating business-critical data pipelines, including monitoring, incident management, data quality, security and performance optimisation.

 · Ability to plan team capacity, manage a portfolio of priorities, resolve cross-team dependencies and provide transparent, proactive delivery reporting.

 · Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills across engineering, business and senior leadership; undergraduate degree or equivalent experience.

 Desirable Experience 

 · Enterprise Finance or Supply Chain data, including SAP and planning-system integrations (such as Anaplan or Adaptive).

 · Data governance, metadata/lineage, master data, privacy classification and regulated or sensitive enterprise datasets.

 · Enabling analytics, machine learning or AI-ready data products and applying AI-assisted engineering practices responsibly.

 · Working with geographically distributed teams and large-scale enterprise transformation programmes.

jobs.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

 PlayStation Studios is the game development division of Sony PlayStation, and is responsible for developing some of the most recognisable and ambitious console games and franchises on PlayStation, including The Last of Us, Horizon, Spider-Man, God of War, Helldivers and Gran Turismo. 

We work with some of the best game studios in the world, and use data to help them make their games even better. We provide end-to-end analytics services for PlayStation Studios and use data to help them in the game development lifecycle. We are looking for talented people to join us in pushing the boundaries of game analytics for PlayStation games.

 As a Lead Analytics Developer, you’ll work in our cross-disciplinary engineering team to scale our platform, expand its reach, and help define and build the future of analytics for PlayStation games. You should have a passion for video games and a background in data or analytics engineering. You’re looking for a fun, dynamic environment to take on new challenges.

 In your first six months , you will work on new title launches, and build data models to ensure efficient and consistent queries. To build these data models, you’ll work directly with game studios and data analysts to design and validate suitable in-game telemetry. You’ll also help expand our use of technologies, such as dbt and airflow, in ways that are suitable to our use cases. You will be given ownership of data models for specific games and work closely with Game Analytics team members and game studio colleagues to ensure we’re building with consistency and performance in mind. 

We’d love to hear from you if: 

 You are adept at writing SQL on analytics (OLAP) databases (preferably Redshift, or similar databases) 

 You have experience implementing and using data modelling tools such as dbt or SQLMesh 

 You have experience in transforming business needs into data model requirements & solutions 

 You’re excited by Big Data projects and technology, and want to gain more experience in this area 

 You’re committed to quality as a top priority, and have an interest in repeatable, testable, destructible, test-driven database development 

 Bonus points for: 

 a degree in Computer Science 

 experience with Python, AWS Glue, source control (Git, Liquibase), Airflow

jobs.title: Senior Director, Reporting & Analytics Engineering
jobs.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment? 

 Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

 Role Overview: 

 We are seeking a Senior Director to lead our Enterprise Reporting and Analytics Engineering organization, a team of analytics engineers, report developers, visualization specialists, and people leaders. This organization focuses on the last mile of the enterprise data supply chain: the semantic models, curated data products, metric definitions, and consumption experiences that turn engineered data into decisions. 

 This is not a traditional reporting leadership role; the classic notion of “reporting” in the form of a myriad of dashboards and filters is racing towards obsolescence. But the need for data and insights, and the need to deliver it in a way that is digestible and actionable, is timeless. Yes, governed dashboards and trusted reporting remain the foundation, and this leader must be excellent at that foundation. But the mandate is to move the organization decisively beyond static reporting toward a proactive, intelligent analytics capability: partnering with Data Science to productize and visualize their models, enabling generative AI and LLM-based access to our data, building exception-based systems that alert users when outcomes deviate from expectation in a statistically meaningful way, and designing agents that monitor data continuously and deliver insight without being asked. 

 Analytics engineering shares much of its DNA with data engineering — modeling, transformation, testing, version control, CI/CD, performance and cost discipline — but is oriented toward business enablement rather than platform and pipeline. Success in this role therefore depends as much on partnership as on technical depth. This leader will work shoulder to shoulder with Data Engineering on the boundary between platform and consumption, with Product Management on roadmap and requirements, with Data Science on advanced analytic products, and with Analytics Operations on a disciplined intake and prioritization process that makes the best possible use of finite capacity. 

 The ideal candidate has spent years building the traditional foundations — governance, metadata, lineage, dimensional modeling, engaging with enterprise BI platforms— and is now looking to apply that rigor to a fundamentally different generation of analytic products in new and innovative ways. 

 What you'll be doing: 

 Organizational Leadership 

 Lead, coach, and develop an organization of approximately 30 people, including managing through frontline managers; own hiring, role clarity, career pathing, performance management, and succession planning. 

 Define a multi-year vision and roadmap for enterprise reporting and analytics engineering, and translate it into quarterly outcomes the team and its partners can measure. Partner closely with Product Management to jointly shape the multi-year enterprise end-to-end data strategy. 

 Own the organization's budget, vendor relationships, and contractor or offshore capacity. 

 Establish and sustain an engineering culture within an analytics function: peer review, automated testing, documentation standards, source control, CI/CD, etc. 

 Analytics Engineering and Data Architecture 

 Drive maturity of the last-mile architecture in partnership with Data Engineering: curated marts, semantic layers, reusable data products, and certified datasets that serve reporting, ai enablement, data science, and downstream applications. 

 Define and enforce dimensional modeling standards, transformation frameworks, and modular, tested, version-controlled analytics code. 

 Own the enterprise metric layer so that key business measures carry a single, governed definition regardless of where they are consumed. 

 Partner with Data Engineering to define clear contracts and handoffs between pipeline and platform work and last-mile modeling, including shared tooling, standards, and escalation paths. 

 Manage query performance, warehouse consumption, and platform cost as first-class engineering concerns. 

 Data Governance, Metadata, and Lineage 

 Own cataloging, business glossary, data certification, and stewardship workflows, leveraging tools such as Atlan as the primary metadata platform. 

 Maintain column-level lineage across the analytics estate to support impact analysis, change management, audit, and root-cause investigation. 

 Leverage data access provisioning and entitlement models, including row- and column-level security, in partnership with Security, Privacy, and Compliance. 

 Collaborate with Data Engineering to drive data quality monitoring, freshness and availability SLAs, observability, and incident response for analytic assets. 

 Enterprise Reporting and Data Visualization 

 Drive analytics engagement by leveraging enterprise visualization and provisioning platforms, including Domo and Tableau, in partnership with Data Engineering. Ensure best practices are followed in data architecture, governance, adoption, performance, and total cost management. 

 Set visualization and information design standards that make reports readable, consistent, accessible, and decision-oriented. 

 Rationalize the existing reporting portfolio: retire redundant and unused assets, consolidate overlapping content, drive down tech debt and drive consumption toward certified sources. 

 Build a durable self-service capability through training, templates, community, office hours, and clear guardrails on what belongs in self-service versus centrally managed content. 

 Advanced, Proactive, and AI-Enabled Analytics 

 Partner with Data Science to productize their work: build the visualization, interaction, monitoring, and feedback loops that turn models and research into products the business actually uses. 

 Partner with Product Management and Data Engineering to enable generative AI and LLM access to enterprise data. This includes preparing the semantic and metadata foundation that makes data legible to models, delivering conversational analytics, text-to-SQL, and retrieval-augmented experiences on governed sources, and establishing guardrails, evaluation, and accuracy monitoring so that answers can be trusted. 

 Build exception-based analytics that detect when an outcome deviates from its expected value in a statistically significant way, using seasonality-aware baselines, forecast residuals, control limits, and anomaly detection rather than static thresholds. 

 Route those exceptions to accountable owners with context, likely drivers, and a recommended next action; actively tune sensitivity and volume to prevent alert fatigue and preserve signal. 

 Design and deploy analytic agents that proactively monitor data, investigate variances, assemble narrative explanations, and deliver insight into the tools where people already work. 

 Shift the organization's consumption model from pull to push: the measure of success is not how many people opened a dashboard, but whether the right person was told the right thing at the right time. 

 Cross-Functional Partnership, Intake, and Prioritization 

 Operate as a true partner to Product Management: contribute to roadmap, requirements, user research, and release planning, and run analytics with a product mindset covering personas, adoption metrics, and asset lifecycle management. 

 Partner with Analytics Operations to run a transparent intake, triage, sizing, and prioritization process, with published capacity, explicit tradeoffs, and reliable delivery commitments. 

 Make capacity constraints visible to stakeholders and executives, drive reuse over one-off builds, and decline or defer work with evidence rather than friction. 

 Serve as a senior, executive-facing partner to business functions, translating ambiguous business questions into well-scoped analytic solutions. 

 What we're looking for: 

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related quantitative field; equivalent professional experience will be considered. 

 15+ years of progressive experience in data, analytics, or business intelligence, including 8+ years leading teams and 4+ years managing managers. 

 Demonstrated experience leading an organization of 25 or more people in a large, matrixed enterprise. 

 Strong hands-on foundation in SQL, dimensional modeling, and ELT/ETL design, with production experience on a modern cloud data warehouse or lakehouse (for example Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, or Synapse) and a transformation framework such as dbt. 

 Experience applying software engineering practices to analytics work, including Git-based workflows, automated testing, and CI/CD. 

 Enterprise-scale leveraging of BI and data visualization platforms such as Domo, Tableau, Power BI, or Looker, including governance, provisioning, adoption, and cost management. 

 Demonstrated ability to participate in driving data governance program covering catalog, lineage, glossary, stewardship, quality, and access, using platforms such as Atlan, Collibra, Alation, or Informatica. 

 Proven track record of delivering jointly with Data Engineering and Product Management, with clear ownership boundaries and shared accountability. 

 Direct experience partnering with Data Science, including operationalizing, visualizing, and monitoring model output for business consumption. 

 Working command of the statistical concepts underlying exception detection, including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, variance and control limits, seasonality, and forecasting. 

 Experience running a formal intake, prioritization, and capacity planning process for a shared services or platform organization. 

 Excellent executive communication and influence skills, with the ability to operate effectively amid ambiguity and competing priorities. 

 Experience managing budget, vendor contracts, and platform licensing. 

 Preferred Skills: 

 Master's degree or MBA in a related field. 

 Production experience delivering LLM-based analytics: retrieval-augmented generation over governed data, text-to-SQL or conversational BI, semantic layers designed for model consumption, and prompt, evaluation, and cost monitoring frameworks. 

 Experience designing agentic workflows and orchestration for monitoring, investigation, and notification use cases. 

 Hands-on experience with Atlan, Domo, and Tableau specifically. 

 Proficiency in Python or R for prototyping, and familiarity with common statistical and ML libraries and MLOps concepts. 

 Experience deploying anomaly detection at scale, including alert routing, suppression, and fatigue management. 

 Familiarity with data product and data mesh operating models, domain-aligned ownership, and data contracts. 

 Experience operating in an Agile or product operating model at scale, including portfolio, OKR, and roadmap management. Deep experience with the “Silicon Valley” school of Product Management, as exemplified by the “Marty Kagan”-style academic approach a significant plus. 

 Experience leading global or matrixed teams, including offshore or vendor-partnered delivery models. 

 Track record leading a major platform migration, consolidation, or reporting rationalization effort. 

 Demonstrated success attracting, developing, and retaining senior technical talent in a competitive market.

jobs.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment? 

 Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

 Sr. Principal Engineer, Data & Machine Learning 

 San Mateo, CA 

 Why PlayStation Data & Intelligence 

 PlayStation reaches more than 100+ million people. Behind those experiences is one of the largest consumer data estates in entertainment: tens of petabytes under management and trillions of telemetry events a year, powering personalization, experimentation, partner analytics and enterprise decisions across the company. 

 We are in the middle of a multi-year shift in how that data creates value. Today intelligence often arrives after the moment has passed. Our goal is a connected intelligence layer where trusted context about players, content, partners and the business is built once, reused everywhere, activated at the point of decision, and improved by evidence about what happened next. That includes serving AI models and agents with the same governed meaning, quality and permissions we give to people.

 This role helps shape how that is built across PlayStation.

 The Role 

 We are looking for a Senior Principal Engineer, Data & Machine Learning to serve as chief architect for our Data & Intelligence organization and as the senior technical authority for how SIE builds, reuses and activates trusted data and intelligence.

 This is one of SIE’s most senior individual-contributor roles. You will report directly to the Vice President of the organization, sit on the leadership team alongside the Sr. Directors who run our two delivery portfolios, chair our architecture review forum, and lead a community of Principal Engineers anchored to the major architectural seams. You will have no direct reports by design; your leverage comes from the architecture, the standards and the decisions the whole organization builds against.

 This is a hands-on role. You will author architectures and reference implementations, prototype uncertain approaches, review the designs and code that matter most, and step in directly when a technical problem puts an important outcome at risk.

 What You’ll Own 

 You will set the architecture for, and drive reuse across, the initiatives that define the next three years of data and intelligence at PlayStation:

 A single, reusable understanding of the player. The context, lifecycle and lifetime-value intelligence that powers experiences and decisions across PlayStation, built once and reused rather than rebuilt per use case.

 Content and game understanding. Intelligence about titles, experiences and how players engage with them, connected through engagement and content graphs to improve discovery, personalization and new AI experiences.

 Creator and partner intelligence. Reusable title, launch and lifecycle intelligence available to partners at the point of decision, before launch, while live and after.

 Unified measurement. Experimentation, attribution and causal measurement so the company knows what changed an outcome, by how much, and what to do next.

 Activation. Real-time signals, activation data products and APIs that deliver trusted context into the systems that personalize and act.

 Semantic and conversational intelligence. A shared layer of business meaning and metrics that people, analytical tools and AI agents can query and trust.

 Enterprise decision data. Decision-grade finance and supply-chain data that accelerates transformation programs across SIE.

 Trusted foundations and golden paths. Data contracts, certification, lineage, unified events and standard publish-to-consume paths, with trust designed into the lifecycle; and launch data readiness so priority launches have their signals and measures from day one.

 What You’ll Do 

 Translate our multi-year Data & Intelligence strategy into a coherent technical strategy and target architecture, with clear principles for trusted data products, ML systems, shared intelligence, evaluation, activation and lifecycle management.

 Chair the architecture review forum: set its charter and cadence, publish decisions, track adoption and hold the line on non-conforming designs.

 Own the boundary decisions between platform capabilities built for reuse and domain delivery, and keep them stable.

 Define and ratify the standards teams build against: data contracts, golden paths, model evaluation and experimentation, observability, reliability, cost and lifecycle management.

 Lead the technical direction of our hardest cross-organizational initiatives; author proposals, reference designs and prototypes that establish a credible path from concept to production.

 Work directly with engineering and data science teams to remove critical blockers, so that decisions become usable capabilities rather than architecture on paper.

 Partner with security, privacy, legal, governance and responsible-AI teams to embed controls throughout the data and ML lifecycle, including the responsible use of proprietary data, third-party and foundation models, and externally hosted AI services.

 Identify duplicative capabilities, drive rationalization and retirement, and improve interoperability across SIE’s data and ML landscape.

 Advise senior executives on major technical investments, tradeoffs, emerging capabilities and long-term risk; produce the written recommendations that drive annual planning.

 Connect technical investment to named consumers, decisions and measurable outcomes; define how we measure adoption, reuse, time-to-action, quality, reliability, safety and cost.

 Lead a community of Principal Engineers; mentor Principal, Staff and Senior engineers, architects, ML engineers and data scientists.

 Represent SIE’s data and machine learning direction in senior leadership forums, partner organizations and, where appropriate, the broader industry.

 What We’re Looking For 

 15+ years in software, data or machine learning engineering, including 9+ years leading the architecture and delivery of large-scale, complex systems.

 A track record of authoring architectures, standards or platforms that were adopted across multiple organizations and stayed in use.

 Experience taking data, ML or decisioning systems serving tens of millions of consumers into production and operating them at scale.

 Experience chairing, or being the deciding technical voice in, an architecture review forum spanning multiple engineering organizations.

 Deep expertise in at least two of: reusable data products, semantic and metadata layers and data contracts; ML platforms, lifecycle management, evaluation and decisioning; real-time signals, distributed inference and activation platforms; experimentation and causal measurement; generative AI, retrieval and agentic systems; responsible AI, privacy and technical governance.

 Strong command of distributed systems, cloud, data architecture, APIs, security, reliability, observability and performance engineering.

 Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives, engineering and product leaders, and cross-functional partners without direct authority.

 Outstanding written communication. This role leads through documents.

 Experience mentoring Staff, Principal or similarly senior technical professionals.

 Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

 Nice to Have 

 Data and ML applied in gaming, entertainment, media, digital commerce or another large-scale consumer ecosystem.

 Personalization, recommendations, customer intelligence, content intelligence, experimentation or predictive decisioning at scale.

 Shared data or ML platforms serving multiple products and organizational domains.

 Feature, vector, graph, semantic or knowledge platforms; AI gateways and LLMOps.

 Experience translating research or emerging technology into production capabilities.

 Contributions to the field through open source, patents, publications, standards or conference talks.

 Why You’ll Love This Role 

 Set the technical direction for data and intelligence across PlayStation.

 Own the architecture behind experiences reaching more than 100 million people.

 Report directly to the VP and sit on the organization’s leadership team.

 Build once, reuse everywhere: the mandate is to end duplicated work, not add to it.

 Work with strong Principal and Staff engineers, data scientists and product leaders across the company.

 Stay hands-on at the most senior IC level.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Data Governance & Trust
jobs.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment? 

 Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

 Staff Software Engineer, Data Governance & Trust 

 San Mateo, CA 

 About the role 

 Sony Interactive Entertainment is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to help shape and deliver the technical foundation for Data Governance and Trust across our data and AI ecosystem.

 Our ambition is to make data understandable, reliable, reusable, and appropriately governed for the people, applications, and AI systems that depend on it. Achieving this requires shared platform capabilities, clear ownership, and governance practices embedded into how teams build and operate data products.

 In this role, you will establish technical direction, lead initiatives across teams, and remain hands-on in architecture and implementation. You will connect metadata, lineage, data quality, semantic context, and policy controls into practical capabilities that help teams use data with confidence.

 You will also be a trusted technical representative for the Data Governance and Trust group. We are looking for someone who can lead productive discussions, explain complex tradeoffs, navigate difficult conversations, and build alignment across engineering, business, governance, security, and privacy stakeholders.

 This is an individual contributor leadership role with impact across teams.

 What you will do 

 Set technical direction and deliver shared capabilities 

 Shape the architecture and technical roadmap for Data Governance and Trust in partnership with engineering leadership, product partners, domain teams, and governance stakeholders.

 Lead initiatives from discovery and ambiguous requirements through design, implementation, adoption, and ongoing operation.

 Design and build services, integrations, APIs, and automation that connect metadata, ownership, classification, lineage, quality signals, and policy information across the data ecosystem.

 Establish reusable engineering patterns that embed trust requirements into data publishing, discovery, access, consumption, change, and retirement.

 Stay hands-on through prototypes, production code, design reviews, and the resolution of complex technical problems.

 Lead conversations and build alignment 

 Serve as a technical spokesperson for the group in architecture discussions, planning forums, domain engagements, and leadership reviews.

 Facilitate discussions among stakeholders with different priorities, surface disagreements constructively, and guide decisions toward clear outcomes.

 Explain technical choices, business implications, risks, and costs to both engineering and nontechnical audiences.

 Challenge assumptions respectfully, incorporate feedback, and help teams reach workable agreements on standards, ownership, and implementation.

 Document decisions, clarify responsibilities and dependencies, and follow through on commitments across teams.

 Build relationships that enable adoption through credibility, collaboration, and influence.

 Make governance practical and sustainable 

 Partner with governance, security, privacy, and domain stakeholders to translate agreed requirements into implementable controls and traceable evidence.

 Help domain teams define data contracts, quality expectations, ownership responsibilities, and lifecycle practices supported by shared platform capabilities.

 Connect quality and reliability signals to accountable owners, consumer communications, and remediation workflows.

 Evaluate build, buy, and integration choices based on interoperability, usability, reliability, operating cost, and long-term flexibility.

 Measure success through improvements in approved data use, adoption, reliability, reuse, and operational effort.

 Prepare the foundation for AI consumption 

 Develop ways to make business meaning, provenance, quality status, and permitted-use information available to applications and AI through supported interfaces.

 Partner with AI and platform teams on governed access to data and context, including traceability and defined behavior when required trust information is missing.

 Support shared semantic definitions and metadata models while preserving clear accountability within business domains.

 Strengthen the team 

 Mentor engineers in system design, technical judgment, stakeholder engagement, and leadership.

 Raise engineering standards for reliability, maintainability, testing, observability, and documentation.

 Help engineers take broader ownership and communicate their recommendations effectively.

 What you bring 

 A track record of designing, building, and operating production software or data platforms, with demonstrated impact across multiple teams.

 Deep knowledge of metadata management, data governance, lineage, data quality, privacy engineering, access controls, or closely related platform domains, grounded in practical delivery.

 Hands-on expertise building or extending metadata and catalog platforms such as Atlan, Alation, DataHub, OpenMetadata, or comparable systems.

 A practical understanding of federated ownership models, data stewardship, semantic models, business glossaries, or certified metrics.

 The ability to work across warehouse, lakehouse, streaming, and data transformation environments.

 Demonstrated delivery of data contracts, automated lineage, quality checks, or policy as code.

 Sound judgment in translating ambiguous business or policy requirements into clear technical designs and delivered outcomes.

 Proven ability to lead initiatives across teams without direct reporting authority.

 Skill in leading difficult technical or organizational conversations, resolving competing priorities, and securing clear decisions and commitments.

 Strong written and verbal communication, including architecture proposals, decision documents, and presentations tailored to different audiences.

 A collaborative approach grounded in listening, respectful challenge, and shared accountability.

 A commitment to mentoring engineers, supported by examples of improving the effectiveness of the teams around you.

 What would be valuable 

 Strong software engineering skills, including proficiency in a language such as Python, Java, or Go, and practical SQL experience.

 Experience with distributed systems, APIs, integrations, and cloud data infrastructure, including sound judgment about reliability, consistency, security, and failure handling.

 Experience implementing controls that generate operational evidence.

 Delivering governed data or context services for analytics, applications, machine learning, or AI agents.

 Leading platform adoption, modernization, or migration across organizational boundaries.

 Representing technical work through internal forums, technical writing, communities of practice, or external presentations.

 What success looks like 

 Partner teams understand the technical direction, the decisions required, and their responsibilities.

 Cross-team discussions produce documented decisions, accountable owners, and sustained follow-through.

 Priority workflows demonstrate connected governance capabilities in production, supported by clear operating ownership.

 Producers and consumers can access relevant meaning, ownership, lineage, quality, and permitted-use information within their workflows.

 Shared patterns reduce repeated implementation work and manual coordination.

 Engineers across the group grow in technical judgment, communication, and leadership.

jobs.description:
Mission 

 The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

 Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

 Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

 Overview 

 We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

 We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.

 What Yo u’ ll Do: 

 Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.

 Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.

 Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.

 Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

 An Ideal Candidate Should Have: 

 A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.

 Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.

 Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.

 Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

 Nice to Have 

 Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.

 Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.

 Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

 What We Offer 

 A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products

 A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive

 Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity

 The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry

 Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture

 The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more

 An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

 Compensation: The United States base salary range for this full-time position is $140,000-$200,000 + bonus + equity depending on experience

 Think you’re a good fit for this job? 

 Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply. 
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

 Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit? 

 Refer them! 

 Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. 

 Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

evidence: 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.

 Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

 Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

 Overview 

 We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

 We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.

 What Yo u’ ll Do: 

 Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.

 Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.

 Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.

 Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

 An Ideal Candidate Should Have: 

 A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.

 Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.

 Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.

 Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

 Nice to Have 

 Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.

 Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.

 Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

 A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products

 A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive

 Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity

 The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry

 Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture

 The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more

 Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

 Overview 

 We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

 We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.

 Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.

 Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.

 Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.

 Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

 A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.

 Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.

 Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.

 Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

 Nice to Have 

 Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.

 Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.

 Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

 What We Offer 

 A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products

 A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive

 Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity

 The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry

 Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture

 The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more

jobs.title: Database Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

 DATABASE RELIABILITY ENGINEER 

 SpaceX is looking for a Database Reliability Engineer with strong technical knowledge in Microsoft SQL/ PowerBI technologies as well as excellent interpersonal and communication skills. This employee will be a part of our IT Engineering organization and join a team of database administrators and engineers responsible for all database technologies used throughout SpaceX. The ideal candidate will be flexible, flourish in a fast-paced and challenging environment and have an insatiable desire to learn, solve complex problems and help others. They should be a self-starter, self-motivator, and possess ingenuity to excel at this position.  This individual will need to demonstrate strong knowledge in Windows, server/storage infrastructure, and troubleshooting skills. 

 RESPONSIBILITIES: 

 Partner with internal customers to understand current challenges, plan/communicate improvements and anticipate future needs. 

 Perform root cause analysis of production-related database issues. 

 Collaborate with internal stakeholders to optimize schemas, queries, and database/server configurations. 

 Perform data migration / data transformation from OLTP to OLAP systems. 

 Develop code to automate routine tasks and provide end user self-service tools by leveraging PowerShell or a similar scripting language. 

 Engineer, deploy and maintain all aspects of Microsoft SQL database monitoring. 

 Quickly address critical support situations by providing effective solutions to database technical issues. 

 Manage PowerBI licensing, utilization, permissions and provide best-practices guidance and query optimization assistance for users. 

 Provide comprehensive and fully vetted backup and restore solutions. 

 Engineer, implement and routinely test Disaster Recovery (DR) strategies. 

 Develop and maintain strong documentation and support runbooks. 

 Support and foster the professional growth of other database engineering and administration staff via cross-training, coaching and responsibility sharing. 

 Participate in an on-call rotation. 

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: 

 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, or engineering discipline and 5+ years of experience in IT; OR 7+ years of professional experience with database reliability or DevOps in lieu of a degree. 

 7+ years experience in monitoring and tuning databases to provide highly available and performant services. 

 5+ years experience in optimizing SQL queries and data replication & transformation. 

 PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: 

 Proficient in SQL Server and at least one other database technology (Postgres, MySQL, ClickHouse).

 Proficient in resiliency and high availability methods for SQL Server, such as SQL Server log shipping, availability groups, database mirroring and replication. 

 Expertise in scaling large critical databases with high expectations for uptime and performance. 

 Ability to work effectively and provide technical leadership in high-stress situations such as production database outages. 

 Knowledge of configuration management automation and limiting the amount of manual toil. 

 Knowledge of data structure design and modeling. 

 Strong understanding of hardware in relation to SQL server; SAN, Virtualization, and basic networking for troubleshooting. 

 Good knowledge of development cycle to interface well with developers. 

 Working knowledge of adjacent database technologies (Postgres, ClickHouse, MySQL).

 Strong attention to detail, high degree of accuracy, excellent oral and written communication skills, strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to meet deadlines. 

 Open to learn new database technologies especially Column-oriented databases.

 Expertise in reporting options (SQL reports, PowerBI, etc.).

 Strong understanding of big data and data warehouse concepts and technologies.   

 ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

 Willingness to work extended hours and weekends as needed (to respond to network and server errors after hours).

 This role is an onsite position - remote work or hybrid work will not be considered.

 Own end-to-end workflow deployment and optimization of Starlink Ground Network processes

 Automate supply chain processes, including inventory syncs, order creation, kitting, shipment validation, and spares replenishment

 Develop and monitor performance metrics for build, deployment, and ongoing maintenance/reliability of the Ground Network hardware fleet (antennas, network/optical devices

 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate engineering needs into system requirements and drive adoption

 Support emergency deployments and incident response by managing critical operational and data workflows 

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 

 Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, or related field 

 Experience in Python or SQL

 PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

 Basic understanding of Kubernetes concepts, including pods, services, deployments, and namespaces

 Prior success in delivering strong data visualizations using tools such as PowerBI, Grafana, Metabase or other real-time metrics systems

 Experience building backend services using APIs (Celery, FastAPI, Django, or similar frameworks) and system-to-system data exchange in logistics and supply chain environments

 Proven track record developing custom forecasting tools and planning logic

 Knowledge of MRP/ERP, WMS, or other supply chain systems

 Strong problem-solving skills and comfort working in ambiguous environments with evolving requirements

 Excellent communication and cross-functional program management skills

jobs.title: Data Engineer (Starlink)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

 DATA ENGINEER (STARLINK) 

 At SpaceX, we’re leveraging our experience building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation, delivering fast, reliable internet to more than 10 million users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate the full stack — satellites, user terminals, and the software that ties it all together.

 As a Data Engineer on the Starlink Enterprise team, you will improve the quality of data flowing into our commercial systems and build the integrations and AI agents that turn that cleaner data into better decisions and faster execution — from pipeline generation through closed revenue and ongoing enablement. You will partner with Enterprise sales, channel and reseller operations, sales ops, and enablement to fix messy inputs, reduce manual cleanup, and ship automations that make go-to-market workflows more reliable.

 RESPONSIBILITIES: 

 Improve data hygiene and quality across go-to-market systems — identify bad, missing, duplicate, and stale records; implement validation, enrichment, and remediation so higher-quality data enters our system of record, opportunity, partner/reseller, and enablement workflows

 Raise the quality of inputs to AI agents and analytics so outputs (recommendations, deal status, enablement answers, reporting) are more accurate, trustworthy, and actionable

 Build integrations across internal tools and external systems so deal, customer, and partner context flows cleanly between sales, channel ops, and operational platforms — reducing manual re-entry and preventing quality issues at the source

 Develop Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and related interfaces that connect AI assistants (including Grok) to internal and external go-to-market systems, with an emphasis on reliable, well-scoped access to the right data and tools

 Design, ship, and iterate AI agents that power Starlink Enterprise go-to-market workflows

 Contribute to AI-powered applications and automations that accelerate lead-to-revenue cycles, working within the additional datasets and systems architecture owned by the team

 Instrument data quality and agent performance with monitoring and feedback loops — catching regressions early and tying improvements to outcomes (e.g., cleaner pipeline, faster cycle times, higher adoption and trust)

 Partner closely with sales, sales ops, channel/reseller ops, and enablement to turn recurring data-quality problems and manual processes into durable automations and standards

 Create reusable tools, checks, and documentation that help the team maintain data quality and extend agents over time

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: 

 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, physics, mathematics, or another STEM discipline

 1+ years of professional data engineering or software engineering experience (internship experience applicable)

 1+ years of development experience in Python or another modern programming language (SQL, etc.)

 PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: 

 Experience improving CRM data quality (deduping, enrichment, validation rules, field completeness, source-of-truth discipline)

 Experience building AI agents, LLM-powered applications, or tool-using assistants that integrate with real business systems (APIs, CRMs, ticketing, data warehouses)

 Experience designing APIs, webhooks, or integration layers that connect heterogeneous systems and keep data consistent across them

 Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar patterns for exposing tools and data sources to AI systems

 Experience with CRM and go-to-market tooling; familiarity with Clay, HubSpot, Apollo, or similar sales engagement / enrichment platforms is a plus

 Professional experience supporting sales, sales ops, channel/reseller, or revenue operations workflows with data and automation

 Experience with SQL and modern data tooling; exposure to Grok, internal AI platforms, or comparable LLM developer tooling is a plus

 Experience with agent evaluation, guardrails, permissions, and human-in-the-loop patterns for production AI systems

 Ability to thrive in a fast-changing environment, take initiative on ambiguous problems, and develop new expertise as the product and stack evolve

 ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: 

 Must be available to work extended hours and weekends as needed

 Willingness to travel to customer sites, other SpaceX locations, and events as needed

 COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS: 

Pay Range:

Level 1: $125,000.00 - $150,000.00
Level 2: $145,000.00 - $175,000.00

 Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

 Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

 To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Our models and analysis are relied upon day-in-and-day-out to evaluate the safety and optimality of flight trajectories.  Conduct anomaly resolution utilizing the engine model and sparse instrumentation

 Develop a detailed understanding of the physics underlying rocket engine performance, sources of performance variability, as well as related modeling and measurement techniques

 Develop tools and portals to understand the sources of engine performance variability and enact improvements to manufacturing and engine hardware design

 Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a STEM discipline

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

 SR. SOFTWARE ENGINEER, PROPULSION SIMULATION & DATA ANALYSIS (RAPTOR) 

 The Raptor Systems Modeling and Control Team is responsible for the power-balance, optimal control, and calibration of one of the worlds most prolific and advanced rocket engines. In addition to this we aid in root cause analysis for anomaly resolution, providing data and model driven insights supporting operations and components teams in high-consequence decision making. Our models and analysis are relied upon day-in-and-day-out to evaluate the safety and optimality of flight trajectories. With hundreds of engines, hundreds of simulations, and hundreds of hot fire operations, the work we do guides both the engine design process and operation of every single mission and engine test. In this role you will work with brilliant, passionate engineers to develop rapid, seamless processes to translate engine test data into accurate predictions of future performance for the most reliable and cutting-edge rocket engines in the world. 

 RESPONSIBILITIES: 

 Maintain and improve the accuracy of the lumped-parameter thermofluid physics model of the Raptor engine 

 Conduce engine cycle analysis to steer future-state engine design and thrust upgrades

 Conduct anomaly resolution utilizing the engine model and sparse instrumentation

 Develop a detailed understanding of the physics underlying rocket engine performance, sources of performance variability, as well as related modeling and measurement techniques

 This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll set the technical direction for our AWS-based data platform, develop the engineers on your team, and strengthen how Data Engineering works with Backend Engineering, Infrastructure, SRE, Analytics Engineering, and Data Science. Your first mandate is practical: improve reliability, reduce manual operational work, modernize how we deploy and monitor pipelines, and create clear ownership for how new data enters the platform.

 You’ll inherit meaningful systems and real constraints—not a blank slate. The right person will know when to modernize, when to simplify, and when the best architecture is the one the team can operate reliably.

 This position operates on a hybrid schedule, requiring you to be on-site in our New York office at least three days per week to work with stakeholders and foster team collaboration. 

 What you'll do: 

 Lead and grow the Data Engineering team. Coach engineers, set clear expectations, create development opportunities, and build a culture of ownership, accountability, and technical excellence.

 Raise the operational bar. Improve observability, alerting, runbooks, incident response, service-level expectations, and recovery practices so problems are found and resolved before downstream teams lose trust.

 Reduce manual work. Identify repetitive and fragile operational processes, prioritize them by risk and effort, and automate the work that consumes engineering capacity.

 Modernize how the platform ships. Establish CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, testing, code review, documentation, and rollback practices for data pipelines and supporting infrastructure.

 Protect data quality from source to warehouse. Define standards for schemas, keys, grain, semantics, validation, lineage, backfills, and cutovers. Ensure source changes do not silently alter downstream metrics or models.

 Partner with Analytics Engineering and Data Science. Deliver reliable, well-documented platform inputs and agree on clear boundaries between ingestion, source normalization, business-facing marts, and analytical use cases.

 Make sound architecture tradeoffs. Evaluate batch, higher-frequency batch, and real-time patterns based on the business requirement, operational cost, and team capacity—not novelty.

 Communicate clearly. Give technical and business leaders a direct view of platform health, risks, priorities, tradeoffs, and progress.

 Use AI tools with judgment. Apply AI-assisted development and operational workflows where they improve quality and speed, while protecting sensitive data and owning the correctness of the output.

 Strong programming(preferred python and scala) and SQL experience in your background.

 Experience introducing or improving CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, code review, and secure deployment practices.

 Strong architectural judgment. You can distinguish a real scaling requirement from a process or reliability problem, and you prefer maintainable systems over unnecessary complexity.

 Experience defining ownership across Data Engineering, Backend Engineering, Infrastructure or SRE, Analytics Engineering, and downstream data consumers.

 Strong people leadership. You can develop experienced engineers, delegate meaningful ownership, give direct feedback, and hire thoughtfully as the team grows.

 Clear communication with both technical and non-technical partners. You can explain an incident, an architecture decision, or a delayed commitment without hiding the tradeoff in jargon.

 Sound judgment in a regulated environment, including secure data handling, least-privilege access, audit-ability, and change control.

jobs.title: Data Engineer II

Cybersecurity is an exciting, evolving space, and being at the forefront of the fight to disrupt cybercrime makes SpyCloud a special place to work. If you’re driven to align your career with a fantastic mission, look no further!

 This Data Engineer II role sits on the Engineering team, reporting to the Senior Director of Data Engineering. Your focus will include evolving our data platform using technologies such as Databricks and Spark, building scalable data pipelines, and serving customers through purpose-built data stores including RDS, Elasticsearch, and DynamoDB. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with ownership of complex data engineering initiatives that support the scalability, reliability, and continued evolution of SpyCloud’s data platform.

 What You'll Do: 

 Design, build, and improve scalable data systems with a focus on performance, and reliability.

 Use Databricks and Spark to prepare, transform, and serve high-quality data to customers and downstream systems.

 Build, optimize, and maintain real-time and batch data pipelines using AWS technologies such as Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, ECS, EKS, and Terraform, as well as develop and maintain pipelines within the Databricks ecosystem.

 Identify and implement improvements to the cost and performance of data ingestion, transformation, and storage workflows.

 Be available for on-call support to troubleshoot and remediate data pipeline failures outside of standard business hours.

 Partner with Product Management, SpyCloud Labs, and Engineering teams to understand requirements and develop effective technical solutions.

 Evaluate and implement modern tooling for data processing, ML/AI data workflows, and observability.

 Contribute to architectural and technical design decisions and help implement scalable solutions aligned with engineering standards.

 Promote engineering best practices through collaboration, code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

 Identify and resolve complex data quality, performance, security, and reliability issues across production systems.

 Independently own complex data engineering initiatives from design and development through deployment and production support.

 Contribute to the continued evolution of SpyCloud’s data platform as product, customer, and AI requirements grow.

 Requirements: 

 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering, software engineering, or a closely related discipline.

 Experience building and operating Lakehouse, Databricks, or large-scale distributed data architectures in AWS.

 Strong understanding of distributed systems as they relate to data storage, processing, and computing.

 Experience building and managing Elasticsearch/OpenSearch data stores.

 Hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining ETL and data-processing pipelines.

 Experience preparing and managing data for machine learning and LLM workflows.

 Strong development skills in Python, particularly when building data-intensive systems.

 Practical experience with DynamoDB and other AWS-native data services.

 Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform.

 Experience troubleshooting complex data pipeline, performance, and data quality issues in production environments.

 Ability to independently own complex technical projects from design and development through deployment and production support.

 Ability to evaluate technical trade-offs and contribute effectively to architectural and design decisions.

 Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 Understanding of data governance, privacy, and compliance considerations within AI and ML environments.

 Experience with observability and monitoring tools for large-scale data platforms.

 Experience with Go or C programming languages.

 Experience working with cybersecurity or security-related datasets and technologies.

 Comfort working in fast-paced environments with evolving product and technical requirements.

 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related STEM field.

 Base Salary Range: $104,000 – $135,000

 U.S.-Based Benefits + Perks (for Full Time Employees):

Guided by our core values in all business decisions, we prioritize unity in our mission and ensure all SpyCloud employees have the support and benefits they need to stay focused on our goals. In addition to our engaging workspace in South Austin, flexible and remote-friendly work options, and competitive salary package, we offer our employees a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

 Health Savings Account (HSA) available with Employer Contribution

 About SpyCloud: 

 SpyCloud transforms recaptured darknet data to disrupt cybercrime. Its automated identity threat protection solutions use advanced analytics and AI to accelerate investigations and protect workforce, consumer, and supplier identities from the threats that matter most: authentication bypass, session hijacking, malicious insiders, account takeover, ransomware, and fraud. Its data from malware-infected devices, successful phishes, combolists, and third-party breaches also powers many popular dark web monitoring and identity theft protection offerings. Customers include 7 of the Fortune 10, along with hundreds of global enterprises, mid-sized companies, and government agencies worldwide. Headquartered in Austin, TX, SpyCloud is home to more than 250 cybersecurity experts whose mission is to protect businesses and consumers from the stolen identity data criminals are using to target them now.

To learn more and see insights on your company's exposed data, visit spycloud.com .

 Our Mission: 

 Our mission is to make the internet a safer place by disrupting the criminal underground. Together with our customers and partners, we aim to end criminals’ ability to profit from stolen information.

 Who We Are: 

 SpyCloud is a place for innovative, collaborative, and problem-solvers to thrive. Individually, we’re amazing, but together, we’re unstoppable. Women, minorities, individuals with disabilities, and protected veterans are encouraged to apply. SpyCloud complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment.  Our culture is something really special. We’re all driven to disrupt the cybercriminal economy as we keep customer accounts safe from compromise. We support a truly worthy and serious mission, but we have fun doing it together. If you are driven, inventive, and collaborative, you’ll fit right in.
