jobs.title: Data & AI Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
【 About the company 】 

 At Tomofun, we LOVE pets and technology. Our vision is to bring joy and innovation to every pet lover in the world.

 We are pioneers in the pet tech industry. Our debut product, Furbo - the world's first AIoT treat-tossing pet camera, is the #1 bestseller on Amazon in 15 countries, including the US, UK, and JP and have millions of users in 133 countries. In 2019, we launched an AI-powered subscription service, the Furbo Pet Nanny, which sends smart alerts to our users to notify them to check on the safety of their furbabies when they are home alone. Since the launch of Furbo Pet Nanny, we have saved hundreds of pets' lives and are continuing to innovate and develop new features with our state-of-the-art technology.

 The learning curve is steep. But the work is exhilarating. Tomofun is on the cusp of a pet-tech boom and we’re looking for smart, innovative thinkers who aspire to incredible things.

 > Know more about us: furbo.com | LinkedIn | Medium Tech Blog 

 【 About the role 】 
Our centralized Data Team is building an Agentic Data Ecosystem : a unified semantic layer, a User 360 foundation, and AI agents that help teams across the company get answers from data without waiting on an analyst.
As a Data & AI Engineering Intern , you'll work directly with our data engineers, analytics engineers, and data scientists on three hands-on areas. You'll use AI agents to automate data collection, keep our ingestion pipelines healthy, and help make our internal Analytics Agents more accurate. This isn't a "make coffee and watch" internship. What you build will be used by marketing, growth, and product teams across our global offices.

 【 What You'll Do 】 

 AI-powered data collection: Use AI tools and agents (e.g. Claude, browser automation, scheduled workflows) to set up recurring collection of marketing data, including from advertising and e-commerce platforms that don't offer a public API.

 Data ingestion & cleaning pipelines: Maintain and monitor ingestion and cleaning pipelines in Databricks. Investigate failed jobs, fix schema changes caused by upstream platform updates, and help catch data discrepancies before stakeholders do.

 Agent answer quality: Review and tag question–answer pairs from our internal Analytics Agents, build evaluation sets, and help fine-tune prompts, semantic definitions, and knowledge sources to improve answer accuracy.

 Documentation: Write clear runbooks and notes for the pipelines and agent workflows you work on, so the team can build on them after your internship.

 【 Our Stack 】 

 Databricks on AWS (lakehouse, pipelines, Genie / Agent Bricks)

 Python and SQL 

 Amplitude (product and marketing analytics)

 Tableau (stakeholder reporting)

 Claude and other AI agents / MCP-based tools

 Git-based version control

 【 Required Qualifications 】 

 Currently pursuing (or recently completed) a degree in Computer Science , Computer Engineering, Information Management, or a related field.

 Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to build or automate something real, not just for chat. Please share an example in your application.

 Working knowledge of Python , and basic SQL .

 Strong learning ability: comfortable picking up new tools and platforms quickly, and figuring things out from documentation.

 Attention to detail and a habit of checking whether data "looks right."

 Able to commit 2–3 days per week for at least 3 months .

 Good communication in Mandarin and English (reading and writing technical English is essential).

 【 Preferred Qualifications 】 

 Experience with web scraping or browser automation (e.g. Playwright, Selenium, Puppeteer).

 Exposure to ETL/ELT concepts, data pipelines, or cloud data platforms (Databricks, Spark, BigQuery, Snowflake).

 Experience building or evaluating LLM applications: prompt engineering, RAG, agent frameworks, or LLM evaluation.

 Familiarity with digital advertising platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok, Amazon Ads).

 Personal projects or GitHub repos that show how you build and learn.

 【 What You'll Gain 】 

 Real ownership of production data work, with mentorship from an experienced data team.

 Hands-on experience applying AI agents to data engineering and analytics, a skill set most companies are only starting to build.

 Exposure to a global consumer IoT + subscription business across marketing, growth, and product.

 An opportunity to extend up to 12 months based on performance and team needs.

 【 Perks 】 

 Work with an international team at our Taiwan HQ on problems with global impact.

 An open, transparent working environment where your ideas are heard.

 Pet-friendly office: bring your fur babies to work!

 A LOT of free snacks and drinks for humans and furkids.

 Afternoon tea twice a month and monthly birthday parties.

 【 Why Join Us? 】 

 See how a modern data team uses AI agents in production, not just in demos.

 Build things that marketing and product teams across the world will use.

 Join a collaborative, high-trust team that cares about quality and learning.

 If you love building with AI, learn fast, and want to turn messy real-world data into something useful, we'd love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer, Associate
jobs.description:
About TPG 

 TPG is a leading global alternative asset management firm, founded in San Francisco in 1992, with operational teams around the world. TPG invests across a broadly diversified set of strategies, including private equity, impact, credit, real estate, and market solutions, and our unique strategy is driven by collaboration, innovation, and inclusion. Our teams combine deep product and sector experience with broad capabilities and expertise to develop differentiated insights and add value for our fund investors, portfolio companies, management teams, and communities.

 TPG’s success depends on our people, and we build and sustain our world-class team by creating an inclusive, supportive culture within the firm that seeks excellence and encourages humility and transparency. The quality of our investments and our ability to build great companies depend on the originality of our insights. Reaching our firm’s full potential means supporting every team member to bring the fullness of their unique perspective to their work and to our community. We are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace to foster diversity of thought and reflect the breadth of our limited partners and portfolio companies. 

 Description of Position 

 TPG is looking for an Analytics Engineer who can build analytics solutions from the ground up — from data ingestion through data modeling to final analytics delivery. This role will sit within our Analytics Engineering team and is ideal for someone who has experience owning the full lifecycle of a data solution, working across modern tools like Power BI and Databricks AI/BI, and translating raw data into trusted, decision-ready insights.

 Principal Responsibilities 

 Build reliable, scalable, and high-performance data solutions to deliver trusted datasets, semantic layers, and AI-ready data.

 Drive the evolution of data solutions delivery by adopting AI-enabled tools and practices that modernize workflows and scale team operations.

 Uses AI Tools like Claude, Chat GPT, etc. to improve development efficiency, provide powerful data insights, and

 Design, develop, and implement Business Intelligence solutions using tools such as Power BI and Databricks AI/BI.

 Maintain and develop ETL/ELT frameworks for structured and semi-structured data sourced from SQL databases, APIs, SaaS applications, and Data Lake Storage.

 Implement transformation logic using PySpark, SQL, and Delta Lake within a Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture.

 Partner with Finance, Accounting, and front-office stakeholders to understand reporting and analytics needs and translate them into scalable data solutions.

 Ensure data quality, consistency, and reconciliation accuracy across source systems and downstream reporting layers.

 Document data flows, models, and pipelines to support audit readiness and knowledge continuity.

 Requirements 

 Minimum 3-4 years of relevant experience in data analytics, BI development, or data engineering.

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field.

 Solid expertise with SQL Server, Power BI, Excel, and AI/BI tools.

 Solid experience with data modeling (dimensional modeling, semantic layers, or similar).

 Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT development across SQL, APIs, SaaS platforms, and Data Lake Storage.

 Familiarity with PySpark, Delta Lake, and Medallion architecture concepts is strongly preferred.

 Strong analytical mindset with the ability to work independently on end-to-end data solutions.

 Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Experience with the transition from traditional Data Solutions teams to advanced, AI-enabled teams, actively leveraging tools to modernize and scale operations

 Experience with Databricks as a core analytics/ETL platform.

 Exposure to financial services, Treasury, or fund administration data (e.g., Investran, Workday, Geneva, GTreasury).

 Experience supporting audit-ready or compliance-sensitive reporting environments.

 TPG is an equal employment opportunity employer that provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to age, race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender (including gender identity and expression), alienage or citizenship status, military or veteran status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy status, breastfeeding (or related medical conditions), familial status, caregiver status, or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.description:
Who is Trace3 ?

 Trace3 is a leading Transformative IT Authority, providing unique technology solutions and consulting services to our clients. Equipped with elite engineering and dynamic innovation, we empower IT executives and their organizations to achieve competitive advantage through a process of Integrate, Automate, Innovate.

 Our culture at Trace3 embodies the spirit of a startup with the advantage of a scalable business. Employees can grow their career and have fun while doing it!

 Trace3 is headquartered in Irvine, California. We employ more than 1,200 people all over the United States. Our major field office locations include Denver, Indianapolis, Grand Rapids, Lexington, Los Angeles, Louisville, Texas, San Francisco. 

 Ready to discover the possibilities that live in technology? 

 Come Join Us! 

 Street-Smart - Thriving in Dynamic Times 

 We are flexible and resilient in a fast-changing environment. We continuously innovate and drive constructive change while keeping a focus on the “big picture.” We exercise sound business judgment in making high-quality decisions in a timely and cost-effective manner. We are highly creative and can dig deep within ourselves to find positive solutions to different problems.

 Juice - The “Stuff” it takes to be a Needle Mover 

 We get things done and drive results. We lead without a title, empowering others through a can-do attitude. We look forward to the goal, mentally mapping out every checkpoint on the pathway to success, and visualizing what the final destination looks and feels like.

 Teamwork - Humble, Hungry and Smart 

 We are humble individuals who understand how our job impacts the company's mission. We treat others with respect, admit mistakes, give credit where it’s due and demonstrate transparency. We “bring the weather” by exhibiting positive leadership and solution-focused thinking. We hug people in their trials, struggles, and failures – not just their success. We appreciate the individuality of the people around us.

 * This position will be a W2 Contract for 6 months potential to be extended or converted FTE - Eligibility to obtain Government clearance 

JOB SUMMARY: 

 The Regional Senior Principal Engineer/Enterprise Architect IV serves serves as a customer-facing technical lead for the discovery, architecture, design, and modernization of secure on-premises and hybrid datacenter environments. The role translates mission objectives, business requirements, workload needs, operational constraints, and security obligations into practical, supportable architectures for regulated and mission-critical customers.

 The role requires broad, hands-on architecture knowledge across compute, networking, storage, virtualization, containers, automation, cybersecurity, Zero Trust Architecture, AI infrastructure, and Microsoft GCC-High hybrid-cloud solutions. Success requires strong technical judgment, analytical and project-management skills, executive presence, and the ability to communicate effectively with customers, engineers, partners, and sales teams.

 SUMMARY OF ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS: 

 Serve as the senior, customer-facing technical lead for datacenter discovery, architecture, design, modernization, and solution shaping engagements.

 Lead structured workshops with executive sponsors, engineering, infrastructure, platform, cybersecurity, compliance, program-management, and application stakeholders.

 Translate mission objectives, user and workload requirements, performance targets, availability goals, growth expectations, recovery objectives, and regulatory constraints into actionable architectures.

 Develop and communicate end-to-end modern datacenter architectures spanning compute, accelerated/GPU compute, network, storage, backup and disaster recovery, virtualization, containers, shared services, observability, and operational management.

 Design hybrid-cloud solutions integrating on-premises environments with Microsoft Azure Government and Microsoft GCC-High while addressing identity, secure connectivity, data protection, workload placement, governance, compliance, and operational boundaries.

 Apply Zero Trust Architecture and defense-in-depth principles across identity, access, segmentation, endpoint and workload protection, encryption, key and certificate management, logging, observability, vulnerability management, and security operations.

 Perform capacity planning, workload placement, performance analysis, resiliency planning, technology evaluation, lifecycle planning, and migration or modernization planning for current and target environments.

 Produce reference architectures, high-level and detailed designs, diagrams, sizing inputs, bills of materials, implementation roadmaps, controls mappings, assumptions, risks, and decision records.

 Present complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences; lead architecture reviews, whiteboarding sessions, demonstrations, proposal responses, statements of work, and executive briefings.

 REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: 

 Demonstrated experience as a customer-facing technical lead, enterprise architect, solutions architect, principal engineer, or equivalent for complex datacenter or infrastructure modernization initiatives.

 Substantive architecture experience across the modern datacenter stack, including x86 compute, accelerated/GPU compute, servers, HCI or converged infrastructure, switching and routing, storage, backup and disaster recovery, virtualization, containers, management platforms, monitoring, and physical datacenter considerations.

 Strong knowledge of virtualization architecture, including VMware vSphere, Microsoft Hyper-V, or comparable hypervisor technologies; clustering, high availability, resource management, encryption, lifecycle management, and migration considerations.

 Working knowledge of Kubernetes and enterprise container platforms, including control-plane and worker-node design, registries, namespaces, resource isolation, cluster operations, and platform security.

 Strong networking knowledge, including Ethernet and high-speed datacenter fabrics, VLANs, VRFs, routing, segmentation, out-of-band management, microsegmentation, software-defined networking, and network performance for AI and data-intensive workloads.

 Strong storage and data-protection knowledge across block, file, and object storage; all-flash and scale-out architectures; RAID or erasure coding; performance tiers; backup, replication, disaster recovery, and recovery objectives.

 Practical experience with infrastructure automation and lifecycle management using technologies such as Terraform, Ansible, APIs, configuration-management platforms, CI/CD, GitOps, and policy-driven provisioning.

 Applied knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture, including identity and federation, MFA, RBAC/ABAC, privileged access, microsegmentation, endpoint and workload protection, encryption in transit and at rest, PKI, HSM/KMS concepts, SIEM integration, observability, and vulnerability management.

 Experience designing or integrating hybrid-cloud architectures involving Microsoft Azure Government and Microsoft GCC-High, including secure connectivity, identity, workload placement, data protection, governance, and operational integration with on-premises environments.

 Ability to conduct structured discovery, assess current-state environments, identify gaps and risks, estimate capacity and growth, and convert findings into reference architectures and actionable roadmaps.

 Excellent written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and technical-diagramming skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers, executives, engineers, cybersecurity professionals, program managers, partners, and sales teams.

 Ability to work across multiple technology domains without relying solely on a single-vendor specialty; relevant vendor certifications or equivalent hands-on expertise are desirable.

 Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, travel to customer or partner locations as needed, and maintain technical credibility throughout the sales, design, and delivery lifecycle.

 Initial 6‑month contract with strong potential for extension and possible conversion to a long-term full-time role.

 No active clearance required at start; however, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain a security clearance.

 Hybrid environment with on-site requirements still being finalized.

 Work may be performed at multiple Baltimore-area customer locations, and candidates should be flexible regarding worksite assignment and on-site frequency.

 LOCATION: Full Time/ On-Site in Linthicum Heights, MD or Annapolis Junction, MD

 CLEARANCE REQUIRMENT: Eligibility to obtain Government clearance 

 SALARY RANGE: $185,001 to $198,458.50

 PHYSICAL DEMANDS: 

 The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

 While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to:

 Remain in a stationary position for extended periods of time.

 Operate a computer, keyboard, and other office equipment using hands and fingers.

 Communicate effectively in person, over the phone, and through electronic means.

 Occasionally move about the office to access files, office equipment, and meeting spaces.

 Lift and/or move up to 15 pounds as needed.

 Maintain specific vision abilities, including close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

 Actual salary will be based on a variety of factors, including location, experience, skill set, performance, licensure and certification, and business needs. The range for this position in other geographic locations may differ. Certain positions may also be eligible for variable incentive compensation, such as bonuses or commissions, that is not included in the base salary.
 Estimated Pay Range
 $165,000 — $185,000 USD 

 The Perks 

 Comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans for you and your dependents

 401(k) Retirement Plan with Employer Match, 529 College Savings Plan, Health Savings Account, Life Insurance, and Long-Term Disability

 Competitive Compensation

 Training and development programs

 Major offices stocked with snacks and beverages

 Collaborative and cool culture

 Work-life balance and generous paid time off

 Our Commitment 

 At the core of Trace3's DNA is our people. We are a diverse group of talented individuals who understand the importance of teamwork and demonstrating leadership, character, and passion in all that we do.

 We’re committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to grow. We recognize that embracing diversity drives innovation, improves outcomes, fosters collaboration, boosts teammate satisfaction, and builds a more inclusive culture.

 As an equal opportunity employer, Trace3 bases all employment decisions based on individual qualifications, merit, and business requirements. We do not engage in discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation, and pregnancy), national origin, age (40 or older), disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

 Any demographic information provided is strictly voluntary, kept confidential in accordance with Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) regulations, and will not be used in employment decisions, including hiring, promotions, or mentorship programs. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all.

 If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete the application process or participate in an interview, please email recruiting@trace3.com .

 OUR MISSION 

 True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

 OUR VALUES

 Fuel for your day: Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks for in-office employees

 And more: 401(k) retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, and Dog Fridays

 Equity participation: Equity is included as part of our total compensation package, giving you an opportunity to share in the company’s success.

 *Do not apply to fixed term and temporary roles

 YOUR MISSION 

 We are seeking highly motivated Data and Control Systems Test Engineers to design, build, and operate the instrumentation, data acquisition, and test control systems that enable spacecraft testing. You will work closely with test engineers across all disciplines to define instrumentation requirements, develop data acquisition architectures, design and implement automated test control systems, and deliver high-quality test data for engineering analysis. In this role, you will architect DAQ systems for complex test campaigns, develop test automation and sequencing software, commission and calibrate instrumentation, troubleshoot hardware and software integration issues, and ensure test data integrity and traceability. This position offers an excellent opportunity to build mission-critical test infrastructure in a fast-paced, hands-on environment. 

 RESPONSIBILITIES 

 Design and implement data acquisition systems for propulsion, fluids, mechanical, avionics, and environmental test campaigns including sensor selection, signal conditioning, and DAQ hardware architecture. 

 Develop automated test control and sequencing software using LabVIEW, Python, MATLAB, or similar platforms to enable safe, repeatable, and efficient test execution. 

 Define instrumentation requirements and sensor layouts in collaboration with test engineers to ensure full test objective coverage and requirements traceability. 

 Commission, calibrate, and validate instrumentation and DAQ systems prior to test campaigns, including end-to-end checkout and uncertainty analysis. 

 Develop real-time monitoring displays, safety interlocks, and automated abort logic for hazardous test operations. 

 Perform post-test data processing, analysis, and visualization to support engineering disposition and requirements verification. 

 Troubleshoot DAQ hardware, instrumentation, control system software, and network connectivity issues during test operations. 

 Establish and maintain data management processes including file naming conventions, metadata standards, archival procedures, and configuration control for test data. 

 Interface with avionics, software, and systems engineering teams to integrate spacecraft telemetry and command interfaces into ground test systems. 

 QUALIFICATIONS 

 Bachelor's degree in electrical, computer, aerospace, mechanical engineering, computer science, or related technical discipline. 

 Years of relevant experience in data acquisition, test automation, instrumentation, or control systems engineering for aerospace, defense, or high-reliability test environments in line with engineering level. 

 Hands-on experience with data acquisition hardware (National Instruments, Keysight, HBM,etc.) and software platforms (LabVIEW, MATLAB, Python) 

 Strong programming skills in at least one language commonly used for test automation(Python, LabVIEW, MATLAB, C/C++). 

 Working knowledge of instrumentation including pressure transducers, thermocouples, load cells, strain gauges, accelerometers, and flow meters. 

 Experience with signal conditioning, analog and digital I/O, and measurement uncertainty analysis. 

 Strong troubleshooting skills for hardware and software integration issues in test environments. 

 Excellent communication and collaboration skills with ability to work across multidisciplinary test teams. 

 U.S. Citizenship required due to government contracts. 

 PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 

 Master's degree in electrical, computer, or aerospace engineering. 

 Experience with real-time control systems, PLC programming, or embedded systems development. 

 Familiarity with spacecraft avionics interfaces, telemetry protocols, and command and data handling systems. 

 Experience with high-speed data acquisition, video synchronization, or distributed DAQ architectures. 

 Knowledge of Ethernet-based instrumentation protocols (Modbus TCP, EtherCAT, PROFINET). 

 Experience with version control (Git), continuous integration, and software development best practices for test systems. 

 Familiarity with hazardous test operations including propulsion testing, high-pressure systems, or environmental chambers. 

 Experience with test data analysis tools and visualization platforms (Grafana, Tableau, custom dashboards). 

 Background in systems engineering, requirements verification, or test planning. 

 Active Secret or Top Secret clearance. 

 COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS 

 Base Salary: 

 Test Engineer 3: $125,000-$155,000 

 Senior Test Engineer: $140,000-$175,000

 Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave 

 Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience. 

 ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS 

 Work Location — this a fully onsite position based out of our Long Beach, CA office. 

 Work environment —the work environment; temperature, noise level, inside or outside, or other factors that will affect the person's working conditions while performing the job.

 Physical demands —the physical demands of the job, including bending, sitting, lifting and driving.

 This position will be open until it is successfully filled. To submit your application, please follow the directions below. #LI-Onsite 
 To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Twin Health 

 At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health. 

 We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

 Working here 

 Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

 Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

 With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

 Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

 Opportunity 

 We are looking for a Product Analytics Associate Engineer to join our Data Platform team, supporting the data-driven insights and product analytics that directly improve member outcomes and Care Team effectiveness. This is a great opportunity to grow at the intersection of product, data, and healthcare — working alongside our Data Engineering and Product Analytics team to help translate Member and Care Team data into actionable insights, while building deep, hands-on experience with modern analytics engineering practices. You'll partner with Product Managers, Area owners, Care Team leads, and Data Engineers, with support and mentorship from senior team members as you grow into greater ownership of your own product areas.

 Responsibilities 

 Assist Product Managers and Area owners with data pulls, ad hoc analysis, and basic reporting to support their day-to-day decision-making

 Help set up and monitor A/B tests — building tracking queries, checking data quality during test runs, and summarizing results for senior team members to review

 Write and maintain SQL queries and dbt models for specific, well-scoped tables and metrics, with code review and guidance from senior analytics engineers

 Build and update components of dashboards and reports in our BI tools (e.g., adding a new metric, fixing a broken visualization) under the direction of senior team members

 Help track and report on established KPIs across product areas — member engagement, CGM utilization, Care Team effectiveness — using existing frameworks and definitions

 Learn our data architecture by working closely with Data Engineers, asking questions, and gradually taking on small pipeline tasks

 Run data quality checks on assigned datasets and flag anomalies or inconsistencies to the team

 Practice communicating findings clearly in team meetings and written summaries, building toward more stakeholder-facing work over time

 Contribute to documentation (data dictionaries, metric definitions) for the models and reports you work on

 Ask questions, seek feedback, and take initiative in identifying small improvements to existing processes

 Other duties as assigned

 Qualifications 

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, or related field

 1–3 years of experience in product analytics, data analytics, or a similar role (internships and co-ops count)

 Solid SQL skills — comfortable writing joins, aggregations, and window functions; eager to deepen query complexity and optimization skills

 Some exposure to dbt (data build tool) or a strong willingness to learn data modeling and transformation practices quickly

 Familiarity with cloud data warehouses — Snowflake preferred, though experience with any modern warehouse (BigQuery, Redshift, etc.) is welcome

 Strong analytical curiosity — a genuine interest in connecting data to real product and business decisions

 Good communication skills and a collaborative mindset — comfortable asking questions and learning from senior teammates

jobs.title: (Senior) Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
(Senior) Analytics Engineer

 TubeScience Labs: Los Angeles, in person — $110,000–$165,000 

 TubeScience Labs' mission is to create trusted, scalable, and self-improving AI systems that power the largest performance-based paid social creative video company in the world.

 TubeScience is Meta's largest creative partner and AppLovin's #1 creative partner, producing 8,000+ original ads every month from a 100,000 sq. ft. Los Angeles studio, backed by a library of 1.6 million+ performance ads and $3B in annual managed ad spend. That is what gives TubeScience one of the richest first-party creative-performance datasets anywhere.

 Labs turns that data — and the playbook behind billions in spend — into frontier AI tools that actually ship. We are an AI-native lab working end to end, from research and design to coding, experimentation and delivery. Our pipelines run against real creative, real deadlines, and real budgets every day.

 You'll join a small, AI-empowered, senior team of engineers and product managers, with direct access to expert users and full ownership of the systems you build. You'll be expected to use the latest frontier and open-weight models in every phase of the job, from discovery and prototyping to building, testing and deployment.

 The role

 You'll build the data systems that connect ad performance to creative decisions. Our platform brings together data from advertising channels, creative production workflows and business operations, and your work makes that data reliable, understandable and useful in reports, internal products, and future analytics and machine learning applications.

 The role is hands-on across the whole data lifecycle: extracting data from APIs, maintaining dependable pipelines, modeling data in Snowflake, defining metrics, and delivering insights through Power BI and other tools. Much of the foundation already exists. You'll learn how its parts fit together, make it faster and more reliable, and help shape what we build next.

 We weigh directly relevant experience heavily. This platform carries real advertising data and feeds the reporting the business runs on from the first week, so tell us plainly where your background maps: advertising data, warehouse modeling, pipelines or BI.

 We are open to hiring at Analytics Engineer or Senior Analytics Engineer level, depending on experience and scope of ownership.

 Responsibilities

 Build and evolve the data platform, from external sources through ingestion, transformation and curated models to BI and application delivery

 Extract and integrate advertising data from Meta, TikTok, Google and Snapchat using their APIs and Python, handling pagination, rate limits, backfills, schema changes and reconciliation with the platforms

 Build performant Snowflake models, and define and document the metrics the business relies on together with stakeholders

 Maintain and improve Power BI reporting, including a possible migration to a better BI tool, and build datasets that link ad outcomes to creative strategy and production decisions

 Investigate discrepancies and pipeline failures, add checks and observability, and use agents to automate the repetitive work

 Work with data, product, engineering and business partners on analytics and machine learning approaches that feed ad performance back into creative development

 Minimum qualifications

 You have 5+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering or a closely related role, with meaningful ownership of production data systems.

 You have worked with advertising or marketing performance data, ideally pulling it directly from platforms such as Meta, TikTok, Google or Snapchat.

 You are strong in SQL and Python, and you can reason through the full path from a source API to a business-facing metric or report.

 You have designed data models and warehouse architecture that support changing business needs, including layered approaches such as medallion architecture where useful.

 You have built or maintained orchestrated pipelines, and you understand failure recovery, backfills, data quality and operational reliability.

 You have developed Power BI reports or semantic datasets, and you have worked with stakeholders to resolve ambiguous metric definitions.

 You are comfortable with GitHub-based development, code review, and cloud infrastructure on AWS or GCP. 

 You investigate problems independently, make practical engineering decisions, and explain the trade-offs to technical and business partners alike.

 Preferred qualifications

 You have worked on creative analytics, attribution or cross-platform performance measurement.

 You have optimized Snowflake or Databricks performance, including dynamic tables.

 You have used transformation tools such as Coalesce and orchestration tools such as DBOS or Airflow.

 You have built datasets or features for internal applications, experimentation or machine learning.

 You use AI-assisted development fluently, while applying your own judgment to system design, correctness and production changes.

 The problems to solve

 Advertising data from many platforms. Meta, TikTok, Google and Snapchat, each with its own API, limits and quirks, reconciled with what the platforms themselves report.

 A platform that grows with the business. Architectural choices that still hold as data volumes and use cases grow.

 Metrics people trust. Consistent definitions across advertising, creative, client and operational data, agreed with stakeholders and documented.

 Reporting that connects ads to creative. Datasets that show which creative decisions actually moved performance.

 Reliability without the toil. Fewer surprises in the pipelines, with agents handling the repetitive checks.

 Feedback loops. Analytics and machine learning that feed ad performance back into creative development.

 How the hiring works

 Three conversations and a short piece of practical work. Recruiter screen, then an engineer from the team, then a practical assignment and a walkthrough with the hiring manager. Roughly 17 business days end to end if we both move quickly. You will get a decision either way at every stage.

Job Title: Senior Data Engineer 

 Department: Product Development 

 About the Role : The Senior Data Engineer designs, builds, and maintains scalable data architecture and infrastructure that supports Unite Us’ business objectives and the needs of both healthcare and social care clients. As part of a collaborative team of talented engineers, this role partners closely with Application Engineers, Product Managers, and cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, high-quality data solutions, including ETL pipelines and data warehouse integrations. This work is critical to collecting, processing, and delivering data to internal and external stakeholders, enabling informed investment decisions, quantifying the value and ROI of Unite Us networks, and supporting continued organizational growth across healthcare and social care domains. The Senior Data Engineer champions data integrity and accessibility, contributes to system architecture and technical best practices, and provides operational support through customer onboarding and on-call participation—helping establish Unite Us as a trusted leader across the healthcare and social care landscape while making a meaningful impact nationwide.

 What You'll Do :

 Design / implement a data architecture and infrastructure aligned with business objectives

 Collaborate with Application Engineers, Product Managers, and Solutions Architects to ensure data systems or technical infrastructure support client and product requirements

 Develop, create, and maintain ETL processes and data pipeline solutions for efficient loading of data into the data warehouse

 Test, monitor, and optimize data pipelines or ETL solutions to ensure reliability, performance, and scalability

 Collect and validate high-quality data

 Ensure data integrity and maintain strong data governance standards

 Champion data democratization and enable or facilitate accessibility to well-documented data for relevant stakeholders

 Guide the team or engineering teams on technical or data engineering best practices

 Contribute to system or platform architecture

 Support operational activities such as onboarding new customers to data products

 Participate in team on-call rotations

 Partner or engage with cross-functional teams, including Solutions Delivery, Business Intelligence, Predictive Analytics, and Enterprise Services

 Address, resolve, or support data-related technical issues or requirement

 You’re a great fit for this role if :

 6–8+ years of experience designing, building, and operating data warehouses, data lakes, and ETL/ELT pipelines in production environments

 Proven experience building, designing, or optimizing data pipelines using Snowflake

 Experience using data transformation tools like DBT

 Proven expertise architecting and optimizing batch and streaming data pipelines

 Advanced SQL knowledge, including complex query authoring and familiarity with relational databases such as Snowflake, Redshift, and Postgres

 Strong proficiency in Python for building, optimizing, and maintaining data pipelines and services

 Experience with orchestration frameworks such as Apache Airflow

 Exposure to or experience with AWS and cloud services such as S3, ECS, and RDS, including building cloud-native data platforms

 Experience with CI/CD pipelines for testing, deployment, and release (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins)

 Experience with infrastructure and data tooling including Kubernetes, Terraform, and Docker

 Exposure to or experience with Kafka

 Experience developing or delivering data platforms or applications for large enterprise clients

 Background or previous engagement with healthcare and/or social determinants of health (SDOH) data products, including designing, building, or maintaining pipelines for healthcare claims and clinical data, with an understanding of data quality, scale, sensitivity, and compliance requirements in this space

 Experience designing high-performance, reliable systems, including exposure to operational best practices

 Exposure to or experience with data quality frameworks

 Experience supporting analytics, reporting, or data user tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, ThoughtSpot, Sigma)

 Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to identify, investigate, and resolve complex data issues and system failures, and to lead technical investigations

 Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional and non-technical stakeholders

 BS/BA degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

 Our Mission: 

 Unite Us’ mission is to unlock the potential of every community. Our co-founders started Unite Us in 2013 to serve the people they served with. ABOUT ROCKET MONEY 🔮 

 Rocket Money’s mission is to empower people to live their best financial lives. Rocket Money offers members a unique understanding of their finances and a suite of valuable services that save them time and money – ultimately giving them a leg up on their financial journey.

 ABOUT THE TEAM 🤝 

 The Analytics Engineering team's mission is to make data consistent, trustworthy, and easy to use. We build the dimensional models that power business decisions, and we own the integrity of the data those decisions rest on.

 We work in a semi-embedded structure: Analytics Engineers sit close to the Data Analyst teams they support while remaining part of a central Analytics Engineering practice. Day to day, that means translating business questions into technical requirements, modeling ingested source data into shapes the business can actually use, and partnering with engineering teams on the upstream data we depend on.

 We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help shape that architecture as it grows. You'll build and iterate on our star schema, surfacing models that Data Analysts and stakeholders across the business can self-serve against with confidence. Done well, this work raises the data literacy of the entire company — and we take that seriously.

 IN THIS ROLE, YOU'LL 🤹 

 Be a trusted builder, architect, and consultant on the analytics data we surface to our stakeholders. You'll learn the intricacies of our source data, how we transform it, how we monitor for integrity, and continue to move the needle on the partnership needed to maximize value for the business.

 You will:

 Design and build dimensional models that scale (we use dbt + BigQuery) 

 Translate ambiguous business questions into dimensions, facts, and grain decisions that hold up as the business changes

 Make tradeoffs between normalization, performance, and usability, and document the reasoning behind them

 Reduce technical debt in the dbt project: model layering, naming and testing standards, macro reuse, and incremental strategy

 Own data quality and monitoring for the models you build 

 Define what "correct" means for each model and instrument data quality checks to monitor it

 Build and improve the alerting and triage process so data issues are caught proactively

 Lead root-cause investigations on data discrepancies across the pipeline, from source event or system of record through to the analytics layer

 Partner with Data Engineering and product engineering teams on upstream contracts and instrumentation quality

 Be the connective tissue between source data and business definitions 

 Support technical definition of core business measurement and drive alignment when stakeholders disagree

 Partner with Data Analysts and BI to ensure models enable stakeholder self-service analysis

 Translate business needs into technical requirements and prioritize work against them

 Raise the bar on the team through code review, design review, and documentation

 ABOUT YOU 🦄 

 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or related roles.

 Deep data modeling expertise. You have designed dimensional models from scratch and integrated them into a cohesive analytics architecture to serve your stakeholders. You understand grain, SCD types, and fact table design tradeoffs.

 You can handle complex modeling scenarios, such as conforming dimensions across business use cases, modeling many-to-many relationships, handling late-arriving and restated data, and keeping models usable as the source systems evolve.

 You treat data quality as a design problem, not a cleanup task. You have built testing and monitoring into pipelines, defined SLAs or expectations with data owners, and managed the on-call/triage side of keeping data trustworthy.

 You judge your work by its usability to your stakeholders over the long-term, not just by speed of delivery, underlying architecture elegance, or immediate use case.

 Production dbt experience. You understand model materialization strategies, testing, macros, and how to keep a growing project maintainable.

 2+ years of experience with BI tools (Looker preferred) and an understanding of how modeling choices shape what's possible in the analytics layer.

 Strong cross-functional communication skills and the ability to influence stakeholder & business decisions.

 Strong problem decomposition: you can understand the underlying problem in requests that you receive and align them with our modeling roadmap and architecture.

 Bonus points if:

 You have worked with finance or financial services data — transactions, subscriptions, revenue recognition, ledgers, or reconciliation against a system of record.

 You have experience with our stack (BigQuery, dbt Cloud, Looker, Amplitude, DeepNote)

 You have experience with data governance, lineage, or catalog tooling

 You're familiar with Agile process & sprint cycles

 You have experience in mobile app or product analytics

 Our Stack 

 Sources and ingestion: Cloud SQL (MySQL) and BigQuery via GCP Datastream (CDC)

 Ingestion and CDC

 Build and maintain analytics-ready datasets that support self-serve reporting and experimentation

 Cross-functional delivery

jobs.description:
About Turing 

 Turing’s mission is to accelerate superintelligence to drive real economic progress. Headquartered in San Francisco, Turing works with frontier AI labs to generate high-quality datasets, reinforcement learning environments, and frontier research benchmarks that improve model capabilities in software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and advanced STEM reasoning. In software engineering, Turing is the largest and longest-running data provider in the category. Turing also works with Fortune 500 enterprises across financial services, life sciences, healthcare, retail, automotive, and CPG to build and deploy end-to-end agentic AI systems inside mission-critical workflows. By operating on both sides, Turing closes the loop between frontier research and enterprise deployment, turning real-world deployment signals into better data, evaluations, and more capable models. Learn more at www.turing.com . 

 Senior ML & Data Engineer — Data Quality & Sensitive Data Compliance 

 This is a full-time remote role based in Brazil or Colombia.

 About the role 

 Enterprise data flows through our connectors, gets processed, and passes through a sanitization layer before anything downstream touches it. Two things have to be true at every step: the data is what we think it is, and no sensitive information — PII, PHI, company identifiable information (CII), or financial data — gets through. You'll own both. You'll do this primarily by building the machine learning that detects sensitive entities in text and image data and replaces them consistently at scale.

 This is a hands-on IC engineering role with a QA mindset. You'll build the detection models, validation infrastructure, adversarial test sets, and audit processes that let us make strong claims about data quality and de-identification performance — and back them up with evidence. You'll work closely with a senior ML lead, with no client-facing responsibilities.

 What you'll do 

 Data Quality 

 Run deep dives into enterprise data to assess quality: topic coherence across connectors, domain depth within connectors, completeness, and consistency

 Design and automate validation suites for data pipelines — schema checks, completeness, drift detection, and reconciliation across raw → processed → sanitized stages

 Surface and characterize quality issues in ways that engineering and product can act on

 Sensitive data compliance (PII / PHI / CII / financial) 

 Design, train, and evaluate ML models (NER and other approaches) that detect sensitive entities across text and image-based documents such as scans, invoices, and presentations

 Build replacement pipelines that substitute detected entities with coherent alternatives, so the same entity always maps to the same replacement across every file in a corpus and the data stays useful

 Run these algorithms over large volumes of data to prepare it for downstream agentic task building

 Build adversarial test sets for de-identification across all sensitive data classes: edge cases, obfuscated identifiers, multilingual entities, OCR noise, and formats designed to slip past detectors

 Cover company identifiable information specifically — organization names and aliases, domains and email patterns, internal project and system names, org charts, vendor and partner relationships, contract terms, and any combination of details that could re-identify the source enterprise

 Cover financial data — account and routing numbers, card numbers, revenue and pricing figures, transaction records, tax IDs, and financial statements

 Measure and report de-identification performance by data class — entity-level precision and recall, leak rates, false-negative audits, and replacement consistency

 Implement regression gates in CI/CD so no pipeline change ships without passing data quality and sensitive-data checks

 Run sampling-based human-in-the-loop audits and maintain the audit trail as compliance evidence

 Partner with engineering on root-cause analysis when inconsistencies or leaks are found, and drive fixes to closure

 What we're looking for 

 About 4 to 5 years of hands-on machine learning experience, with ML as your primary background

 Strong Python for ML development and data validation (pytest, Great Expectations, Pandera, or similar)

 Solid SQL and experience validating data across pipeline stages

 Familiarity with sensitive data categories and the relevant standards — HIPAA Safe Harbor for PHI, GDPR/LGPD for PII, PCI DSS for cardholder data, and confidentiality/NDA obligations for company information

 Experience building and testing NER or other ML-based detection systems: building labeled eval sets, computing precision/recall, handling non-determinism

 Understanding of re-identification risk — how seemingly innocuous details combine to reveal an organization or individual

 Comfort with ambiguity and a fast-moving environment

 A skeptical, detail-oriented approach — you assume things are broken until you've proven otherwise

 Nice to have 

 Computer vision and OCR experience, especially building, scaling, and evaluating document pipelines for contracts, statements, invoices, presentations, and internal documents

 Hands-on experience with financial or healthcare data, including the privacy requirements specific to those industries

 Startup experience

 Auditing LLM or VLM outputs

 Synthetic sensitive-data generation (PII, PHI, company and financial records)

 Familiarity with the GCP data stack (BigQuery, GCS, Cloud Run jobs) and CI/CD integration

 Experience handling multi-tenant enterprise data with strict customer confidentiality requirements

 Compliance reporting or working with auditors

 Why this role matters 

 Our enterprise customers trust us with their data on the condition that it can never be traced back to them. Every downstream model, dashboard, and customer commitment depends on the data being clean and the sanitization layer being airtight. When you find a leak, you've prevented an incident. When you prove there isn't one, you've earned the trust that lets the rest of the company move fast.
 Values 

 We are client first: We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.

 We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection

 We are AI forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

 Advantages of joining Turing 

 Work at the frontier of AI , helping the world’s leading AI labs improve their most advanced models by building expert datasets, RL environments, and first-of-a-kind benchmarks.

 Contribute to leading-edge AI research and showcase your work at top conferences such as ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS.

 Bring frontier AI innovation to the enterprise , applying lessons learned from leading AI labs to solve real-world business challenges.

 Collaborate with and learn from exceptional colleagues with deep AI experience from Google, Meta, Amazon, and other leading technology companies.

 Move at the pace of AI innovation , with the speed, ownership, and impact of a startup.

 Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

 The Role 

 We are looking for a Research Engineer to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art models for a frontier AI lab client. You will work directly with the client's researchers and engineers, turning inbound requests and post-training goals into concrete technical proposals and data/environment specifications, and then owning the technical execution: building the quality and verification systems that ensure what we deliver meets extremely high standards for correctness, realism, diversity, difficulty, and measurable model lift.

 Most of this work is bespoke and custom, built for one client's evolving needs.You'll typically stay attached to a single frontier lab client so you can build real context and a working relationship with their team, with flexibility to support other accounts when needed. Because bespoke work is judged on both turnaround time and quality, both matter equally here.

 This role is designed for candidates with experience building and improving deep learning systems, especially where strong results depend on data quality, data curation, denoising, synthetic data generation, and rigorous evaluation. You'll operate in one or more of the following capability areas:

 Coding and software engineering agents (repositories, unit tests, debugging, tool use, code reviews, long-horizon workflows)

 RL environments and verifier-based training (tasks, rewards/verifiers, trajectories, evaluation harnesses)

 Multimodal data and reasoning (text + images + documents + tables/charts; optional audio/video)

 STEM reasoning (math, physics, chemistry, bio, engineering – solution verification and error analysis)

 Modern embodied AI / VLM-driven agents (vision-language(-action) models, embodied task suites, tool/sensor/action abstractions, long-horizon interaction data)

 What You'll Do 

 1) Own data and environment quality from an AI researcher perspective 

 Respond to inbound requests from the client and translate ambiguous, evolving research goals into a technical proposal and clear data requirements: target skills, failure modes, difficulty calibration, coverage, and success metrics.

 Provide the technical feasibility assessment, assumptions, acceptance criteria, and evaluation requirements needed to scope the contract or statement of work.

 Define what “good” looks like by creating detailed rubrics, counterexamples, and boundary cases (what to include vs. exclude).

 Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data: spot subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities, leakage, ambiguity, inconsistent assumptions, and distribution shifts.

 Drive iterative improvements using evidence: group failures (for example, by semantic similarity) to find the underlying gap, then turn that into concrete instructions for the production team — better few-shot examples, explicit counterexamples, clearer guidance on what's causing rejections.

 2) Design and build datasets and RL environments for your capability area(s) 

 Contribute to or lead the design of:

 Task suites (single-step and long-horizon workflows)

 Ground-truth signals (verifiers, unit tests, structured checks, reward functions, automatic validators)

 Environment interfaces (APIs, tool schemas, state abstractions, database schemas, simulator-like dynamics)

 Depending on your mapped capability area(s), you may focus on:

 Coding / SWE agents: data reflecting real development work (codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, tests, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, security fixes).

 Multimodality: tasks that test true multimodal reasoning (chart reading, document QA, UI understanding, diagram-based STEM reasoning, OCR-aware tasks).

 STEM: tasks with verifiable solutions (symbolic checks, reference solvers, numerical validation, step consistency, unit sanity).

 Modern embodied AI / VLM-driven agents: interaction data and environments for vision-language(-action) models.

 3) Build robust validation, denoising, and synthetic data systems 

 Build project-specific verification systems that combine deterministic checks, model-based evaluators calibrated against gold sets, and targeted human review.

 Implement automated validation and filtering to achieve frontier-grade signal-to-noise: deduplication, decontamination, leakage checks, consistency checks, difficulty and diversity controls.

 Develop synthetic data generation and augmentation pipelines where appropriate: programmatic task generators, controlled perturbations, scenario templating, simulator-/tool-driven rollouts.

 Create documentation and data cards: dataset intent, known limitations, recommended use, and evaluation linkage.

 4) Use evaluations and training runs to prove impact 

 Design and run evals that reflect the client's intended usage.

 Produce analysis that connects data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons, error breakdowns, ablations that identify which data attributes drive lift.

 When needed, run in-house fine-tuning or RL-style experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate that the data/environment improves model behavior in measurable ways.

 5) Collaborate effectively with large production teams without being ops-heavy 

 Give technical direction to the distributed expert network producing the data, by providing clear specs, examples, edge cases, and fast feedback loops based on audits and quantitative signals.

 You own technical translation, acceptance criteria, evaluator and verifier design, quality diagnosis, and the technical release recommendation. The Strategic Project Lead owns production execution, staffing, throughput, project cost, and recovery.

 You are expected to be highly engaged in reviewing and improving outputs from large annotation/creation efforts, but not primarily responsible for hiring, staffing, or people operations — that sits with the SPL.

 Communicate directly with the client on technical findings, quality risks, and recovery options. Align changes to scope, schedule, or external commitments with the account and delivery owners.

 Who We're Looking For 

 4–5 years of experience building or improving deep learning systems where data quality mattered materially (training, post-training, evals, or agentic systems).

 Strong intuition for the “data ingredients” that drive model improvements: what to collect, what to filter, what to synthesize, and how to measure.

 Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers: turning research objectives into concrete specs, and turning messy outputs into actionable insights.

 Comfortable being the direct technical point of contact for a client, including explaining setbacks or trade-offs when things don't go as planned.

 Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented in diagnosing subtle data quality issues and failure modes.

 Solid programming ability with a bias for shipping: Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL/structured data workflows strongly preferred; for coding-focused work, proficiency in a major language (e.g., C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) is a plus.

 Comfort designing quality systems: rubrics, validation scripts, gold sets, sampling strategies, statistical checks, slice-based evaluation, human-in-the-loop review loops grounded in measurable criteria.

 Direct experience with a frontier AI lab is not required, and is uncommon in the LATAM market — what matters most is hands-on engineering depth and the ability to operate with ambiguity.

 Strong pluses 

 RL or post-training experience (any of: RLHF/RLAIF, verifier training, reward modeling, RL fine-tuning, environment design).

 Experience with agentic evaluation (tool use, multi-step workflows, long-horizon tasks, trajectory analysis).

 Multimodal expertise (document understanding, charts, diagrams, OCR, UI/vision grounding; audio/video optional).

 STEM depth (math/physics/engineering) with an eye for verifiability and rigorous correctness.

 Modern embodied AI / VLM-driven agent experience (vision-language(-action) models, interaction datasets, embodied evals, long-horizon grounding, tool/sensor/action interfaces).

 Systems thinking: ability to “simulate” an application's API/data schema and design tasks that realistically reflect real-world constraints and workflows.

 Why Turing 

 Work directly with a frontier AI lab, at the cutting edge of post-training and RL environment design, embedded in a real research relationship rather than a rotating set of anonymous tasks.

 Real impact (path to AGI): your datasets and environments will directly influence the trajectory toward Artificial General Intelligence and, ultimately, Superintelligence.

 High autonomy and fast iteration, with a Strategic Project Lead handling scaling and resourcing so you can stay focused on the technical approach and quality bar.

 Talent-dense team, where you'll find rapid iteration and an exceptional learning curve.

 Formulate research questions that can inform Turing’s products, platforms, and technical strategy.

 Explore new approaches to synthetic and agentic data generation, reinforcement learning, post-training, model understanding, benchmarks, and evaluation.

 Iterate quickly from early hypothesis through validated technical insight.

 Communicate technical findings clearly to both specialized and cross-functional audiences.

 Contribute to Turing’s research culture through technical discussions, peer review, mentorship, and collaboration.

 Represent Turing thoughtfully within the broader AI research community.

jobs.description:
About Truveta 

 Truveta is the world's first health provider-led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta's ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a unique combination of health, software, and big data expertise who share our company values. 

 Location - Hyderabad, India. 

 This opportunity 

 Join the founding team of the Truveta India Development Center and play a pivotal role in shaping its future. As one of the early members, you will help build and scale a high-impact organization while contributing to the products and platforms that advance healthcare through data and AI. This is an unusual chance to influence both the technical direction and the culture of a growing global engineering hub. 

 Patients, doctors, and medical researchers deserve to benefit from the large-scale technological innovation and digital intelligence that have driven progress in other industries. In this position you will build online services, automation, and tooling that monitor Truveta's data and make sure it continues to meet our high-quality standards. The work calls for creative problem solving and a strong appetite for applying AI and machine learning to anomaly detection, supported by statistical methods, to monitor and reason over big data at scale. 

 Who we need 

 We are looking for software engineers who are excited by the opportunity to improve healthcare in far-reaching ways, and who sit comfortably at the boundary between production engineering and applied machine learning. You will design and ship services rather than notebooks, and you will be expected to explain why a given detection method suits a given data problem, how you evaluated it, and what its false-alert rate costs the people who receive its alerts. 

 Beyond core capabilities, we are seeking problem solvers, collaborative teammates, and people willing to roll up their sleeves while making a difference. You will learn the healthcare domain quickly, because the quality of clinical data cannot be judged without understanding what the data is meant to represent. 

 What you will do 

 In this role you will: 

 Build performant AI-based anomaly detection and monitoring systems, using machine learning and supporting statistical methods to analyze big data at scale. 

 Design, implement, test, deploy, operate , and tune the online services, automation, and tooling that monitor Truveta's data, contributing hands-on to every stage of the software development lifecycle. 

 Detect and characterize data-quality issues such as missing or late feeds, volume and distribution shifts, schema and contract drift, duplication, and implausible clinical values. 

 Develop and evaluate detection approaches, from statistical baselines and time-series methods through machine-learning models, and measure them on precision, recall, and alert usefulness rather than accuracy alone. 

 Turn detection output into signals people can act on: alerts with root-cause context, data-quality metrics, and dashboards that engineering and clinical teams trust. 

 Work with data-processing engineers to build quality checks into pipelines so that defects are caught where they are introduced. 

 Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product managers, clinical informaticists, architects, and other engineers to define what quality means for each data domain. 

 Take part in design reviews, code reviews, and the on-call rotation for the services you own. 

 Required qualifications 

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

 1 + of experience building production-quality services on a cloud platform such as Azure, AWS, or GCP. 

 2 + years writing Python for machine learning, AI-based data analytics, or statistical modeling. 

 Hands-on experience across the software development lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, operations, and performance. 

 Working knowledge of the statistics and model-evaluation methods that underpin that modeling work. 

 Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to learn a new domain quickly. 

 Clear written and spoken communication, and comfort collaborating across disciplines. 

 Preferred qualifications 

 Experience developing and evaluating AI or machine-learning approaches for anomaly detection, with supporting knowledge of statistical methods, time-series analysis, or data-quality monitoring. 

 Experience working as part of distributed teams, particularly across India and the United States. 

 Experience processing large datasets with Spark, Databricks, or comparable distributed frameworks, and strong SQL. 

 Experience running services on Microsoft Azure. 

 Familiarity with data-quality and observability tooling such as Great Expectations, Deequ , Soda, or equivalent in-house frameworks. 

 Experience operating machine-learning models in production, including drift monitoring and retraining. 

 Exposure to healthcare, clinical, or other regulated data.

jobs.description:
About Venn 

 Venn is the sovereign AI platform for real estate. We turn each company’s data, knowledge and way of operating into its own Company Brain, then build bespoke applications and AI agents on top of it to grow revenue, reduce costs and improve performance. The intelligence stays the customer’s proprietary asset and compounds over time.

 More than 270 owners and operators run on Venn across 30 states and five countries. Our customers include Related, Bozzuto and Kairoi Residential in the U.S. and Grand City Properties in Europe. Our platform is approaching one million homes, and our contracted revenue has more than quadrupled in the past year. Venn has raised over $140 million from investors including Group 11 and NOA, and recently acquired a16z-backed Zuma to accelerate our AI agents.

 Our mission is to make sure AI sharpens what makes a real estate company different, instead of erasing it. Come build it with us.

 About the role 

 We are looking for a hands-on Data Lead to build and own Venn’s data domain end-to-end.

 This is a key role for someone who combines strong engineering capabilities, deep data passion, product thinking, and business understanding. We are looking for a builder who can independently create the data infrastructure, deliver reliable dashboards and insights, support product and business decision-making, and turn data into a strategic asset for the company.

 This is not just a reporting or BI role. You will be responsible for building the data foundation that will support Venn’s next stage of growth- across infrastructure, product analytics, business insights, executive reporting, customer-facing analytics, and future AI-driven use cases.

 What you’ll do 

 Own Venn’s data domain end-to-end- from infrastructure and pipelines to dashboards, insights, and business impact.

 Build and maintain scalable data pipelines across product, finance, GTM, customer, and operational data sources.

 Design reliable data models and create a clear source of truth for key company metrics.

 Build business and executive dashboards that help leadership understand the state of the business.

 Analyze product usage, engagement, adoption, retention, feature performance, and customer value.

 Support Product, R&D, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and leadership with meaningful data insights.

 Translate business and product questions into clear data analysis and actionable recommendations.

 Work closely with R&D, while being technically independent and able to build and deliver solutions without relying on engineering support for every step.

 Define data standards, documentation, quality checks, metric definitions, and best practices.

 Use modern AI tools to accelerate data development, analysis, documentation, automation, and insight generation.

 Identify opportunities where Venn’s data can support smarter product experiences, automated insights, customer-facing analytics, and AI-supported decision-making.

 The must 

 6+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, BI, product analytics, or similar data roles.

 Strong hands-on development background- currently coding or previously worked as a developer / software engineer.

 Strong SQL skills and experience building data models, pipelines, and reporting layers.

 Experience working with modern data warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar.

 Ability to build data solutions independently, end-to-end, from technical design to implementation and delivery.

 Strong product and business understanding, with the ability to connect data to real company needs.

 Experience building dashboards, reporting layers, and business/product insights.

 Hands-on experience using AI tools as part of day-to-day technical work, analysis, development, or data workflows.

 Ability to work directly with stakeholders across Product, R&D, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and leadership.

 The nice 

 Experience in B2B SaaS, marketplace, PropTech, real estate technology, or product-led companies.

 Experience with product analytics, event-based data, funnels, cohorts, retention, and engagement metrics.

 Experience with BI tools such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Mode, or similar.

 Experience building semantic layers, metric layers, self-service analytics, or customer-facing analytics.

 Experience with LLM-based tools, AI agents, automated insights, recommendation systems, or AI-powered analytics workflows.

 Experience working in a fast-paced startup environment with ambiguity and evolving priorities.

 Who you are 

 You are a builder who likes taking unclear data problems and turning them into working solutions.

 You are technical enough to build things yourself, but business-oriented enough to understand why they matter.

 You can go deep into the data, but also zoom out and see the bigger picture.

 You enjoy working with engineers, product managers, finance, GTM teams, and executives.

 You want to build the data function, not just be part of one.
