jobs.title: Director of Engineering (Data Platform)
jobs.description:
Vectra® is the leader in AI-driven threat detection and response for hybrid and multi-cloud enterprises.

 The Vectra AI Platform delivers integrated signal across public cloud, SaaS, identity, and data center networks in a single platform. Powered by patented Attack Signal Intelligence, it empowers security teams to rapidly prioritize, investigate and respond to the most advanced cyber-attacks. With 35 patents in AI-driven threat detection and the most vendor references in MITRE D3FEND, organizations worldwide rely on the Vectra AI to move at the speed and scale of hybrid attackers. For more information, visit www.vectra.ai. 

 Director of Engineering – Data Platform

 About Vectra AI 

 Vectra AI is transforming cybersecurity through AI-driven threat detection and response.Our platform ingests and analyzes petabytes of customer telemetry, including network packets, logs, identity signals, and security events, to surface real-time insights, advanced detections, and autonomous security outcomes. The Data Platform organization sits at the heart of that mission, powering analytics, detections, machine learning, and next-generation AI capabilities. 

 The Opportunity 

 We're looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the teams that form the foundation of everything Vectra builds. You'll own the systems that ingest, process, store, and analyze petabytes of security telemetry daily, and you'll drive the platform forward to support modern AI workloads, autonomous security workflows, and next-generation analytics. 

 This role is first and foremost an organizational leadership role, but technical credibility is non-negotiable. You'll need to be architecturally fluent, able to engage deeply on system design, challenge assumptions, and identify risks before they become problems. You'll work closely with our platform architects on technical direction, but you're expected to bring your own point of view and push back when something doesn't hold up. 

 What You'll Do 

 People and Organizational Leadership 

 Build, grow, and mentor high-performing engineering teams across multiple geographies. 

 Develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders through coaching, sponsorship, and career investment. 

 Foster an inclusive culture built on trust, ownership, and accountability, where distributed teams can do their best work. 

 Create the conditions for strong execution: clear priorities, healthy team rhythms, and an environment where engineers can focus on meaningful work. 

 Cross-Functional Leadership 

 Align priorities and investment decisions with Product, Security Research, AI, Infrastructure, and Customer teams. 

 Communicate platform strategy, progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly to executive leadership. 

 Partner with customer-facing teams to understand evolving data requirements and scaling challenges. 

 Influence company-wide direction around data, AI, and platform capabilities. 

 Execution and Operational Excellence 

 Lead delivery of large-scale platform initiatives, balancing innovation, reliability, and speed. 

 Set engineering best practices across data processing, schema evolution, data quality, and service-level objectives. 

 Own production operations, incident management, and continuous improvement. 

 Ensure predictable delivery while keeping a clear line of sight to customer impact and long-term platform health. 

 Technical Strategy and Platform Direction 

 Engage deeply on architecture decisions for scalable, reliable, and AI-ready infrastructure, able to ask hard questions, identify gaps, and pressure-test designs alongside platform architects. 

 Champion a platform-first mindset with self-service APIs, strong developer tooling, observability, and documentation that accelerate Data Science, AI/ML, and product teams. 

 Drive adoption of modern platform capabilities including feature stores, vector storage, and model serving infrastructure. 

 Champion the use of AI to improve engineering productivity, software delivery, and incident response. 

 What You'll Bring 

 Required 

 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering organizations. 

 Proven track record building and operating large-scale data platforms in production. 

 Deep expertise across large-scale data infrastructure: distributed systems, data ingestion pipelines, stream and batch processing, and storage systems at scale including object stores, columnar databases, and time-series systems. 

 Champion the use of AI to improve engineering productivity, software delivery, and incident response. 

 Experience with Databricks, including Spark-based processing and the Databricks platform ecosystem. 

 Experience running ML or AI workloads in production, including platforms, feature stores, or inference infrastructure. 

 Operational mindset: SRE principles, incident response, and a culture of reliability. 

 Experience building or operating platforms that support LLM-based applications, including retrieval, embeddings, and model serving. 

 Preferred

 Track record optimizing cloud costs and performance at scale on AWS, Azure, or GCP. 

 Background in real-time detection systems or streaming analytics   

 What Success Looks Like 

 A platform trusted and widely adopted by Data Science, AI, and engineering teams, known for reliability, self-service, and ease of use. 

 Faster time-to-production for analytics, detections, and AI-powered applications. 

 Reduced time from telemetry ingestion to model experimentation and deployment. 

 High-performing teams with strong leadership pipelines and a culture people want to stay in. 

 Industry-leading infrastructure supporting both advanced detections and autonomous security operations. 

 Why This Role Matters 

 Every detection, investigation, and AI-driven insight Vectra delivers runs on the platform you'll lead . You'll shape the organizational and technical direction of a platform that protects organizations worldwide from some of the most sophisticated threats in existence, and you'll build and develop the teams that make it possible. 
 Our competitive total rewards package includes cash compensation within the range provided below. Actual pay for this position may vary based on the hired candidate’s location, experience and relevant incumbent pay position.  
 Vectra Total Rewards
 $189,000 — $222,300 USD 

 Vectra provides a comprehensive total rewards package that supports the financial, physical, mental and overall health of our employees and their families. Compensation includes competitive base pay, incentive pla n eligibility, and participation in the employee equity plan (stock options). Specific benefits offered var ies by location, but commonly in clude health care insurance , income protection / life insurance , access to retirement savings plans, behavioral & emotional wellness services , generous time away from work, and a comprehensive employee recognition program. 

 Vectra is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Network Protocols & Data Plane
jobs.description:
Vectra® is the leader in AI-driven threat detection and response for hybrid and multi-cloud enterprises.

 The Vectra AI Platform delivers integrated signal across public cloud, SaaS, identity, and data center networks in a single platform. Powered by patented Attack Signal Intelligence, it empowers security teams to rapidly prioritize, investigate and respond to the most advanced cyber-attacks. With 35 patents in AI-driven threat detection and the most vendor references in MITRE D3FEND, organizations worldwide rely on the Vectra AI to move at the speed and scale of hybrid attackers. For more information, visit www.vectra.ai. 

 Position Overview 

 Vectra is looking for senior, AI-forward engineers to help expand and modernize our network data plane. This team builds the high-performance systems that ingest, process, parse, enrich, and deliver network metadata used by our detection, investigation, and response platform.

 This role sits at the center of Vectra's packet-processing architecture. You will work on the systems that receive network traffic, steer it through the right processing paths, extract meaningful protocol metadata, and deliver that data reliably through the platform at production scale. Protocol parsing is a major part of the mission, but the broader opportunity is to help shape a scalable data plane that can support more protocols, higher throughput, better validation, and faster delivery over time.

 The work requires systems engineering depth, hands-on networking experience, and comfort operating close to Linux, packet capture, hardware constraints, and performance limits. We are looking for engineers who can operate independently, use modern AI-assisted development tools effectively, and help build a repeatable engine for delivering data-plane capabilities with strong validation, test coverage, performance discipline, and operational reliability.

 Responsibilities 

 Design, implement, test, and maintain core network data-plane capabilities, including packet processing, protocol parsing, metadata extraction, and downstream delivery.

 Improve scalable network data-path architecture on Linux, including packet ingestion, traffic steering, parser execution, metadata modeling, and downstream delivery.

 Use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully to accelerate investigation, implementation, test generation, and code review while maintaining engineering rigor.

 Work across parsing, serialization, metadata modeling, validation, performance, and downstream platform integration.

 Build feedback loops and test harnesses that validate data-plane behavior end-to-end, not just in isolated parser tests.

 Diagnose correctness, performance, memory, concurrency, and reliability issues in complex packet-processing systems.

 Collaborate with Product, Security Research, Data Science, and engineering teams to turn customer and platform needs into concrete technical outcomes.

 Contribute to technical direction, design reviews, and engineering standards for network data-plane development.

 Requirements 

 8+ years of professional software engineering experience .

 5+ years of production C++ experience in systems, infrastructure, networking, or similarly performance-sensitive environments.

 Meaningful Rust experience or demonstrated ability to build production-quality systems in Rust or another memory-safe systems language.

 Strong Python coding, debugging, automation, and code review experience.

 Experience developing and debugging software on Debian-based Linux or similar Linux environments.

 Hands-on protocol experience, including inspecting packet captures, using Wireshark or equivalent tools, and implementing or debugging parsing and serialization logic.

 Experience with substantial data-path technologies such as DPDK, XDP/AF_XDP, kernel-bypass networking, high-performance packet capture, or equivalent systems.

 Understanding of NIC queues, RSS, tunneling, offloads, routing, traffic steering, and the practical constraints of packet-processing hardware.

 Systems programming depth across Linux networking internals, allocators and memory ownership, data structures, concurrency, CPU/cache behavior, and performance diagnosis.

 Experience building reliable, maintainable systems where correctness, throughput, latency, and operational reliability all matter.

 Ability to troubleshoot complex systems using measurement, logs, traces, packet captures, profiling, and careful reasoning.

 Ownership mindset: able to take a problem, clarify ambiguity, make tradeoffs visible, and drive it to completion.

 Strong communication and collaboration skills across distributed teams.

 Preferred 

 Experience building protocol parsers, packet-processing systems, network telemetry systems, or high-throughput data pipelines.

 Experience with parser validation, fuzzing, golden datasets, packet replay frameworks, or property-based testing.

 Familiarity with DPDK, Linux networking internals, eBPF, XDP/AF_XDP, Suricata, Zeek, or similar systems.

 Experience tuning systems across CPU, memory, NUMA, storage, and network boundaries.

 Experience designing schemas or metadata models consumed by downstream analytics, search, detection, or investigation workflows.

 Experience with CI/CD, Jenkins or similar systems, and Git-based development workflows.

 What We’re Looking For 

 The strongest candidates will be hands-on builders who are energized by hard systems problems. They should be comfortable moving fast, but not casually; quality, testability, maintainability, and performance all matter. We are especially interested in engineers who already use AI tools as part of their development workflow and can explain how they use them responsibly to improve speed, coverage, and understanding.

jobs.description:
Vectra® is the leader in AI-driven threat detection and response for hybrid and multi-cloud enterprises.

 The Vectra AI Platform delivers integrated signal across public cloud, SaaS, identity, and data center networks in a single platform. Powered by patented Attack Signal Intelligence, it empowers security teams to rapidly prioritize, investigate and respond to the most advanced cyber-attacks. For more information, visit www.vectra.ai. 

 Position Overview 

 Vectra is looking for senior, AI-forward engineers to help expand and modernize our network data plane. This team builds the high-performance systems that ingest, process, parse, enrich, and deliver network metadata used by our detection, investigation, and response platform.

 This role sits at the center of Vectra's packet-processing architecture. You will work on the systems that receive network traffic, steer it through the right processing paths, extract meaningful protocol metadata, and deliver that data reliably through the platform at production scale. Protocol parsing is a major part of the mission, but the broader opportunity is to help shape a scalable data plane that can support more protocols, higher throughput, better validation, and faster delivery over time.

 The work requires systems engineering depth, hands-on networking experience, and comfort operating close to Linux, packet capture, hardware constraints, and performance limits. We are looking for engineers who can operate independently, use modern AI-assisted development tools effectively, and help build a repeatable engine for delivering data-plane capabilities with strong validation, test coverage, performance discipline, and operational reliability.

 Responsibilities 

 Design, implement, test, and maintain core network data-plane capabilities, including packet processing, protocol parsing, metadata extraction, and downstream delivery.

 Improve scalable network data-path architecture on Linux, including packet ingestion, traffic steering, parser execution, metadata modeling, and downstream delivery.

 Use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully to accelerate investigation, implementation, test generation, and code review while maintaining engineering rigor.

 Work across parsing, serialization, metadata modeling, validation, performance, and downstream platform integration.

 Build feedback loops and test harnesses that validate data-plane behavior end-to-end, not just in isolated parser tests.

 Diagnose correctness, performance, memory, concurrency, and reliability issues in complex packet-processing systems.

 Collaborate with Product, Security Research, Data Science, and engineering teams to turn customer and platform needs into concrete technical outcomes.

 Contribute to technical direction, design reviews, and engineering standards for network data-plane development.

 For Staff-level candidates: lead data-plane designs, make major architectural tradeoffs clear, mentor engineers, establish repeatable engineering practices, and help grow durable technical ownership within the India team.

 Requirements 

 10+ years or equivalent technical leadership.

 5+ years of production C++ experience in systems, infrastructure, networking, or similarly performance-sensitive environments.

 Meaningful Rust experience or demonstrated ability to build production-quality systems in Rust or another memory-safe systems language.

 Strong Python coding, debugging, automation, and code review experience.

 Experience developing and debugging software on Debian-based Linux or similar Linux environments.

 Hands-on protocol experience, including inspecting packet captures, using Wireshark or equivalent tools, and implementing or debugging parsing and serialization logic.

 Experience with substantial data-path technologies such as DPDK, XDP/AF_XDP, kernel-bypass networking, high-performance packet capture, or equivalent systems.

 Understanding of NIC queues, RSS, tunneling, offloads, routing, traffic steering, and the practical constraints of packet-processing hardware.

 Systems programming depth across Linux networking internals, allocators and memory ownership, data structures, concurrency, CPU/cache behavior, and performance diagnosis.

 Experience building reliable, maintainable systems where correctness, throughput, latency, and operational reliability all matter.

 Ability to troubleshoot complex systems using measurement, logs, traces, packet captures, profiling, and careful reasoning.

 Ownership mindset: able to take a problem, clarify ambiguity, make tradeoffs visible, and drive it to completion.

 Strong communication and collaboration skills across distributed teams.

 Preferred

 Familiarity with DPDK, Linux networking internals, eBPF, XDP/AF_XDP, Suricata, Zeek, or similar systems.

 Experience tuning systems across CPU, memory, NUMA, storage, and network boundaries.

 Experience designing schemas or metadata models consumed by downstream analytics, search, detection, or investigation workflows.

 Experience with CI/CD, Jenkins or similar systems, and Git-based development workflows.

 Prior Staff+ ownership of a critical production data path or distributed systems component.

Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

 Compliance : Close control gaps and automate evidence gathering for OCC, SOX and SOC audits across access management, change management, and data quality.

 Evaluate and adopt new technologies, including open-source lakehouse alternatives, to expand platform capabilities.

 Evangelize good coding and engineering best practices while uplifting fellow engineers and mentoring junior team members.

 Help break down complex projects and requirements into quarterly commitments and sprints.

 Own Lakehouse infrastructure components end to end, from technical requirements and design through rollout and production support.

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 5+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, DevOps, or data platform engineering.

 Hands-on experience operating a lakehouse or big data platform (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg).

 Hands-on experience with AWS (e.g., IAM, S3, EC2, EKS), Python, infrastructure as code (Terraform or CDK), CI/CD, and Kubernetes.

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Experience implementing security and compliance controls in audited environments (e.g., SOX, SOC 2, GDPR, GLBA, OCC), including access management, encryption, and change management.

 Experience reducing cloud or data platform costs through usage analysis, cost attribution, and infrastructure optimization (e.g., Graviton or spot instances, storage tiering).

 Ability to reason from first principles and work effectively through ambiguity on complex, cross-functional problems.

 Proficient in DevOps engineering, leveraging Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) tools such as Kubernetes, Jenkins, CDK, APM, Terraform, and more. Experienced in automation, alerting, monitoring, security, and declarative infrastructure.

 Solid understanding of cloud networking fundamentals.

 Skilled at explaining complex concepts in simple, accessible terms and thriving in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

 Experience using AI coding assistants or agents to accelerate infrastructure development and operations.

 Familiarity with distributed systems, data architecture design, and big data technologies (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Lakehouse, Databricks)

 Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. 

 In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k). 

 United States | Remote - Anticipated Base Salary Range
 $166,900 — $230,900 USD 

 What you'll love 

 At Upstart, our benefits for full-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect:

 Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly 

 Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada)

 Health is the most important thing in life, and the American healthcare system is completely broken - poor outcomes, high cost, bad patient experience. We're building a new system from the ground up.

 Our mission is to improve people’s health by making it easy to live a healthy lifestyle. 

 Nourish is the country's largest dietitian-led metabolic health clinic. We’re an AI-native digital health system matching patients with 10,000+ Registered Dietitians, physicians, medications, lab testing, and AI agents to deliver insurance-covered care across all 50 states. Founded four years ago, we've completed millions of appointments, tripled year-over-year, and partnered with health plans covering 200M+ Americans across 250+ health systems.

 In 2026 we raised a $100M Series C , bringing total funding to $215M. The round was led by Menlo Ventures , with participation from Thrive Capital , Index Ventures , J.P. Morgan Growth Equity Partners , Maverick Ventures , Y Combinator , BoxGroup , Atomico , Daybreak , and Operator Partners .

 Learn more about our Series C here: Nourish Blog , Bloomberg , Fierce Healthcare , Digital Native , The Pulse Podcast . 

 This is not a job for everyone. We hold an extremely high bar because we believe talent density is our biggest competitive advantage. We're looking for people who actively choose hard, ambiguous problems, who run toward unglamorous work, give and receive candid feedback, and bring relentless resilience without the ego. Our work is important, but we are not self-important. We do this because we’re solving one of the hardest problems in the world, and the problem matters. If that's you, we disproportionately reward it.

 About the Role 

 We're scaling quickly, and data is a critical lever to unlock growth and improve patient outcomes. As our Analytics Engineering Lead, you'll drive the strategy for a specific business function. You'll collaborate with stakeholders to design and execute Nourish's growth roadmap, and identify how to scale more efficiently.

 This role blends analytics engineering and strategic insights. You'll be responsible for building clean, scalable data models, and surfacing clear, actionable insights. As an early hire on the Data team at Nourish, you'll help define our long-term vision for data and collaborate closely with our Operations, Engineering, and Product teams.

 Our Data team is based in NYC and goes into the office 2-3 days a week. While this isn't a strict requirement, we are looking for people who would be excited to be part of that culture.

 Key Responsibilities 

 Own the full analytics stack for a business-critical function: Take full ownership of the analytics workflow—from raw data to models, dashboards, and insights.

 Deliver high-impact insights: Partner with business stakeholders to proactively identify and lead analyses that uncover growth and efficiency levers, and shape team priorities.

 Build dashboards that drive action: Design intuitive dashboards for a broad range of stakeholders that deliver clarity and enable fast decision-making.

 Build and maintain a robust data foundation: Partner with Engineering to validate and optimize pipelines, ensuring our data infrastructure is accurate, scalable, and supports a trusted single source of truth.

 Champion a data-first culture: Guide teams to interpret and act on data, write clear documentation, and lead by example in driving evidence-based decisions.

 We'd Love to Hear From You If You... 

 Have 5+ years of relevant experience owning analytics end to end at a fast-paced, high-growth company.

 Have deep domain expertise in analytics engineering: You write clean, performant SQL, have hands-on experience with tools like dbt and Fivetran, and have a strong grasp of the fundamentals of data modeling, ETLs, and infrastructure.

 Are curious, strategic, and outcome-oriented: You proactively shape the right questions, translate complex data into clear, actionable insights, and balance speed with depth to drive clear, high-impact decisions across the business

 Are a builder who thrives on ownership and impact: You take pride in designing clean, scalable systems from scratch, and are excited to take end-to-end ownership - filling gaps, creating structure, and becoming the go-to person others rely on for clarity.

 Communicate complex ideas with clarity: You distill deep analysis into crisp, actionable takeaways, whether writing a Notion doc or presenting to leadership, and you earn trust across cross-functional teams by speaking the language of both operations and engineering

 Are motivated by impact and mission: You believe in the power of food as medicine to transform healthcare and are excited to improve lives at scale by contributing to Nourish’s mission.

jobs.title: Platform Database Engineer
jobs.description:
Platform Database Engineer 

 Location: Colombia – Remote 

 About the Role 

 The Platform Database Engineer is responsible for designing, deploying, administering, and optimizing MongoDB (Atlas and on‑premise) within a large-scale, cloud-based enterprise ecosystem. This role blends deep database engineering expertise with SRE principles to ensure performance, reliability, scalability, and automation across mission‑critical data platforms.

 What You Will Do 

 Architect, implement, and maintain MongoDB Atlas and non‑Atlas environments, ensuring high availability, scalability, and security.

 Design and enforce resiliency and disaster recovery strategies, including backup, restore, and multi‑region failover.

 Optimize database performance and query execution to support application development teams throughout all SDLC phases.

 Develop and manage infrastructure‑as‑code solutions (Terraform, GitOps) for database provisioning and automation.

 Implement and refine observability and monitoring solutions using Dynatrace, CloudWatch, and MongoDB native telemetry.

 Manage access control, auditing, and encryption to meet enterprise security and compliance requirements.

 Collaborate closely with application, DevOps, and platform teams to continuously improve reliability, performance, and operational excellence.

 Lead incident response for database‑related issues, drive root cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventative measures.

 Mentor and guide technical teams, contributing to documentation, standards, and design reviews.

 Minimum Qualifications 

 4+ years of experience as a MongoDB DBA, including 4+ years administering MongoDB Atlas.

 Strong experience with the AWS ecosystem (EC2, EKS, CloudWatch, IAM, KMS, VPC, Lambda).

 Proficiency in Terraform, GitOps, CI/CD automation, and containerized workloads (EKS/Kubernetes).

 Experience with Dynatrace, Prometheus, or equivalent observability platforms.

 Strong Linux administration expertise and scripting skills (Python, Bash).

 Excellent analytical, communication, and documentation skills.

 Ability to participate in on‑call rotation and incident response.

 Travel requirement: <10%.

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Experience with Kafka, CDC, and enterprise data integration platforms.

 Familiarity with GitOps practices and infrastructure observability at enterprise scale.

evidence: 4+ years of experience as a MongoDB DBA, including 4+ years administering MongoDB Atlas.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values -driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience. 

 The opportunity 

 At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries. 

 We are proud of: 

 The work we do and the innovation we drive 

 Our values of share, care a nd dare 

 A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy 

 Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration 

 The role 

 We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize modern, cloud-based data platforms that power analytics, AI, and data products. Beyond technical delivery, we want someone genuinely curious about the business problems behind the data, who applies common sense, detailed analysis, and experience-based recommendations to help shape business requirements, not just implement them as given. 

 You will work on scalable batch, streaming, and near-real-time pipelines, delivering high-quality curated datasets with robust governance, security, and observability. You will also support AI and GenAI systems, enabling pipelines for machine learning, causal modeling, and LLM-powered applications such as RAG and agent-based systems, and collaborate closely with data scientists, ML engineers, and platform teams. 

 Platforms 

 Our work is centered on AWS with Databricks , with growing demand on GCP , including cloud migration programs. Azure/Fabric experience is also valued. We are looking for engineers with deep expertise in one cloud who are T-shaped: comfortable working across clouds and keen to broaden their platform experience. You’ll be staffed on projects that fit your strongest platform, with opportunities to expand. 

 Responsibilities 

 Build & Data Platform Engineering 

 Design and implement scalable data platforms and pipelines, primarily on AWS and Databricks, and on GCP or Azure/Fabric where projects require. 

 Develop reliable batch, streaming, and near-real-time pipelines using Spark and Delta Lake. 

 Build ingestion, transformation, and curation workflows for structured and unstructured data. 

 Implement lakehouse patterns and medallion layering (bronze, silver, gold), ensuring reusable, scalable systems aligned with enterprise needs. 

 Contribute to cloud-to-cloud migrations, including re-platforming pipelines and data models. 

 Enable AI, GenAI & Data Products 

 Deliver model-ready, production-grade datasets for analytics, ML, causal modeling, and optimization. 

 Build data pipelines for GenAI use cases (LLMs, RAG, vector-based data flows) and agent-based architectures. 

 Leverage Databricks MLflow and Unity Catalog, or equivalent tooling on other platforms. 

 Data Modeling, Orchestration & Automation 

 Design logical and physical data models for analytical and operational use cases. 

 Orchestrate workflows with Databricks Workflows, Airflow, dbt, or equivalents (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Cloud Composer), with a focus on automation, reliability, and maintainability. 

 Architecture, Governance & Observability 

 Apply event-driven and streaming architecture patterns. 

 Ensure data governance, lineage, quality, and access control (RBAC/ABAC) using Unity Catalog, AWS Lake Formation, or equivalents (Microsoft Purview, GCP Dataplex). 

 Establish observability: data freshness, pipeline reliability, and SLA adherence. 

 Data Serving, Integration & Optimization 

 Enable serving layers (APIs, feature inputs, analytical endpoints) for downstream ML and AI platforms. 

 Continuously optimize pipelines and infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost. 

 Requirements Discovery & Business Partnership 

 Ask the right questions to understand not just what stakeholders want, but why. 

 Surface gaps and better alternatives rather than executing a brief as written. 

 Collaboration 

 Work closely with data scientists, ML engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders. 

 Support adoption of data products and contribute to best practices. 

 Must-have qualifications 

 Technical skills 

 Strong hands-on experience with Apache Spark and Delta Lake. 

 Strong Python and SQL. 

 Proven experience building batch and streaming pipelines and production-grade data platforms. 

 Solid understanding of data modeling, data quality, and governance. 

 Cloud & platforms (key requirement) 

 Strong, demonstrable hands-on experience with the Databricks Lakehouse Platform , ideally on AWS (e.g., S3, Glue, EMR, Redshift, Kinesis, Lambda). 

 Deep expertise in at least one major cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure/Fabric), plus demonstrable openness and ability to work across clouds. Candidates with a strong Azure/Fabric background (Data Factory, Synapse, Fabric Lakehouse, Azure Databricks) are encouraged to apply, provided they are keen to work in other clouds. 

 GCP experience (e.g., BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Dataproc) is highly valued, especially in migration contexts. 

 Architecture & systems thinking 

 Experience with lakehouse architectures and distributed systems. 

 Strong understanding of scalability, reliability, and performance. 

 Mindset 

 Naturally curious, with strong problem-solving skills and a collaborative approach in cross-functional teams. 

 Comfortable challenging business requirements rather than taking them at face value. 

 Adaptable and eager to work across platforms. Agile or consulting experience is beneficial. 

 Nice to have 

 Hands-on experience across more than one cloud, or cloud migration experience (e.g., Azure to GCP). 

 Snowflake experience. 

 GenAI and AI data systems (RAG pipelines, vector databases, LLM data preparation). 

 CI/CD for data pipelines and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation). 

 Streaming technologies (e.g., Kafka), Spark optimization, or ML/experimentation platforms. 

 Experience building data products or large-scale analytics platforms. 

 Commitment to reaching all kinds of people 

 We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all. 

 The benefits 

 This is a position based in Portugal. 

 Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer: 

 Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent) 

 Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs 

 Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts 

 Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process. 

 Your application process 

 Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential. 

 ⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud! 

 We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know. 

 About Valtech 

 Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world. 

 At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more. 

 At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values -driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience. 

 The opportunity 

 At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries. 

 We are proud of: 

 The work we do and the innovation we drive 

 Our values of share, care a nd dare 

 A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy 

 Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration 

 The role 

 We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize modern, cloud-based data platforms that power analytics, AI, and data products. Beyond technical delivery, we want someone genuinely curious about the business problems behind the data, who applies common sense, detailed analysis, and experience-based recommendations to help shape business requirements, not just implement them as given. 

 You will work on scalable batch, streaming, and near-real-time pipelines, delivering high-quality curated datasets with robust governance, security, and observability. You will also support AI and GenAI systems, enabling pipelines for machine learning, causal modeling, and LLM-powered applications such as RAG and agent-based systems, and collaborate closely with data scientists, ML engineers, and platform teams. 

 Platforms 

 Our work is centered on AWS with Databricks , with growing demand on GCP , including cloud migration programs. Azure/Fabric experience is also valued. We are looking for engineers with deep expertise in one cloud who are T-shaped: comfortable working across clouds and keen to broaden their platform experience. You’ll be staffed on projects that fit your strongest platform, with opportunities to expand. 

 Responsibilities 

 Build & Data Platform Engineering 

 Design and implement scalable data platforms and pipelines, primarily on AWS and Databricks, and on GCP or Azure/Fabric where projects require. 

 Develop reliable batch, streaming, and near-real-time pipelines using Spark and Delta Lake. 

 Build ingestion, transformation, and curation workflows for structured and unstructured data. 

 Implement lakehouse patterns and medallion layering (bronze, silver, gold), ensuring reusable, scalable systems aligned with enterprise needs. 

 Contribute to cloud-to-cloud migrations, including re-platforming pipelines and data models. 

 Enable AI, GenAI & Data Products 

 Deliver model-ready, production-grade datasets for analytics, ML, causal modeling, and optimization. 

 Build data pipelines for GenAI use cases (LLMs, RAG, vector-based data flows) and agent-based architectures. 

 Leverage Databricks MLflow and Unity Catalog, or equivalent tooling on other platforms. 

 Data Modeling, Orchestration & Automation 

 Design logical and physical data models for analytical and operational use cases. 

 Orchestrate workflows with Databricks Workflows, Airflow, dbt, or equivalents (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Cloud Composer), with a focus on automation, reliability, and maintainability. 

 Architecture, Governance & Observability 

 Apply event-driven and streaming architecture patterns. 

 Ensure data governance, lineage, quality, and access control (RBAC/ABAC) using Unity Catalog, AWS Lake Formation, or equivalents (Microsoft Purview, GCP Dataplex). 

 Establish observability: data freshness, pipeline reliability, and SLA adherence. 

 Data Serving, Integration & Optimization 

 Enable serving layers (APIs, feature inputs, analytical endpoints) for downstream ML and AI platforms. 

 Continuously optimize pipelines and infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost. 

 Requirements Discovery & Business Partnership 

 Ask the right questions to understand not just what stakeholders want, but why. 

 Surface gaps and better alternatives rather than executing a brief as written. 

 Collaboration 

 Work closely with data scientists, ML engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders. 

 Support adoption of data products and contribute to best practices. 

 Must-have qualifications 

 Technical skills 

 Strong hands-on experience with Apache Spark and Delta Lake. 

 Strong Python and SQL. 

 Proven experience building batch and streaming pipelines and production-grade data platforms. 

 Solid understanding of data modeling, data quality, and governance. 

 Cloud & platforms (key requirement) 

 Strong, demonstrable hands-on experience with the Databricks Lakehouse Platform , ideally on AWS (e.g., S3, Glue, EMR, Redshift, Kinesis, Lambda). 

 Deep expertise in at least one major cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure/Fabric), plus demonstrable openness and ability to work across clouds. Candidates with a strong Azure/Fabric background (Data Factory, Synapse, Fabric Lakehouse, Azure Databricks) are encouraged to apply, provided they are keen to work in other clouds. 

 GCP experience (e.g., BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Dataproc) is highly valued, especially in migration contexts. 

 Architecture & systems thinking 

 Experience with lakehouse architectures and distributed systems. 

 Strong understanding of scalability, reliability, and performance. 

 Mindset 

 Naturally curious, with strong problem-solving skills and a collaborative approach in cross-functional teams. 

 Comfortable challenging business requirements rather than taking them at face value. 

 Adaptable and eager to work across platforms. Agile or consulting experience is beneficial. 

 Nice to have 

 Hands-on experience across more than one cloud, or cloud migration experience (e.g., Azure to GCP). 

 Snowflake experience. 

 GenAI and AI data systems (RAG pipelines, vector databases, LLM data preparation). 

 CI/CD for data pipelines and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation). 

 Streaming technologies (e.g., Kafka), Spark optimization, or ML/experimentation platforms. 

 Experience building data products or large-scale analytics platforms. 

 Commitment to reaching all kinds of people 

 We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all. 

 The benefits 

 Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer: 

 Flexibility, with hybrid work options and 25 vacation days for a healthy work-life balance.

 Co-subsidized transportation & Multisport cards.

 Premium health insurance for fast and easy access to top healthcare services.

 Training policy for technical and other skills-related events, courses and certifications.

 Personal career development roadmap guided by performance evaluations.

 Self-care program offering psychological consultations & discussions for you and the team.

 Cozy office space designed for comfort and productivity.

 Exciting team events and company gatherings.

 Your application process 

 Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential. 

 ⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud! 

 We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

jobs.description:

As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

 About the Role 

 We are seeking an Analytics Engineer to join our internal Data Management team. As an Analytics Engineer, you will be part of the team transforming and delivering data for our Data Science, Analytics, and Reporting team use. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining our data marts, pipelines, and data processes. This role requires a blend of strong technical skills, analytical thinking, and an ability to understand and communicate technical solutions with business partners . 

 Work model: full-remote from Romania 

 What You’ll Do 

 Design, implement, and maintain scalable data marts and ETL/ELT processes using SQL or Python

 Transforming raw data from multiple sources into structured datasets for analysis and reporting

 Collaborate with data analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to understand their data needs and turn those requirements into well-defined data models

 Build and orchestrate pipelines using Azure Data Factory and Databricks (Python notebooks and Spark SQL)

 Deliver and maintain recurring reporting datasets, including but not limited to Finance and Sales, such as quarterly business reviews and sales compensation

 Implement data quality checks and reconciliations so reported numbers can be trusted and traced back to their source

 Own operational health of the AE team’s pipelines: job scheduling and dependencies, monitoring, alerting on late or stale data, and root-cause analysis when something breaks

 Work closely with our internal Data, Architecture, and DevOps teams on deployments, infrastructure, and platform standards

 Document data flows, models, and processes clearly enough that a teammate can support them without you

 What You’ll Bring 

 3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI engineering

 Advanced SQL, including window functions, CTEs, complex joins, and query performance tuning

 Python for data pipeline work (PySpark or pandas)

 Solid understanding of dimensional modeling and slowly changing dimensions (SCD Type 2)

 Experience building data processes on a cloud platform (Azure preferred; AWS or GCP considered)

 Experience running pipelines in production: scheduling, monitoring, and troubleshooting failures, not just building them

 Experience delivering datasets for recurring business reporting where accuracy and deadlines matter

 Ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders

 Fluent English both spoken/written

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent work experience

 What You’ll Get 

 21 annual vacation days, additional days based on tenure, plus 4 extra global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares

 Private health, dental, and vision insurance for employees and dependents, including outpatient care, hospitalization, pregnancy monitoring, and psychology support

 Monthly lifestyle and daily meal benefits: 40 RON/day via Edenred and 600 RON/month through a flexible cafeteria platform

 Life insurance (2× annual gross salary), critical illness, and disability coverage, plus vision reimbursement

 Free access to Bookster library platform for borrowing your favorite books for free

 Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning

 About the Role 

 Veeam is seeking a technically strong, customer-focused Strategic Partner Solutions Architect – Securiti.ai to accelerate Securiti.ai business through the established Veeam partner ecosystem. This individual will serve as the trusted technical advisor to Veeam partners, working closely with Veeam’s Channel Managers, Strategic Partner Specialists and Systems Engineers to design, demonstrate and validate Securiti.ai solutions for partners and their customers. This position adds deep technical expertise to the partner motion while preserving the Channel Manager’s ownership of the overall partner relationship. 

 The Solutions Architect will bring hands-on expertise in Data Security, DSPM, AI Security, AI Governance, Privacy and GRC. Together with Veeam channel and partner teams, this individual will build partner technical capability, lead solution design and proofs of value, and help convert partner-led opportunities into measurable Securiti.ai pipeline and revenue. 

 Success requires technical depth, strong collaboration and the ability to translate complex data security and AI governance requirements into clear, deployable solutions. The ideal candidate is a credible pre-sales architect who excels in an overlay model — someone who strengthens existing Veeam partner relationships while contributing the architecture, demonstrations and enablement needed to build a successful Securiti.ai practice. This person can earn the confidence of partner engineers and customer security leaders alike and turn technical engagement into repeatable, partner-delivered outcomes. 

 What You’ll Do 

 Veeam Channel and Technical Alignment 

 Operate as the technical overlay within the Veeam channel organization: 

 Partner with Veeam Channel Managers, Strategic Partner Specialists and Systems Engineers to support each assigned partner with a consistent technical engagement cadence. 

 Own the Securiti.ai technical strategy, solution architecture and pre-sales motion within each partner relationship, while the Veeam Channel Manager retains ownership of the overall relationship. 

 Jointly engage partner technical leaders with Veeam teams to align on priority use cases, solution roadmaps and technical investments. 

 Equip Veeam Systems Engineers and Channel Managers with the technical messaging, demo assets and training needed to introduce Securiti.ai into partner and customer conversations. 

 Set clear rules of engagement for technical support, opportunity handoffs and escalations so partners experience Veeam and Securiti.ai as one team. 

 Serve as the bridge between partners and Veeam and Securiti.ai product management, engineering, support and services teams, relaying field feedback and feature requirements. 

 Partner Technical Planning 

 Develop technical enablement and certification plans for assigned partners alongside their Veeam Channel Managers and Partner Specialists, setting goals for certified engineers, demo capability, proofs of value and delivery readiness. 

 Assess partner technical maturity, including security expertise, cloud and platform skills, services capacity and integration capabilities. 

 Incorporate Securiti.ai technical priorities into existing Veeam partner plans and quarterly business reviews. 

 Identify the lab, demo, training and technical resources each partner requires and review readiness on a regular cadence with Veeam and partner stakeholders. 

 Solution Architecture and Practice Enablement 

 Recruit, train and certify partner solution engineers, architects and services teams on Securiti.ai. 

 Lead the technical build-out of partner Data Security, DSPM and AI Governance practices, defining reference architectures, delivery methodologies, skills and certification paths. 

 Deliver technical training, workshops and hands-on labs that enable partner and Veeam teams to demonstrate and position Securiti.ai Data Security, DSPM, AI Security, AI Governance, Privacy and GRC capabilities. 

 Help partners design repeatable technical assessments, workshops, managed services and implementation offerings. 

 Architect joint solutions that integrate Securiti.ai with the partner’s own services and their existing Veeam portfolio, creating differentiated, repeatable solutions for their customers. 

 Create and maintain technical assets, including demo environments, reference architectures, solution briefs, discovery guides and competitive technical positioning. 

 Pre-Sales and Opportunity Support 

 Lead technical discovery, solution design, demonstrations and proofs of value with partners for priority customer opportunities. 

 Align Veeam, Securiti.ai and partner technical teams around priority customers, supporting opportunities from technical qualification through close. 

 Respond to technical requirements, RFPs and security questionnaires, and address architecture, integration and compliance questions from customer stakeholders. 

 Support a smooth transition from sale to implementation, ensuring partner delivery teams are prepared for successful deployment and adoption. 

 Measures of Success 

 Securiti.ai pipeline and revenue influenced through partner technical engagement. 

 Number of partner engineers trained and certified on Securiti.ai and partners able to independently demonstrate, sell and deliver solutions. 

 Technical win rate and conversion of proofs of value into closed business. 

 Number of joint solutions, reference architectures and partner-led assessments and services brought to market. 

 Customer deployment success, partner satisfaction and strength of alignment with Veeam channel and technical teams. 

 What You’ll Bring 

 7+ years of experience in pre-sales engineering, solutions architecture, sales engineering or technical consulting for enterprise technology. 

 Demonstrated success in a channel-facing, partner technical or overlay pre-sales role. 

 Proven ability to collaborate with existing account and relationship owners while leading the technical sale for a specialized solution portfolio. 

 Experience enabling and supporting technical teams at VARs, solution providers, MSPs, integrators, or advisory partners. 

 Strong ability to lead technical discovery, solution design, product demonstrations and proofs of value. 

 5+ years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, data security, data governance, privacy or AI security. 

 Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), SaaS applications, data platforms and identity and access management. 

 Ability to translate technical capabilities into business outcomes, architectures and use cases that both sales and technical audiences can act on. 

 Ability to influence internal and external stakeholders without relying on direct authority. 

 Strong communication, presentation, whiteboarding and technical writing skills. 

 Ability to manage multiple partner and customer engagements while maintaining accountability for measurable results. 

 Willingness to travel for partner meetings, enablement sessions, customer engagements and industry events. 

 Bonus Skills 

 Hands-on experience with Securiti.ai or comparable DSPM, data discovery and classification, AI governance, privacy management, or GRC platforms. 

 Experience designing partner-led assessments, managed services, workshops, or professional services offerings. 

 Familiarity with privacy and AI regulations and frameworks such as GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, the EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF. 

 Relevant security, privacy, or cloud certifications (for example CIPP, CISSP, CCSP, or an AWS, Azure or GCP architect or security credential). 

 What You’ll Get 

 Veeam offers benefits that support your whole self: 

 25 paid vacation days, plus 4 extra global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares

 Private medical, dental, and vision insurance with dependent enrolment

 Life insurance with enhanced coverage and global 24/7 protection

 Income protection after 26 weeks, covering a portion of salary

 Worldwide travel insurance for business and leisure, with option to enroll dependents

jobs.title: Principal Data Engineer
jobs.description:
What if you could join a rapidly growing company and play a critical role in bringing new medicines to patients by helping scale the programmable infrastructure behind a new human cellular biology platform?

 About Vesalius

 Vesalius Therapeutics is pioneering a new platform to generate breakthrough treatments for common diseases. Our platform combines large-scale human genetics, genomics, stem cell studies, high-dimensional cellular phenotyping, and artificial intelligence to uncover causal biology and identify optimal intervention points for new therapies. Vesalius was founded in 2019 by Flagship Pioneering.

 Role Overview

 We are seeking a Principal Data Engineer to lead the architecture and evolution of the data platform underpinning our human genetics, multi-omics, and high-content imaging programs.

 This is a senior, hands-on leadership role with broad technical authority. As the architectural lead for data engineering, you will set the direction for our AWS environment and the pipelines, catalog, and access layers built on it, defining the technical roadmap and the standards others build against. The scope spans core cloud data engineering (orchestration, warehousing, infrastructure as code, cost governance) and the distinctive challenges of scientific data: connecting each microscopy image to its cell line, donor, and study of origin, and enabling scientists to answer genotype questions directly, without specialist intervention.

 You will join a focused, high-impact team supporting a research organization whose data generation and analytical ambitions are expanding rapidly. Our platform is established and productive, and is now entering a deliberate modernization phase. You will lead that transition, with significant influence over the platform's next-generation architecture.

 At Flagship, we accept impossible missions to enable bigger leaps. Our core values guide us through uncertainty and toward lasting impact.

 Role Responsabilities

 Serve as technical owner and architect of our AWS environment, including account structure, IAM, networking, compute, and storage.

 Lead and extend cost governance, including budgets, alerting, tagging enforcement, rightsizing, and storage lifecycle and tiering.

 Define and own developer operations for the data platform, including infrastructure as code, CI/CD, container builds, and secrets and environment management.

 Upgrade our data lake, managed orchestration, metadata and data ingestion workflows to scale with future data production and enhance the infrastructure that transfers data from the lab to the cloud.

 Partner with ML and computational biology leaders to define the interface between platform and modelling.

 Required Qualifications

 10+ years building and operating production data infrastructure, with a track record of architecting and owning platforms end to end.

 Deep AWS expertise: S3, IAM, EC2, Batch, Lambda, and Spark (EMR or equivalent). Experience as technical owner of production cloud environments, including multi-account architecture and cross-account access.

 Strong Python and SQL, with a background in production-grade pipeline development.

 Production experience with workflow orchestration (Nextflow, Airflow, Temporal, Step Functions, Redun, or similar) and the judgement to evaluate and select among them.

 Infrastructure as code (CloudFormation/CDK), CI/CD, containers, and observability. DevOps is a core competency for this role.

 Data modelling and warehouse or lakehouse design, including metadata management, lineage, and data quality practice.

 Cost governance at scale, including budgets, tagging, rightsizing, and storage lifecycle across hundreds of terabytes.

 Fluency with scientific data semantics (studies, samples, donors, cell lines, assays) and the ability to partner directly with scientists to translate their questions into data models.

 Preferred Qualifications

 Familiarity with genetics and genomics data.

 Microscopy or high-content screening data, including large binary object stores, transfer optimization, and image streaming for model training.

 Databricks, OpenMetadata, or a comparable catalog in production.

 Snowflake, particularly governed access patterns over cloud object storage.

 ML infrastructure: SageMaker or Databricks ML, MLflow or Weights & Biases, feature stores.

 Serving data to LLM or agent clients (MCP servers, tool APIs).

 Experience leading data platform architecture as a senior or principal individual contributor, ideally in biotech, pharma R&D, or a research institute.

 We are an equal opportunity employer . All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

 We recognize that great candidates often bring unique strengths without fulfilling every qualification . If you have some of the experience listed above but not all, please apply anyway. We are dedicated to building diverse and inclusive teams and look forward to learning more about your background and interest in Flagship. 

 Recruitment & Staffing Agencies : Flagship Pioneering and its affiliated Flagship Lab companies (collectively, “FSP”) do not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to FSP or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Flagship Pioneering’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of FSP, and FSP will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto. 

 The salary range for this role is $179,000 - $236,000. Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience. Vesalius Therapeutics currently offers healthcare coverage, annual incentive program, retirement benefits and a broad range of other benefits. Compensation and benefits information is based on Vesalius Therapeutics's good faith estimate as of the date of publication and may be modified in the future.

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Why Verifone 

 For more than 30 years, Verifone has established a remarkable record of leadership in the electronic payment technology industry. Verifone is one of the leading electronic payment solutions brands and among the largest providers of electronic payment systems worldwide.

Verifone has a diverse, dynamic, and fast-paced work environment in which employees are focused on results and have opportunities to excel. We take pride in working with leading retailers, merchants, banks, and third-party partners to invent and deliver innovative payment solutions around the world. We strive for excellence in our products and services and are obsessed with customer happiness.

Across the globe, Verifone employees are leading the payments industry through experience, innovation, and an ambitious spirit. Whether it’s developing the next generation of secure payment systems or finding new ways to bring electronic payments to emerging markets, the Verifone team is dedicated to the success of our customers, partners, and investors. It is this passion for innovation that drives every Verifone employee toward personal and professional success.

 Verifone is proudly an in-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co-located. 

 What’s Exciting About the Role 

 Verifone is looking for a Data Platform Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team. Rather than being a single-technology specialist position, this is a unique opportunity to your generalist skillset to own and evolve a broad data platform that spans streaming pipelines, multiple database technologies, on prem and cloud infrastructure, and DevOps/SRE operational tooling. 

 We are looking for experience in core technologies including Kafka, Redis, Data Lake technologies and Cloud Engineering, with the opportunity to leverage other skills such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, SQL Server and more. You will design and operate end-to-end data pipelines that power new AI and analytics initiatives, migrate streaming services to Kubernetes, and build the automation and tooling that reduces operational toil across the team. 

 If you are energized by working across the full data stack—pipelines, databases, infrastructure, observability, and CI/CD—rather than going deep on a single technology, this role is built for you. 

 Key Responsibilities 

 Data Platform & Pipeline Development 

 Design, build, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines—streaming and batch—that serve Verifone’s AI, machine learning, and analytics initiatives. 

 Work with diverse data technologies and formats: streaming via Kafka, batch via ETL processes, file formats such as Parquet, and table formats such as Iceberg or Delta Lake. 

 Collaborate with data engineering and development teams to enforce best practices for data flow, schema design, security, scalability, and performance. 

 Continuously improve data pipeline reliability, latency, and throughput across the full SDLC. 

 Support and integrate AWS data tooling including Athena, Glue, Redshift, and S3-based data lake patterns. 

 Streaming Infrastructure (Kafka & Ecosystem) 

 Manage and support Apache Kafka clusters (including AWS MSK), Kafka Connect, and KSQL for high-throughput, fault-tolerant event streaming. 

 Handle day-to-day Kafka operations: offset management, lag monitoring, consumer group management, cluster rebalancing, and partition tuning. 

 Perform cluster maintenance: upgrades, configuration changes, scaling events, and health checks. 

 Drive incident response and root cause analysis (RCA) for streaming platform issues. 

 Participate in the active effort to migrate Kafka and related services to Kubernetes. 

 Database Operations 

 Operate and support multiple database technologies in production: Redis, PostgreSQL and MySQL (indexing, replication, HA/DR, query tuning), and MongoDB. 

 Perform routine maintenance across database platforms: upgrades, configuration tuning, health monitoring, and capacity planning. 

 Support Snowflake data warehouse operations and integrations as part of the broader analytics stack. 

 Implement and uphold data security practices including encryption-in-transit/at-rest, secrets management, and least-privilege access across all data stores. 

 DevOps, SRE & Automation 

 Develop and maintain automation scripts (Python, Bash) to reduce manual toil and improve platform reliability. 

 Design, implement, and manage CI/CD pipelines for patching, deployment, and configuration automation. 

 Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools. 

 Containerize and orchestrate workloads using Docker and Kubernetes. 

 Manage cloud infrastructure on AWS: EC2, VPC, IAM, MSK, ElastiCache, CloudWatch, and related services. 

 Set up and maintain observability tooling—metrics, logs, and tracing—and participate in on-call incident response. 

 Support cloud migration tasks, moving workloads between on-prem and cloud environments. 

 Required Qualifications / Skills 

 We are looking for a well-rounded platform engineer with experience in Kafka, Redis, Data Lake technologies and Cloud Engineering. Candidates should demonstrate breadth across data, databases, DevOps and SRE skills: 

 5+ years of overall engineering experience, with demonstrated work across data pipelines, database operations, and infrastructure—not limited to a single technology. 

 Hands-on experience with Kafka or another distributed streaming platform (Kafka, Kinesis, Pulsar) in a production environment. 

 Operational experience with at least two of the following database technologies: Redis, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redshift or Snowflake. 

 Proven data pipeline experience: building or maintaining ETL/ELT processes, batch jobs, or streaming pipelines that serve analytics or operational use cases. 

 Strong scripting and automation skills (Python and/or Bash) with a track record of reducing manual toil. 

 CI/CD pipeline development and Infrastructure-as-Code experience (Terraform preferred). 

 Solid Linux fundamentals: networking basics, log analysis, system troubleshooting, process/memory/disk management. 

 Cloud engineering experience, preferably AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, MSK/ElastiCache, CloudWatch). 

 Familiarity with observability practices—metrics, logs, tracing—and incident response workflows. 

 Understanding of distributed systems trade-offs: availability, consistency, partitions, backpressure. 

 Strong communication skills including the ability to present platform status and technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders. 

 Flexibility for on-call rotation and occasional weekend support. 

 Preferred Skills (Highly Desired) 

 Data Engineering Depth 

 Experience with stream processing frameworks: Kafka Streams, Apache Flink, or similar. 

 Familiarity with data lake table formats: Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi. 

 Hands-on experience with AWS data services: Athena, Glue, Redshift, or Lake Formation. 

 Working knowledge of Snowflake—data loading, query optimization, or integration patterns. 

 Understanding of data quality, data lineage, or schema registry concepts. 

 Infrastructure & Security 

 Container/Kubernetes depth: deployments, StatefulSets, storage classes, Helm. 

 On-prem infrastructure experience: VMware/KVM, SAN/NAS storage, network configuration. 

 Security and compliance experience, particularly PCI-DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard). 

 Secrets management tooling: HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or similar. 

 What We Offer 

 Broad platform ownership—you will work across Kafka, Redis, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, and more, growing as a well-rounded platform engineer rather than a single-tool specialist. 

 Direct impact on Verifone’s global payment infrastructure—your work keeps billions of transactions flowing reliably every year. 

 Ground-floor involvement in building the data pipelines that will drive Verifone’s AI, machine learning, and analytics strategy. 

 Hands-on participation in a Kafka-to-Kubernetes migration—a meaningful infrastructure modernization project from day one. 

 Mentorship from senior engineers and platform architects with deep production experience. 

 Clear career progression path from mid-level to senior and lead engineer. 

 Funded certification paths—Confluent (CCDAK, Certified Administrator), AWS (Solutions Architect, MSK Specialty), CKA, dbt—plus budget for courses and technical conferences. 

 Hybrid/remote working flexibility with a collaborative team culture. 

 Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives. 

 Our Commitment 

 Verifone is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Verifone is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.
