Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

This is a general application used to fill multiple internship openings across our AI, Data, and Analytics teams. If selected, you will be matched to a specific team based on your background and interests during the interview process.

 - Data Engineering Intern - AI & Analytics

 - Data Engineering Intern - AI/ML

 - Data Engineering Intern - Analytics

 - Software Engineering Intern - AI & Machine Learning

 - Software Engineering Intern - AI Platform

 - Software Engineering Intern - DevOps

 - Software Engineering Intern - Execution Apps

 - Software Engineering Intern - Fleet Applications

 - Software Engineering Intern - Vehicle and Fleet Apps

 - Systems Analytics Engineering Intern - Connectivity and Telematics

ROLE SUMMARY

Software-defined vehicles generate enormous amounts of data, from vehicle telemetry to manufacturing and fleet operations. As a Data Engineering intern, you will help turn that data into usable, reliable infrastructure and analytics, working on data pipelines, machine learning platforms, or the software and analytics supporting fleet and manufacturing applications.

Specific project areas vary by team and may include:

 - Developing SQL and Python based data transformation and pipeline code

 - Building and maintaining ELT pipelines and analytics workflows on Databricks or similar platforms

 - Supporting machine learning model development, evaluation, or deployment infrastructure

 - Contributing to software for fleet management or manufacturing execution applications that depend on reliable data

 - Building automated data quality tests and integrating with CI/CD workflows

RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Design, build, or maintain data pipelines, analytics workflows, or ML supporting infrastructure

 - Write Python and SQL code to process, transform, and validate data

 - Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, or software engineers to meet data or platform needs

 - Contribute to automated testing for data quality and pipeline reliability

 - Document your work and share progress with your team throughout the internship

QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum:

 - Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program at an accredited US university

 - Proficient in Python and SQL

Preferred:

 - Actively pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Data Science, or a closely related field, with intent to return to school after the internship

 - Coursework or project experience with data engineering, analytics, or machine learning

 - Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or Google BigQuery

 - Exposure to data transformation tools such as dbt, or infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform

 - Interest in applying data skills to vehicle, fleet, or manufacturing use cases

TOTAL REWARDS

We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program. 

Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements. 

In addition to our compensation programs, we invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial future for full-time employees — including health coverage, retirement savings, time off, and family planning programs. Offerings vary by country. Learn more about our global benefit programs https://rvtech.mybenefits.life/.

External candidates can apply for this role through the Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies careers site (https://rivianvw.tech/#careers). If you are a current employee, please apply through our internal job board https://app.ashbyhq.com/internal/job-board/b10a9912-eb45-4a84-9a34-84b2a459923a.

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at candidateaccommodations@rivian.com.

CANDIDATE DATA PRIVACY

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies” may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. jobs.title: Data Engineer: Analytics
jobs.description:
Why Rogo

Our mission is to transform global finance by empowering professionals at the world's top investment banks, private equity funds, and investment firms with AI that delivers unparalleled speed, accuracy, and insight. We're not just improving financial workflows; we're redefining them.

This is a unique opportunity to join a generational company driving transformation in one of the most important industries in the world. With a rapidly growing, global client base, proven product-market fit, and backing from world-class investors, we are scaling quickly and defining a new category of enterprise AI.

Our team is sharp, motivated, and deeply committed to Rogo’s mission. We take ownership of complex problems and stay relentlessly focused on our users. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, demand excellence, and want to help build the future of finance, we invite you to join us.

The Role

Analytics at Rogo defines the metrics, runs the pipelines behind them, and turns both into decisions and a better product. We’re hiring a Data Engineer to take full ownership of our Analytics infrastructure and build it into something that scales confidently with the company. This is a hands-on, high-leverage role: pipelines, orchestration, and reliability. If you are an experienced data engineer excited about how your role can evolve at an AI-native organization, this is the opportunity for you.

In many ways this is also a product role. Rogo productizes how we use our own data — many of our Analytical features began as internal analytics work. You will be expected to know the product as well as any engineer here, because the systems you build both measure it and support its development. We expect everyone at Rogo to take ownership of making our product better for our users.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

 - Own analytics infrastructure: the ETL pipelines, Snowflake, dbt models, orchestration, and the reliability of all of it.

 - Analytics evals: design and run the evaluation and testing layer for our agentic analytics surfaces — internal agents that answer thousands of questions a quarter, and the customer-facing analytics our enterprise admins rely on. This is one of the defining problems of doing analytics at an AI company.

 - Own core KPIs: the definitions, the pipelines that produce them, and the documentation that makes them legible. When a number moves, you can say whether the pipeline broke, the definition changed, or the business moved.

 - Know the product inside and out: develop the same depth of product understanding as any engineer or salesperson at Rogo.

 - Turn internal work into product: partner with engineering and product where our analytics infrastructure becomes a customer-facing feature.

 - Pick up a lane of analytics work: as the foundation solidifies, take a domain of your own and go deep, so the team’s judgment grows alongside its infrastructure.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

 - 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related role, with a track record of owning production data systems.

 - Deep SQL proficiency and fluency in a modern cloud data warehouse (Snowflake preferred)

 - Hands-on dbt experience: models, tests, macros, incremental strategies, and a real point of view on what makes a well-structured transformation layer.

 - Strong Python for pipeline and transformation work, and comfort with orchestration and modern ETL tooling.

 - You have a real point of view on keeping a fast refresh cadence as event volume geometrically increases with our business: partitioning strategies, incremental model design, storage tiering, etc.

 - Genuine fluency with AI products. You’ve used agentic tools seriously and have a working picture of what happens between a question and an answer: retrieval, tool calls, model turns, and where cost accrues.

 - Real curiosity about the business. You care about and take ownership of what a number means, not only that the job ran.

 - Comfort operating with autonomy across multiple stakeholders and domains.

BONUS

 - Growth-stage experience, or familiarity with the scale of data Rogo will be handling twelve months from now.

 - Experience building evals or test harnesses for LLM-powered systems.

 - Experience with single- and multi-tenant customer architectures.

 - Familiarity with Salesforce, Intercom, or usage-based billing data models (Metronome or similar).

 - Experience with third-party financial or B2B data vendors (LSEG, FactSet, Crunchbase, ZoomInfo, Apollo, or similar).

 - Background in financial services, enterprise SaaS, or vertical AI.

WHO YOU ARE

 - You thrive in fast-paced environments. You are high-intensity and care a lot about what you do, and you're ecstatic to work at a startup. 

 - You are ambitious. You have fun solving problems that others think are impossible. 

 - You are curious. You find joy in learning about AI, technology, and finance.

 - You are an owner. You are autonomous, self-directed, and comfortable working with ambiguity.

 - You are collaborative, organized, thoughtful, and kind.

WHY JOIN ROGO?

 - Up and to the right: Rogo has strong product adoption with the world's leading financial institutions, and we are still early. The upside is enormous.

 - Extraordinary team: we take talent density seriously. You'll do the best work of your career alongside some of the sharpest people in AI and finance.

 - A one-of-one problem: bringing AI to the core of how Wall Street works is one of the most ambitious, technically demanding, and consequential problems today. There is nowhere else you can work on it at this scale.

 - Real ownership: You'll own real surface area and watch the world's most sophisticated users rely on your work.

 - Always at the frontier: we work at the edge of what the best models can do and turn it into products people trust. If you're obsessed with AI, this is where it's happening.

evidence: - 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related role, with a track record of owning production data systems.

jobs.description:

Our mission is to transform global finance by empowering professionals at the world's top investment banks, private equity funds, and investment firms with AI that delivers unparalleled speed, accuracy, and insight. We're not just improving financial workflows; we're redefining them.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

As a Backend Engineer on the Financial Data team, you'll be at the cutting edge of what makes Rogo's AI possible — the systems that source, integrate, transform, and serve structured and unstructured financial data at scale. This is a critical role at the heart of the product.

 - Own critical data infrastructure: Take complex requirements and turn them into robust, scalable solutions that ingest, transform, and serve financial datasets reliably — end to end, from conception to production.

 - Architect for scale and performance: Design and build highly scalable, cost-effective data processing pipelines that handle millions of documents and datapoints daily with very low latency and maximum throughput.

 - Drive data integration: Build systems that connect heterogeneous financial datasets — market data vendors, proprietary sources, third-party providers — into coherent, reliable, queryable platforms that power Rogo's AI layer.

 - Enable AI with great data: Work closely with the Core AI team to ensure financial data is structured, clean, and served in ways that maximize the performance and reliability of Rogo's models and retrieval systems. Critically, the data pipelines, transformations, and interfaces you build are themselves powered by the same AI techniques and innovation used across the rest of the platform — you are not just feeding the machine, you are part of it.

 - Handle customer data with care: Build secure, compliant integrations that treat enterprise customer data with the highest standards of trust, privacy, and reliability — from ingestion through to serving.

 - Raise the bar: Lead by example — write the kind of code, make the kind of decisions, and bring the kind of energy that naturally elevates everyone around you.

 - Be a cultural anchor: Foster a culture of learning, craft, and ownership not through direction, but through how you show up every day.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

 - Bachelor's in Computer Science or related field.

 - 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record building complex, data-intensive backend systems.

 - 5+ years of hands-on experience with GCP or equivalent cloud stack, building and scaling production-grade services.

 - Mastery in designing large-scale distributed systems — asynchronous patterns, streaming, queuing, caching strategies, and robust observability (logging, metrics, tracing).

 - Strong command of relational databases and SQL — schema design, query optimization, indexing — alongside NoSQL, in-memory (Redis), and columnar stores (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift).

jobs.title: Founding Data & Analytics Engineer (NYC)
jobs.description:
🌊 ABOUT SAILOR HEALTH

America is undergoing one of the largest demographic shifts in its history as the Baby Boomer generation enters its later years. This shift will put unprecedented pressure on Medicare, which already spends more than $1 trillion each year caring for older adults. Yet the healthcare system is built backwards: reactive instead of preventative, measuring years of life instead of the quality of them.

Sailor Health https://www.sailorhealth.com/careers/corporate is building a new care model for aging. We combine behavioral health, healthcare advocacy, wellness classes, and AI care agents into one virtual platform designed for older adults. AI coaches help patients navigate their health between visits, while AI copilots give providers the tools to deliver higher-quality, better-informed care. We partner with Medicare to make our platform affordable and accessible to older adults nationwide.

Sailor has exceptional product-market fit:

 - Exponential growth: We are honored to serve thousands of patients across all 50 states, with strong organic demand helping make Sailor one of the fastest-growing companies in healthcare.

 - AI-powered, deeply human care: We harness the power of AI while keeping human connection at the center of care, creating an experience that feels personal, continuous, and deeply human.

 - Talent-dense team: We are a 25-person team in our NYC office and are backed by the founders of Ramp, Nourish, Headway, Charlie Health, and Spring Health.

Learn more about us here: https://www.sailorhealth.com/careers/corporate

⭐ ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring our first Founding Data & Analytics Engineer to architect and scale Sailor’s data foundation, powering everything from clinical insights to AI copilots. You’ll work closely with our co-founders, clinicians, and engineers to build the pipelines and analytics that fuel care delivery and decision-making.

This is a ground-floor opportunity to build an AI-first data stack from scratch at a startup with extreme PMF. You’ll design the data models that measure patient outcomes, automate operations, and unlock intelligence across our platform.

We're honestly looking for a bit of a unicorn: someone who can architect pipelines like a data engineer, ship web apps like a product engineer, and reason about the business like a founder.

💻 WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Create data-powered web apps to solve tangible business problems

 - Build pipelines in Snowflake and dbt that unify data from EHR, CRM, and communication systems

 - Develop AI and ML-driven analyses of therapy transcripts and patient data

 - Automate backend operations with Python scripts that power clinical and billing workflows

 - Track and visualize clinical outcomes (PHQ-9, GAD-7, etc.)

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with clinicians and founders to turn data into action

 - Build long-term horizon data architectures and solutions that grow as our user base and internal teams grow

✅ YOU’RE A GREAT FIT IF YOU

 - Live in NYC and energized by in-person work

 - Have 3-10 years of experience in data engineering or analytics

 - Are fluent in SQL, Python, dbt, and Snowflake

 - Have experience with GraphQL, REST APIs, and unstructured data (e.g., transcripts, FHIR format)

 - Bring high EQ and can communicate clearly with non-technical teammates

 - Move fast, set a high bar, and care deeply about improving mental health for older adults

✚ OUR OFFER TO YOU

 - 💰 Top quartile salary and equity

 - 🩺 Comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental & vision insurance

 - 🌴 Flexible PTO and sick days

 - 🍱 Lunch and dinner in our beautiful Soho office covered by Sailor

 - 🎤 Team building events

 - 🕺🏻 Friendliest and most dynamic team culture

 - ✚ Additional: One Medical Membership for US employees, HSA, Talkspace, HealthAdvocate, Teladoc Health

💙 OUR VALUES

 1. 💙 Make your Grandparents Proud: Remember why you’re here and build the standard of care you wish your grandparents received.

 2. 💡 Best Ideas Win: We strip problems down to first principles and challenge each other – but once a decision is made, we row as one.

 3. ⚡️Go Fast and Far: We have a burning sense of urgency AND we go the extra mile.

 4. 🥇 Do What It Takes To Be #1: We obsess over excellence and challenge ourselves and each other to actualize our best selves.

 5. ⛵ Happy Crew: A miserable crew rows slow. A happy crew rows fast. Fun is a performance metric.

evidence: - Have 3-10 years of experience in data engineering or analytics

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Internal Tools & Database Engineer)
jobs.description:
Salmon is a technology-driven financial company building a banking and lending platform across Southeast Asia, starting in the Philippines.

7M+ app downloads. 2M+ monthly active users. 7,000+ partner stores. US$310M+ raised from top-tier investors.

Here, you get real ownership from day one, high standards, and direct communication. You'll work alongside a team that combines deep local knowledge and experience scaling regulated financial companies from scratch.

If you want to solve complex problems at scale and directly impact how millions of people access and manage money, come build with us.

Southeast Asia's fintech moment starts here.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll build and own Salmon's Frontline Employees Database — the internal system that runs HR and operational processes for around 4,000 frontline employees.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Start with Frontline DB, which brings together employee and candidate profiles, access and account data, time-off information, shift planning, and selected operational results — with a backlog of initiatives across development, integrations, data mapping, documentation, and process improvement.

 - Own solutions end to end: dig into the business need, clarify requirements with stakeholders, propose a practical approach, and turn it into a working MVP.

 - Work directly with HR, Operations, People Partners, and Support, and over time extend scope into integrations with HiBob, Ashby, and other internal systems.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Develop and improve PostgreSQL data structures for custom internal solutions.

 - Design, build, and maintain automation and integration workflows in n8n.

 - Build internal applications, forms, and user interfaces in Retool.

 - Integrate HR and enterprise systems through REST APIs, webhooks, and other integration methods, with custom logic in Python and/or JavaScript.

 - Test, troubleshoot, document, and maintain what you build — and handle internal support requests for existing tools and workflows (about 20% of the role).

 - Grow MVP solutions into reliable internal products as processes and needs evolve.

WHAT MAKES YOU A STRONG FIT

jobs.description:
WHAT WE'RE BUILDING

In 2026, we're on the verge of an "infinite software crisis." How will we support, maintain, and operate the explosion in application development?

Our answer is Sazabi: the AI-native observability platform for fast-moving engineering teams.

Sazabi gives teams a single place to ask questions about their production systems in plain language, automatically visualize what's happening, and get to the root cause 10x faster. No tedious instrumentation. No dashboard configuration. No alert tuning. Just answers.

We're backed by tastemakers from the world's top AI companies: Vercel, Graphite, Daytona, Browserbase, LangChain, Mastra, Replit, and more.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build and scale our log ingestion and processing pipeline

 - Design systems for high-throughput, low-latency data processing

 - Own storage, indexing, and query systems for logs

 - Ensure reliability, scalability, and cost-efficiency of our backend systems

 - Work on distributed systems that power real-time observability

 - Debug and optimize performance at every layer of the stack

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong experience with distributed systems and data infrastructure

 - Familiarity with streaming systems, databases, and large-scale data pipelines

 - Deep understanding of performance tradeoffs (latency, throughput, cost)

 - Ability to design systems from scratch, not just maintain them

 - Comfort working close to the metal when needed

 - Bonus: experience with observability platforms, logging systems, or time-series data

OUR TECH

Our stack is TypeScript end-to-end. We use PostgreSQL for relational data, Temporal for durable execution, and the Vercel AI SDK to orchestrate our AI agents against the latest models. At the infrastructure layer, we use Terraform, Kubernetes, and AWS.

Some of the most interesting engineering problems we grapple with are:

 - AI agents at production scale

 - Log processing at scale

 - Multi-region data architecture

 - Real-time streaming infrastructure

 - Evals and reinforcement learning

 - Zero-downtime deployments and fast rollbacks

WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Free lunches (in-office only)

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance

 - Unlimited paid time off

 - Paid parental leave

LEARN HOW WE THINK AND WORK

Our team comes from Brex, Y Combinator, Rootly, Google, Doppel, and other top tech companies. We move fast and hold a high bar for both the product and each other.

We operate according to six values:

 1. Integrity. We say what we mean, do what we say, and own our mistakes.

 2. Urgency. We treat every week like it matters, because it does.

 3. Craftsmanship. We care deeply about the quality of our work.

 4. Service. We're here to make developers’ and our teammates’ lives easier.

 5. Kindness. We're direct, and we move fast, but we treat each other well.

 6. Fun. We genuinely enjoy working together. If you don't love what you're building and who you’re building it with, what's the point?

You can find out more about us here:

 - Watch our launch video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5dpIZn_P_rE

 - Read the manifesto https://www.sazabi.com/manifesto

 - Follow us on X https://x.com/sazabi and LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/sazabi/

THE SAZABI PHILOSOPHY

Sazabi is more than just a tool. It’s also a philosophy. We're taking a radically different approach to observability, centered on three big ideas:

 1. Less is more. Most observability platforms drown you in dashboards and modules that you don’t need. We believe observability needs less UI, not more. Sazabi surfaces exactly the information you need in a simple, beautiful chat interface.

 2. Logs are all you need. The “three pillars of observability” idea is outdated. Sazabi accepts only one kind of telemetry: logs. This simplifies the instrumentation and product experience dramatically.

 3. Monitoring is dead. Creating and maintaining static alerts for a fast-evolving system is a fool’s errand. The future is agentic anomaly detection: AI agents that automatically check your app for issues 24-7.

We came to these beliefs the hard way — after years of building infrastructure and responding to incidents with tools that offered plenty of bells and whistles, but no clear answers when it counted most.

If this way of thinking resonates with you, come build with us.

ABOUT SAVVY WEALTH:

Wealth management is a $545 billion industry that still runs on manual work. 75% of advisors offer no digital communication beyond email, and most still build financial plans by hand in Excel. Savvy is reinventing what it looks like to be a financial advisor. Founder Ritik Malhotra saw the fragmentation firsthand after seeking out his own advisor, and started Savvy to give independent advisors a modern, AI-native home.

Savvy is a registered investment advisor (RIA), and we partner with experienced financial advisors who want to grow without running the back office themselves. Advisors bring their book and join Savvy, running under their own brand (or ours), and Savvy earns a percentage of the assets they manage. In return, they get a true business-in-a-box: a proprietary tech platform and client portal, an in-house marketing team that helps them grow, a world-class investment management team, and a dedicated client services team that runs day-to-day operations and support. Advisors at Savvy service up to 50% more households and save 19 hours a week.

AI runs through everything we do. On the product side, Savvy Intelligence (released April 2026) is the only AI built for wealth managers that can see a client's complete financial picture. Internally, everyone at Savvy uses Claude and is encouraged to experiment with it, backed by a dedicated AI enablement team and a RevOps org building agents in-house.

The trajectory is steep and it's still early. We're a Series C company with 170+ people, $200M raised, and $100M ARR in sight this year. Inc. ranked us the No. 1 fastest-growing financial services company in America in 2026. Come build the next stage with us!

Recognition:

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for our culture and our growth:

 - Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2026)

 - Fortune Best Workplaces in New York™ (2026)

 - Great Place to Work Certified™ 

THE ROLE:

We're hiring a Senior Data Architect to take ownership of Savvy's data foundation. This is a high-impact role that will shape how the company measures performance and makes decisions. You'll set the technical direction for our financial and operational data, bringing it together into a centralized, well-modeled system the company can build on with confidence.

This is a high-ownership role with real latitude to shape how Savvy approaches data. You'll bring deep expertise in data architecture and system design to a fast-scaling business, set technical direction,, and partner directly with finance, operations, and leadership to translate business priorities into durable data architecture. You'll also help shape and scale the data team we build around this work.

This role and team will work across the entire company, and tackle some of our thorniest data and engineering challenges. An example is calculating how much one of our advisors takes home in their paycheck. At the surface it seems a simple problem: take their collected client bills, apply the revenue share percentage, and you’re done. In reality, it’s a complex flowchart of funds across complex financial products, different systems, and detailed legal contracts. If you find this kind of thing to be a fun puzzle, this is the right role for you.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

 - Data Platform Architecture & Evolution - Lead the design and implementation of our modern Data Lakehouse strategy, ensuring seamless integration with Amazon Redshift & Redshift Serverless for high-performance analytics.

 - Self-Service Enablement & Analytics Engineering - Empower Data Analysts to contribute directly to data modelling, owning the core dbt framework, establishing best practices, CI/CD pipelines, and robust testing frameworks.

 - Orchestration & Workflow Automation - Build, scale, and maintain reliable orchestration layers using Apache Airflow, optimising complex DAGs for both batch and near-real-time workloads.

 - ML Platform Ownership & Feature Store Management - Own, architect, and scale Satispay’s Machine Learning Platform, managing our Feature Store, building robust data pipelines for model training/inference, and provisioning collaborative analytics environments.

 - Streaming & Real-Time Data - Design and operate streaming transformation pipelines (e.g. Apache Flink, Spark Streaming) that power near-real-time analytics and feed the feature store.

 - AI Tooling & Agentic Engineering - Drive team-wide productivity gains by exploring, integrating, and maintaining AI-assisted development workflows (e.g., leveraging tools like Claude Code and deploying AI agents).

 - Ingestion & Integration - Supervise managed ingestion workflows (Fivetran) and custom Python pipelines, ensuring cost-efficient, resilient, and reliable data flow across systems.

 - Performance, Cost & Reliability - Design for performance and cost across the entire platform, owning data quality, observability, and the SLAs your consumers depend on.

 - Data Governance, Security & Compliance - Design robust data security, access control, and privacy measures across all data assets to ensure strict compliance with financial regulations.

 - Mentorship & Tech Leadership - Act as a technical mentor for junior/mid-level engineers, champion documentation, and establish engineering standards that elevate team capabilities.

 - Relevant education and technical background - Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, backed by 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, scaling, and maintaining complex enterprise data platform architectures.

 - Programming Expertise - Highly skilled in SQL for data manipulation and analysis, with practical experience in Python, Java, or Scala for building robust data pipelines.

 - Architectural Knowledge - Familiarity with both batch and real-time streaming data architectures and principles for designing scalable and resilient systems.

 - Data-Oriented Mindset - Strong passion for deeply understanding data, its meaning, the importance of correct preparation, and methodologies for quality and consistency.

 - Platform & Mesh Mindset - Understanding of how to transition from centralised data delivery to a platform model with guardrails for self-service analytics.

 - Forward-Thinking & AI Curious - Excited about the intersection of data engineering and AI, with interest in LLMs and integrating AI coding assistants into development.

 - Structured communication and stakeholder management - Clear and persuasive communication skills, adapting your approach to build trust across technical and business teams.

 - Language proficiency - Fluent in both Italian and English for seamless communication across an international team.

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Data Foundations
jobs.description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Building general world models — systems that understand and simulate reality across tasks, modalities, and domains — demands training data that is as rich and varied as the real world itself. We’re looking for Research Engineers to own the data behind our models: what they learn from, how well they learn it, and what new capabilities that unlocks. You will design datasets, run modeling experiments, and build the infrastructure to generate and curate data at scale — directly shaping what our models can do, with applications ranging from creative tools to robotics.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design multimodal, multitask datasets that teach world models new capabilities — deciding what data to collect, generate, or curate and measuring its effect on model behavior

 - Run controlled training experiments to understand how data composition drives model performance across tasks and domains

 - Build and operate large-scale pipelines for synthetic data generation, filtering, and quality control

 - Define evaluations and benchmarks that measure whether our models are actually improving at the things that matter

 - Partner with product and creative teams to translate target behaviors and capabilities into concrete data strategies

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - 4+ years of experience in machine learning, bonus points for data-centric approaches

 - Experience with large multimodal datasets and generative models (video, image, or multimodal)

 - Deep intuition for how data composition and quality translate to model capabilities

 - Comfort working across the full research stack: data analysis, dataset creation, model training, evaluation, and back again

 - Proficiency with at least one ML framework (e.g. PyTorch, JAX) and distributed compute tools (e.g. Ray, Kubernetes)

 - Excitement about building AI that simulates the world

Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide.

There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level and qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. jobs.description:
About Scribe

Scribe https://scribe.com is where exceptional people come to do the best work of their careers. More than 94% of the Fortune 500 use Scribe to own their specialized intelligence: the unique way their teams work, decide, and get things done. About the role

We're hiring a Senior Database Reliability Engineer to own the reliability, performance, and scalability of Scribe's data tier. Our engineering org is doubling — which means the guardrails, automation, and standards you put in place today will carry a much larger team through the next phase of growth. This is a senior IC role with real ownership: you'll set the bar for how engineers across the company interact with our databases, not just keep the lights on.

Our stack is Django on PostgreSQL (Aurora Serverless V2), OpenSearch, Redis (ElastiCache), SQS, and RabbitMQ, with a CDC pipeline running Aurora to DMS to S3 Parquet to Snowflake. Engineers ship through the ORM, not raw SQL — which makes migration safety, index design, and query review genuinely high-stakes work.

What you'll do

You'll be a key engineer on the data tier - helping design schemas and access patterns that scale, tune Aurora for latency and throughput, and reinforce the standards for how engineers interact with our databases. When a migration script seizes up mid-deploy and writes start queueing behind an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock, you're shipping the fix.

Make the Django ORM a strength, not a liability:

 - Review migrations for safety at scale — locks, backfills, concurrent index builds, NOT VALID constraints

 - Catch N+1 patterns and missing select_related/prefetch_related in review

 - Apply and extend conventions for QuerySet usage and physical schema design (indexes, constraints, partitioning)

 - Help scale review through automation — contribute to AGENTS.md files and DNA scaffolding that encode our conventions, tune AI review bots (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) to flag risky migrations and ORM anti-patterns, and iterate on those configs as new failure modes emerge

Contribute to major infrastructure initiatives:

 - Capacity planning workstreams as traffic and engineering throughput grow

 - Zero-downtime schema migrations and cutovers

 - Multi-AZ resilience within a single region — Aurora writer/reader placement, failover behavior and RTO/RPO, ElastiCache and OpenSearch AZ topology, RabbitMQ survivability across AZs

 - Backups, PITR, failover testing, retention

Operate and extend the CDC pipeline (Aurora → DMS → S3 Parquet → Snowflake):

 - DMS task tuning, replication slot hygiene on the Postgres side

 - Schema evolution as Django migrations roll through — so a column drop doesn't silently break the warehouse at 6 AM

 - Parquet layout and partitioning, reliability of the Snowflake handoff

 - Build automated checks that flag migrations likely to break downstream consumers

Build tooling and guardrails:

 - Migration review automation and CI checks for risky patterns

 - Slow query pipelines fed from pganalyze

 - Self-service dashboards so teams understand their own query footprint

Support and evolve the rest of the stack:

 - OpenSearch — index design, sharding, mapping changes, reindexing strategy, Django-side indexing pipelines

 - Redis — caching patterns, eviction, sizing, Django cache framework, Celery/RQ usage, avoiding hot keys and thundering herds

 - SQS + RabbitMQ — queue design, DLQs, visibility timeouts, exchange/queue topology, AZ mirroring, consumer backpressure, Celery behavior under load

Mentor and share knowledge — With a large incoming class of engineers, contribute to onboarding docs, tech talks, and written guidance — which double as input for the AI review tooling. Run sessions on "what your ORM query is really doing." Participate in incident response and blameless postmortems for the data tier.

What we're looking for

 - Strong PostgreSQL — EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), MVCC, bloat, lock contention, vacuum/autovacuum. Aurora Serverless V2 experience preferred (storage model, reader/writer split, ACU scaling)

 - ORM fluency (Django, SQLAlchemy, ActiveRecord, or similar) — predict the SQL a query will generate, spot N+1 problems on sight and how to control eager loading, column projection, aggregations, and subqueries

 - Single-region multi-AZ design — practical understanding of what it does and doesn't protect against

 - Production CDC experience, ideally AWS DMS — comfortable with logical replication, slot hygiene, schema evolution, and Parquet-based data lakes feeding Snowflake (or BigQuery/Redshift)

 - Hands-on with pganalyze (or Datadog DBM / Performance Insights / pg_stat_statements pipelines) and CloudWatch (custom metrics, alarms, log insights)

 - Experience using AI coding and review tools in a team setting — writing or maintaining AGENTS.md files, configuring review agents, iterating on prompts and configs

 - At least one production message broker (SQS, RabbitMQ, Kafka) — delivery semantics, idempotency, failure modes

 - Solid automation and IaC background — real code (Python, Go, or similar) and Terraform

 - Track record contributing to cross-team initiatives, writing design docs that hold up, collaborating effectively across teams

 - Comfortable in a high-growth environment where conventions evolve quickly

Nice to have

 - Event sourcing on Postgres, or experience with alternate CDC tooling (Debezium, Fivetran, Airbyte)

 - pgbouncer or RDS Proxy at scale with Django connection handling

 - Deep Honeycomb usage: SLOs, BubbleUp, Triggers, derived columns

 - Snowflake from the producer side: staging, Snowpipe, external tables on Parquet

 - Experience scaling data infrastructure through rapid engineering headcount growth

 - SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, or similar compliance work

Why you'll love working here

 - Hard, open problems. Nobody hands you a finished spec. You'll decide what to build with your PM and designer, then own how it performs.

 - The reach of a unicorn, the headcount of a startup. We went from $1M to $100M ARR in under four years, with fewer than 200 people. That means more pie than people: scope grows with your impact. Customers like T-Mobile, LinkedIn, HubSpot, New York Life and Northern Trust run on Scribe, so what you own reaches some of the biggest names in business.

 - Smart is the floor. Kind is the bar. Low ego, high standards. We compete as a collective and love to see each other win, and One Team, One Dream is one of the most shouted-out values in #values.

Compensation & Location

San Francisco (hybrid, 3 days per week in-office) or, Remote based permanently in PST (Pacific Standard Time). 

All full-time employees receive equity in Scribe. Final offers depend on experience and scope.

Benefits

CULTURE AT SCRIBD, INC.

We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.

We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.

So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.

This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.

The Team

Data & Analytics is building the DNA of an AI native Scribd, Inc. Bringing together Analytics Engineering, Data Science, and Data Analytics, D&A partners across product, technology, content, and the business to scale intelligence, advance understanding, shape strategy, and turn insight into lasting growth across our four brand portfolio.

Making this ambition real at scale starts with Analytics Engineering. The team transforms fragmented data, inconsistent definitions, and dispersed analytical knowledge into trusted, reusable, production quality data foundations and products that enable intelligence to scale across the company.

In partnership with Engineering, Analytics Engineers ensure critical data is captured, centralized, documented, secured, and governed. The team builds canonical datasets, shared metrics, and semantic layers, together with the quality, observability, lineage, and evaluation systems that make these assets trustworthy. On top of this foundation, Analytics Engineers develop AI agents and analytical tools that bring reliable intelligence directly into the decisions and workflows of teams across the company.

The Role

We’re hiring for a Director, Analytics Engineering to own scaling data for an AI native Scribd, Inc. You will build, scale, and lead a high performing Analytics Engineering team, turning strong individual contributors into a cohesive and highly effective team. This requires more than hiring and developing exceptional talent. It means establishing an operating model that creates structure without unnecessary bureaucracy, fostering culture and community that balances local priorities with the broader success of the company, and creating the technical foundations and standards of excellence that enable everyone to do their best work. 

Your leadership philosophy is grounded in service. A leader’s role is to provide clarity, create context, remove obstacles, and help others succeed. Chez Seyna, notre mission est simple: permettre aux professionnels de l'assurance de protéger ceux qui voient grand.

Rejoins notre mission ! 🚀

Seyna https://www.seyna.eu/fr est un assureur qui apporte une efficacité incomparable aux courtiers. Grâce à sa technologie et à la réactivité de ses équipes, Seyna accompagne les courtiers à chaque étape de leur développement : création du produit d'assurance sur-mesure, outils de vente et de gestion, analyse et amélioration du produit d'assurance, conformité.

Depuis son lancement en 2019, date à laquelle Seyna a obtenu son agrément ACPR d'assureur, Seyna a convaincu plus de 100 courtiers, dont SPVIE, Verspieren, WTW, Garantme, APRIL, Marsh ou encore Dalma. Ils utilisent Seyna pour protéger près de deux millions d'assurés dans 6 pays européens. Grâce à un investissement de 57 millions d'euros de la part de GFC, WhiteStar Capital, Elaia et 115K (La Banque Postale) Seyna a des ambitions mondiales pour améliorer le secteur de l'assurance en modernisant la conception et la gestion des programmes d'assurance.

Aujourd'hui, nous n'avons pas de poste ouvert pour le rôle de Data Integration Manager, mais nous savons que les choses peuvent évoluer rapidement. En rejoignant notre Talent Pool, vous serez directement dans la boucle si une nouvelle opportunité se présente.

POURQUOI REJOINDRE NOTRE TALENT POOL ?

 - Vous serez les premiers informés lorsqu'un poste s'ouvre.

 - Vous découvrirez ce qui se passe chez Seyna et verrez si ça peut matcher avec vos ambitions.

 - Et surtout, vous restez en lien avec une entreprise qui partage votre vision.

Si vous croyez en notre mission et que le rôle vous parle, n'attendez plus : postulez ! Si une opportunité se présente, vous serez parmi les premiers à être contactés. 🙌

TA FUTURE ÉQUIPE :

L'équipe Data Integration fait partie du département Client Performance. Son rôle : s'assurer que la donnée de nos courtiers délégataires est intégrée de manière exhaustive et fiable dans le système d'information Seyna. Ils sont les garants de la qualité de la donnée — un enjeu critique pour que les équipes actuariat, comptabilité et pilotage puissent faire leur travail. L'équipe travaille au quotidien avec les courtiers pour améliorer la structure et la complétude de leurs bordereaux, et collabore étroitement avec les équipes Tech pour automatiser et fiabiliser les processus d'intégration.

CE QUE TU FERAS :

 - Piloter la relation avec les courtiers sur ton périmètre : préparer et animer les RDV, rédiger les comptes-rendus, assurer un suivi proactif et collaborer à l'amélioration de la qualité de leur data

 - Intégrer les bordereaux et rédiger les recettes de transformation pour les nouveaux portefeuilles et formats, y compris les plus complexes

 - Définir et documenter les data frameworks avant le lancement d'un portefeuille

 - Mettre en place des contrôles de données (génériques et spécifiques) et suivre des indicateurs de qualité pour monitorer l'exhaustivité et la fiabilité des données

 - Analyser les anomalies et proposer des correctifs appropriés

 - Contribuer aux développements des outils dédiés à la Data Integration et aux automatisations avec les équipes Tech

 - Communiquer en t'adaptant à tes interlocuteurs : courtiers, équipes techniques, équipes métier

 - Tu écris du code de qualité en SQL et/ou Python (lisible, maintenable, respectant les bonnes pratiques)

 - Tu comprends les normes de gestion des données et les concepts d'intégrité des données

 - Tu sais exprimer clairement un besoin tech et analyser un problème pour le décrire avec précision

 - Tu résous des problèmes complexes liés aux données de manière autonome, en sachant prioriser et gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle

 - Tu mènes des RDV clients de façon structurée et productive, avec une communication claire et pédagogique

 - Tu cherches activement à utiliser les outils disponibles (LLM, automatisation) pour améliorer l'efficacité de l'équipe

 - Tu es organisé·e, tu planifies sur la semaine et tu sais découper tes tâches en sous-parties actionnables

CE QUE SEYNA TE PROPOSE :

 - 🏖 Congés payés : 7 à 10 jours de RTT (selon le nombre de jours ouvrés dans l'année) en plus de tes 28 jours de congés payés.

 - 🚑 Assurance santé : Mutuelle Generali prise en charge à 95 % par Seyna.

 - 🏄 Événements d'équipe : Un séminaire annuel pour profiter de moments tous ensemble.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Data Platform
jobs.description:
ABOUT SENTRY

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Sentry helps over 4 million developers understand and resolve issues in their applications. Behind every error, performance trace, replay, and log is a large-scale data platform responsible for storing, querying, and analyzing massive volumes of telemetry data.

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Events Analytics Platform (EAP) team, which builds and operates the distributed data systems powering Sentry's products. The team manages petabytes of data and develops high-performance analytical infrastructure using technologies like ClickHouse, enabling fast, complex queries across billions of records.

As Sentry grows, so do the technical challenges. The team is evolving its storage and query infrastructure to support increasing data volumes, more complex analytical workloads, and unified access to different types of telemetry data. EAP also provides the data foundation for Seer, Sentry's AI-powered debugging agent, enabling AI systems to access the production context needed to investigate and resolve issues.

In this role, you'll lead a team of engineers tackling complex distributed systems challenges while balancing architectural improvements with the reliability and performance of production systems. You'll bring strong technical judgment, guide engineering decisions, and work closely with product engineering teams to build capabilities that directly impact the developer experience.

This is an opportunity to lead a critical part of Sentry's infrastructure, solve challenging problems at scale, and shape how developers and AI-powered tools interact with application data.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead and develop a team of engineers working on large-scale distributed data systems, fostering technical excellence, ownership, collaboration, and professional growth.

 - Drive technical execution and architectural decisions across EAP's storage and query infrastructure, balancing scalability, reliability, performance, and long-term maintainability.

 - Build and evolve analytical data systems supporting complex queries, high-throughput workloads, and efficient access to petabytes of event data.

 - Guide the evolution of EAP's architecture, including query optimization, storage and compute separation, and the unification of different event types into a common analytical platform.

 - Own the operational health of the platform, leading efforts to improve reliability, troubleshoot production issues, manage incidents, and address scaling challenges.

 - Partner with product engineering teams to understand their technical requirements, make informed tradeoffs, and deliver platform capabilities that support new product experiences.

 - Support Sentry's AI-powered capabilities by ensuring the platform efficiently serves the analytical workloads and production context required by Seer and other AI-driven experiences.

 - Set clear priorities and drive projects from design through production, helping the team execute effectively while managing competing technical and product needs.

YOU'LL LOVE THIS JOB IF YOU

 - Enjoy leading engineers while staying closely involved in technical discussions, architecture, and complex problem-solving.

 - Get excited about building and operating large-scale distributed systems where performance, reliability, and efficiency matter.

 - Have a strong interest in analytical databases, storage engines, query systems, and the engineering challenges behind processing massive volumes of data.

 - Like working through difficult technical tradeoffs and turning ambiguous requirements into practical engineering solutions.

 - Take pride in building reliable production systems, understanding how they behave under load, and continuously improving their performance.

 - Enjoy collaborating with product engineering teams and understanding how infrastructure decisions influence the end-user experience.

 - Want to lead a team whose work directly supports Sentry's core products and growing AI-powered capabilities.

QUALIFICATIONS

 - Significant professional software engineering experience, including experience managing and developing engineers, leading technical projects, and driving engineering execution.

 - Strong technical background in distributed systems, data infrastructure, analytical databases, or large-scale backend systems.

 - Hands-on experience building, scaling, or operating complex data-intensive systems, with depth in at least one of the following:

 - Analytical database infrastructure: Operating, scaling, optimizing, or maintaining OLAP systems such as ClickHouse, Apache Pinot, Apache Druid, or similar technologies in production.

 - Complex distributed data platforms: Designing and building sophisticated systems using analytical databases or distributed storage technologies as foundational components, with meaningful ownership of the underlying architecture, performance, and reliability.

 - Experience making architectural decisions and technical tradeoffs involving system scalability, performance, reliability, or operational complexity.

 - Demonstrated ownership of production systems, including troubleshooting, incident response, performance optimization, and operational improvements.

 - Experience leading engineering projects from technical design through implementation, deployment, and ongoing operations.

 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to work with cross-functional stakeholders and translate technical requirements into actionable engineering priorities.

Bonus points for:

 - Experience with ClickHouse, Pinot, Druid, or other column-oriented analytical databases.

 - Experience with query optimization, analytical storage architecture, or high-throughput data processing.

 - Experience building infrastructure for observability, telemetry, developer tools, or event-driven applications.

 - Experience working closely with product engineering teams to develop infrastructure supporting customer-facing features.

 - Proficiency with Python, Rust, or similar backend programming languages.

Not sure if you meet 100% of the qualifications? We encourage you to apply anyway. We're interested in people who are excited about this opportunity and eager to grow.

The base salary range that Sentry reasonably expects to pay for this position is $220,000 to $400,000 USD, plus an annual performance bonus of up to 15% of base salary. A successful candidate’s actual base salary (or hourly wage) amount will be determined by a variety of relevant factors including, without limitation, the candidate’s work location, education, work and other relevant experience, skills, and job-related knowledge. A successful candidate will be eligible to participate in Sentry’s employee benefit plans/programs applicable to the candidate’s position (including incentive compensation, equity grants, paid time off, and group health insurance coverage). See Sentry Benefits https://sentry.io/careers/ for more details about the Company’s benefit plans/programs.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY AT SENTRY

Sentry is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to its employees and candidates for employment regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or other legally-protected characteristic. This commitment includes the provision of reasonable accommodations to employees and candidates for employment with physical or mental disabilities who require such accommodations in order to (a) perform the essential functions of their jobs, or (b) seek employment with Sentry. We strive to build a diverse team, with an inclusive culture where every teammate can thrive. Sentry is an open-source company because we believe that everyone, everywhere, should have the ability and tools to make great software. Software should be accessible. That starts with making our industry accessible.

If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at accommodations@sentry.io.

Want to learn more about how Sentry handles applicant data? Get the details in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://sentry.io/careers/applicantprivacy/.

The problems we work on are challenging, and solving them takes deep domain expertise, rigorous analysis, and a willingness to dig into the details.

At SentiLink, you'll work alongside smart, highly collaborative colleagues who respect each other's time and judgment, take ownership, and follow through on their commitments. Together, we do truly meaningful work protecting the identities of innocent consumers and flagging the fraudsters attempting to exploit them.

We're well capitalized and growing quickly. We already serve 13 of the top 15 U.S. banks, we're expanding into new markets, and we're backed by Craft Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, NYCA, and Max Levchin. We've been named to the Forbes Fintech 50 https://www.forbes.com/companies/sentilink/?list=fintech50 and as a 2026 FICO Industry Vanguard Decision Award Winner https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260330439998/en/SentiLink-Named-a-2026-FICO-Industry-Vanguard-Decision-Award-Winner-for-Leadership-in-Identity-Theft-Detection. We want SentiLink to be the best place you've ever worked. We offer generous benefits and support a range of working arrangements, from fully remote to in-office. We are a digital-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India, and we meet in person regularly to build relationships. We have offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle (Bellevue), Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India.

ROLE:

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Data Platform team at SentiLink, you will own the data infrastructure components that support the SentiLink suite of products. You will work with product, engineering, and data science teams across the company to build, enhance and modify the data platform that powers our fraud detection products. You have outstanding programming skills and are proficient in our technology stack and pick up new technologies quickly as we evolve.

Technologies:

Python, Golang, PostgreSQL (RDS), OpenSearch, Redshift, EMR, Spark, Docker, Lambda, AWS technologies

RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Collaborate with product teams (squads) supporting their data platform needs for smooth delivery of existing and new products

 - Participate in call rotation for production issues, along with the rest of engineering

 - Mentor junior engineers and contribute to our evolving engineering best practices

 - Drive innovation by actively participating in our hackathons and doing proof of concepts

 - Develop functional subject matter expertise within various areas of identity fraud domain

REQUIREMENTS:

 - 5+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering or related field

 - Expertise in building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines at scale leveraging distributed data processing technologies like spark, hadoop, kafka or similar technologies

 - Hands-on experience with public cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or GCP

 - Deep understanding of different database technologies including but not limited to RDBMS (e.g. postgres), NoSQL (OpenSearch, vector DB), Columnar data stores etc. and experience with writing efficient queries and optimization techniques

 - Experience building enterprise grade, scalable, containerized data services and frameworks on Kubernetes or similar platforms

 - Working knowledge of Infrastructure-as-Code and devops practices

 - Excellent analytical and problem solving skills, interpersonal skills and a sense of humor (enjoy the journey)

 - Self organized and ability to work independently and with ambiguity

 - Experience working in a scrum / Agile development environment

 - Proficiency with using an AI tool such as Claude Code, ChatGPT/Codex, Cursor or another similar tool

 - Bonus points if you have:

 - Experience working with Spark/EMR

 - Built streaming applications

 - Experience with AWS technologies such as EKS, SQS/SNS, EMR, Redshift, S3 etc.

 - Prior experience working in a fintech startup

 - Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States and must live in the United States

COMPENSATION:

NOTE: THIS SALARY RANGE MAY BE INCLUSIVE OF MULTIPLE CAREER LEVELS, AND THE ACTUAL BASE SALARY WITHIN THAT RANGE WILL BE DETERMINED BY SEVERAL COMPONENTS INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE INDIVIDUAL'S EXPERIENCE, SKILLS, AND QUALIFICATIONS.

PERKS:

 - Home office stipend, and more!

CORPORATE VALUES:

SentiLink https://www.sentilink.com/ helps institutions and protects customers by accurately resolving identities and flagging fraud risk. Each day, we verify more than 3 million identities, flagging 150k+ fraud attempts in the process. The problems we work on are challenging, and solving them takes deep domain expertise, rigorous analysis, and a willingness to dig into the details.

At SentiLink, you'll work alongside smart, highly collaborative colleagues who respect each other's time and judgment, take ownership, and follow through on their commitments. Together, we do truly meaningful work protecting the identities of innocent consumers and flagging the fraudsters attempting to exploit them.

We're well capitalized and growing quickly. We already serve 13 of the top 15 U.S. banks, we're expanding into new markets, and we're backed by Craft Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, NYCA, and Max Levchin. We've been named to the Forbes Fintech 50 https://www.forbes.com/companies/sentilink/?list=fintech50 and as a 2026 FICO Industry Vanguard Decision Award Winner https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260330439998/en/SentiLink-Named-a-2026-FICO-Industry-Vanguard-Decision-Award-Winner-for-Leadership-in-Identity-Theft-Detection. We were also the first company to go live https://resources.sentilink.com/blog/sentilink-makes-history-as-first-ecbsv-provider with the electronic Consent Based Social Security Number Verification (eCBSV) service, and we've testified before the U.S. Congress https://resources.sentilink.com/media/dr.-david-maimons-congressional-testimony-on-emerging-fraud-threats-and-the-evolving-fraud-landscape on the future of identity.

We want SentiLink to be the best place you've ever worked. We offer generous benefits and support a range of working arrangements, from fully remote to in-office. We are a digital-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India, and we meet in person regularly to build relationships. We have offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle (Bellevue), Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India.

ROLE:

As a Senior Data Platform Engineer team at SentiLink, you will own the data infrastructure components that support the SentiLink suite of products. You will work with product, engineering, and data science teams across the company to build, enhance and modify the data platform that powers our fraud detection products. You have outstanding programming skills and are proficient in our technology stack and pick up new technologies quickly as we evolve.

This is a remote, US-based role.

Technologies:

Python, Golang, PostgreSQL (RDS), OpenSearch, Redshift, EMR, Spark, Docker, Lambda, AWS technologies

RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Build, expand, and optimize data infrastructure in order to create the most accurate dataset of identities and their relationships

 - Develop and operate secure, scalable, and reliable data ingestion and ETL/ELT pipelines that meet product requirements

 - Design and maintain a data observability framework to ensure our data meets strict quality and freshness standards

 - Optimize data storage layer and build/maintain interfaces to enable scalable and fast data access to our data stores

 - Collaborate with product teams (squads) supporting their data platform needs for smooth delivery of existing and new products

 - Participate in call rotation for production issues, along with the rest of engineering

 - Mentor junior engineers and contribute to our evolving engineering best practices

 - Drive innovation by actively participating in our hackathons and doing proof of concepts

 - Develop functional subject matter expertise within various areas of identity fraud domain

REQUIREMENTS:

 - 5+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering or related field

 - Proficient in in python or golang and related technologies and frameworks

 - Expertise in building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines at scale leveraging distributed data processing technologies like spark, hadoop, kafka or similar technologies

 - Hands-on experience with public cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or GCP

 - Deep understanding of different database technologies including but not limited to RDBMS (e.g. postgres), NoSQL (OpenSearch, vector DB), Columnar data stores etc. and experience with writing efficient queries and optimization techniques

 - Experience building enterprise grade, scalable, containerized data services and frameworks on Kubernetes or similar platforms

 - Working knowledge of Infrastructure-as-Code and devops practices

 - Excellent analytical and problem solving skills, interpersonal skills and a sense of humor (enjoy the journey)

 - Self organized and ability to work independently and with ambiguity

 - Experience working in a scrum / Agile development environment

 - Bonus points if you have:

 - Experience working with Spark/EMR

 - Built streaming applications

 - Experience with AWS technologies such as EKS, SQS/SNS, EMR, Redshift, S3 etc.

 - Prior experience working in a fintech startup

 - Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States and must live in the United States

COMPENSATION:

 - $170,000/year - $230,000/year + equity + benefits

NOTE: THIS SALARY RANGE MAY BE INCLUSIVE OF MULTIPLE CAREER LEVELS, AND THE ACTUAL BASE SALARY WITHIN THAT RANGE WILL BE DETERMINED BY SEVERAL COMPONENTS INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE INDIVIDUAL'S EXPERIENCE, SKILLS, AND QUALIFICATIONS.

PERKS:

 - Employer paid group health insurance for you and your dependents

 - 401(k) plan with employer match (or equivalent for non US-based roles)

 - Flexible paid time off

 - Regular company-wide in-person events

 - Home office stipend, and more!

CORPORATE VALUES:

 - Follow Through

 - Deep Understanding

 - Whatever It Takes

 - Do Something Smart

jobs.title: Fundable - Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
About Fundable

Fundable is a startup data platform that helps investors and other teams discover and research companies. We bring together information on companies, investors, funding activity, and people to make that research easier.

Role overview

We’re looking for a senior data engineer to own Fundable’s data platform from architecture through production, reliably turning high volumes of data from provider APIs, webhooks, files, and web scraping into trusted records for our products.

Today, our enrichment and extraction workflows largely run serially inside a container. You’ll lead the move to a platform that supports concurrent processing, event-driven intake, and orchestrated batch workflows.

What you’ll own

 - Multi-source intake: Build concurrent ingestion for provider APIs, webhooks, files, and scraping, with rate limits and failure handling.

 - Batch and event-driven execution: Orchestrate scheduled workflows and historical backfills using tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect. Build event-driven intake with Pub/Sub or Cloud Tasks, including retries, dead-letter queues, and controlled replay of failed work.

 - Raw-to-curated data: Preserve original payloads, including provider JSON, in Google Cloud Storage (GCS) before transforming them with dbt. Establish medallion layers for raw, standardized, and curated data.

 - Correctness through recovery: Implement idempotent upserts and safe retries, replay, and historical backfills that avoid duplicate records or data corruption. Make data traceable to its source and safe to reprocess.

 - Data quality and delivery: Define data contracts, build automated validation and pipeline tests, and monitor freshness and failures. Design and optimize PostgreSQL schemas, queries, and loading patterns so downstream products receive dependable data.

 - Extraction and enrichment: Integrate provider enrichment and LLM-based structured extraction from text into the platform.

Must-have experience

 - Experience building multi-source production data platforms from zero to one, from initial architecture and pipeline implementation through deployment and ongoing operation.

 - Production experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or Temporal, including dependencies, retries, and failure recovery. Airflow experience is preferred.

 - Hands-on production experience with dbt and GCP.

 - Experience building event-driven systems with messaging or task queues, including asynchronous processing and failure recovery.

 - Strong SQL and PostgreSQL skills, including data modeling, query optimization, and reliable incremental loading. Experience with data contracts, raw and curated storage, retention policies, and automated quality checks.

 - Strong Python skills, including asynchronous HTTP and concurrent processing with tools such as asyncio, aiohttp, or HTTPX.

 - Hands-on web scraping experience with tools such as Scrapy, Playwright, Selenium, or Beautiful Soup, including concurrent scraping, rate limits, and failure handling.

Nice-to-have experience

 - Experience working in startups or small engineering teams, with broad ownership and changing priorities.

 - Entity resolution experience is especially valuable: matching company and people records across sources and reconciling duplicates into consistent entities.

 - LLM-based structured extraction or company and people data enrichment.

 - Familiarity with BigQuery and Dataform.

Interview Process

 - Silver Screening Interview

 - Offline Case Study

 - Client Behavioral Interview

 - Client Case Study Interview

 - Client System Design Interview

 - Client Final Round Interview
